jobs.title: Clinical Product & Compliance Manager – RN Preferred / Nursing Student Considered
jobs.description: Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager – RN Preferred / Nursing Student Considered **Company:** M Systems **Location:** McKinney, Texas / Hybrid **Employment Type:** Full\-Time or Part\-Time, depending on candidate experience and availability **Industry:** Healthcare Information Technology / Electronic Health Records (EHR) About M Systems M Systems develops healthcare information technology solutions for small and medium\-sized hospitals, including rural hospitals, emergency hospitals, and other healthcare organizations. Our platform supports a broad range of hospital functions, including clinical documentation, patient care workflows, behavioral health, operating room workflows, billing, accounting, and other healthcare management capabilities. We are seeking a nursing professional who can serve as the **clinical voice of the product** and work closely with our software engineering, product, implementation, compliance, management, and customer teams. Position Summary M Systems is seeking a **Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager** to provide clinical domain expertise for our healthcare software products. **Registered Nurse (RN) preferred; qualified nursing students will also be considered.** We welcome candidates who are actively pursuing an ADN, BSN, or equivalent nursing qualification and who have strong clinical knowledge, technical aptitude, attention to detail, and an interest in healthcare technology. The successful candidate will help ensure that M Systems' EHR and clinical applications accurately support real\-world hospital workflows and meet applicable healthcare regulatory, compliance, usability, and product\-quality expectations. The individual will serve as a bridge between: * Nurses and physicians * Hospital administrators * Customers * Product management * Software developers * Quality assurance teams * Implementation teams * Compliance and certification organizations This is an excellent opportunity for a nurse or nursing student interested in combining **clinical knowledge, healthcare technology, software product management, compliance, and clinical informatics**. Key ResponsibilitiesClinical Product Management Serve as an internal clinical subject\-matter resource for M Systems' EHR and healthcare applications. Review product functionality from the perspective of nurses, physicians, and other hospital users. Help engineering and product teams understand real\-world clinical workflows and identify gaps between software functionality and actual clinical practice. Provide clinical input for new product features and product improvements. Participate in product planning and prioritization discussions. Translate clinical needs into clear software requirements, workflows, and acceptance criteria. Evaluate whether proposed product functionality is clinically practical, safe, and easy for hospital staff to use. Clinical Workflow Expertise Provide domain expertise for workflows such as: * Patient registration * Admission * Transfer * Discharge * Nursing assessment * Vital signs * Clinical documentation * Nursing notes * Physician notes * Medication workflows * Medication administration * Physician orders * Nursing orders * Allergies * Problem lists * Patient history * Care plans * Laboratory results * Diagnostic results * Clinical alerts * Behavioral health workflows * Operating room workflows * Emergency department workflows * Clinical handoffs * Patient discharge instructions * Follow\-up care * Patient\-safety workflows Work with customers and internal teams to understand variations in workflow between different hospitals and care environments. Product Testing \& Clinical Validation Develop and execute realistic clinical test scenarios for M Systems applications. Test software using patient\-care scenarios similar to those encountered in hospitals. Perform: * Functional testing * Clinical workflow testing * User acceptance testing * Regression testing * End\-to\-end workflow testing * Usability testing * Patient\-safety\-related testing * Release validation Create detailed clinical test cases and expected results. Document software defects, workflow issues, usability problems, and clinical concerns. Work directly with software engineers to reproduce problems. Verify fixes after engineering changes are completed. Participate in software release reviews and confirm that major clinical workflows have been appropriately tested before release. Develop regression test suites for critical clinical functions. Clinical Quality Assurance Help establish a structured clinical quality assurance process for M Systems products. Create repeatable testing procedures for clinical modules. Maintain traceability between: * Clinical requirements * Product requirements * Regulatory requirements * Software functionality * Test cases * Test results * Defects * Corrective actions Identify high\-risk clinical workflows that require additional testing. Help establish release\-readiness criteria for clinical functionality owledge or willingness to learn the following is desirable: * Electronic Health Records * Microsoft Office * Microsoft Excel * Software testing * Defect tracking * JIRA or similar tools * Clinical workflow documentation * HL7 * FHIR * USCDI * Healthcare interoperability * Healthcare terminology * Clinical coding concepts * Healthcare privacy and security Key Personal Attributes The ideal candidate should be: * Clinically knowledgeable * Detail\-oriented * Analytical * Organized * Patient\-safety focused * Comfortable using technology * Curious about how healthcare software works * Able to identify workflow problems * Comfortable communicating with software developers * Comfortable working with nurses and physicians * Able to communicate with hospital administrators * Willing to research healthcare regulations * Able to maintain detailed compliance documentation * Interested in healthcare technology and clinical informatics * Comfortable working in a growing organization The candidate should also be comfortable questioning workflows that do not make clinical sense and clearly explaining why a workflow should be changed. Initial Priorities During the initial phase of the role, the Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager will focus on: * Learning the complete M Systems clinical product suite. * Documenting major clinical workflows. * Creating standardized clinical test scenarios. * Performing end\-to\-end testing of key EHR workflows. * Identifying functional and clinical usability gaps. * Establishing a structured clinical QA process. * Building a compliance and certification requirements matrix. * Identifying certification\-readiness gaps. * Creating clinical product documentation. * Supporting customer workflow discussions and demonstrations. Key Performance Objectives Success in this role will include: * Establishing a structured clinical product testing process * Developing comprehensive clinical test scenarios * Improving product usability for clinicians * Identifying workflow issues before customers encounter them * Reducing clinical defects found after software releases * Maintaining clear product and clinical documentation * Establishing a compliance and certification roadmap * Improving traceability between requirements and testing * Providing clear clinical requirements to engineering * Improving communication between clinicians and engineering * Supporting successful hospital implementations * Improving clinical product demonstrations * Supporting certification\-readiness activities Career Growth This role can provide significant career growth for a nursing professional interested in healthcare technology. Possible career progression may include: **Clinical Product \& Compliance Manager → Senior Clinical Product Manager → Director of Clinical Informatics / Clinical Product \& Compliance → Clinical Informatics Leadership** The position provides hands\-on exposure to healthcare software design, engineering, compliance, interoperability, customer implementation, and product strategy. Why Join M Systems? This is an opportunity for an RN or nursing student interested in building a career at the intersection of **healthcare and technology**. Instead of only using an EHR system, you will have an opportunity to help **design, test, validate, improve, and shape the EHR itself**. You will work directly with software engineers, healthcare professionals, customers, and company leadership. Your clinical knowledge will influence how M Systems products are designed and how nurses, physicians, and other healthcare professionals interact with the system. For a nursing student interested in healthcare technology, clinical informatics, product management, or healthcare IT, this role can provide practical experience that is difficult to obtain through a traditional nursing position alone. Pay: Up to $40,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement Work Location: Hybrid remote in McKinney, TX 75070

jobs.title: Cloud Planning Engineer
jobs.description: Sabanto is a venture\-backed, Illinois\-based technology company on a mission to drive autonomy into agriculture. We believe the agriculture industry's lack of labor will drive the adoption of Farming\-as\-a\-Service companies using autonomous equipment. It's this very spirit that drives us to build a robotic machinery platform, delivering a service that brings unprecedented efficiency, productivity, and cost to farmers. Join our fast\-growing, industrious, and passionate team of innovators as we continue to disrupt the multi\-billion\-dollar agriculture industry. As a Full Stack Engineer at Sabanto, you will be building the web and api platform that powers the orchestration of vehicle configuration, data pipeline processing and the interfaces that our customers use day\-to\-day when operating their vehicles. **RESPONSIBILITIES \& OUTCOMES** * Maintain and extend the cloud path planning engine — coverage paths, headland generation, turn optimization, and safe traversals — for autonomous agricultural robots operating in the field * Diagnose and resolve issues seen by customers related to field coverage in complex, real\-world field geometries (holes, waterways, irrigation systems) * Build and harden geospatial data pipelines that move field and equipment data through transformations, optimization, and output * Design, build, and operate Python\-based AWS Lambda services across the platform, from spec through deployment * Write tested, hardened, and safe code — unit tests, integration tests against real field data, and visual validation before every change ships * Own the build and deployment lifecycle for serverless cloud services **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's in computer science or a related field * Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem\-solving skills, with comfort reasoning about geometry and spatial data * An entrepreneurial attitude with a keen eye for detail * Organized, disciplined, and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously * Industrious – ideally can drive, or willing to learn to drive, tractors, and anything with four wheels * Ag\-gnostic – can walk up to a farmer, talk the talk, walk the walk, i.e. not intimidated **DESIRED EXPERIENCE** * Mastery of Python, including writing production\-grade, well\-tested services * Experience with geospatial and computational geometry libraries (Shapely, GeoPandas, PyProj, or similar) * 3\+ years building cloud\-native services on Amazon Web Services (AWS) — including Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway, and ECS * Experience working with Docker\-based software and build pipelines * Familiarity with optimization techniques or operations research (e.g. OR\-Tools, vehicle routing problems) a plus * Familiarity with robotics or vehicle kinematics (e.g. Dubins/Reeds\-Shepp paths, turning\-radius constraints) a plus * Familiarity with NodeJS/TypeScript and SQL/NoSQL database engines a plus, for cross\-team collaboration **BENEFITS** At Sabanto, every member of our team moves the needle. With a firm footing in our core company values, we've built a fast\-paced, demanding work culture that allows for the flexibility, autonomy, and career opportunities you'd expect from a growing company. We offer competitive benefits including: * Working on a concept that will forever disrupt the agriculture industry * The chance to make an immediate impact and do the best work of your life * Unlimited Vacation and flexible time * 401k, medical, dental **OUR CORE VALUES** * Own It \- Be self\-driven, entrepreneurial, and efficient * Raise the Bar \- Challenge complacency and mediocrity; be adaptable and agile; details matter * Be As One \- Trust, collaborate, and support; invest in co\-workers and customers * Embrace Curiosity \- Always be learning, be curious and share; be humbled but not embarrassed by mistakes * Do the Right Thing \- Act with integrity, even when no one is looking; be transparent * Empower Farmers \- Create solutions where customers, i.e. farmers, win At Sabanto, we value diversity of culture and background for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. Sabanto is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. This position is open to applicants who are legally authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor work visas at this time.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist (New York)
jobs.description: **About Draftwise** ------------------- Draftwise is a contract drafting, review, and negotiation AI powered by your legal knowledge. We turn a firm's guidance, precedent, and language into a legal ontology, ground our models in it, and run complex drafting, review, and search workflows directly within Microsoft Word and in the browser. We serve top law firms and legal departments globally, including over half the Vault 10, dozens of Am Law 100 firms, and Fortune 500 organizations. We are headquartered in NYC with offices in London and West Palm Beach, are Y Combinator alumni, and raised a $20M Series A from Index Ventures. **About this role** ------------------- We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to embed with leading law firms, discover where Draftwise can create transformational value, and turn that discovery into outcomes for customers and repeatable product capabilities. This is a forward\-deployed role. The center of gravity is product discovery in the field: learning how lawyers actually work, identifying the highest\-value problems, and understanding the documents, data, systems, and organizational constraints behind them. You will be accountable for driving transformational outcomes for the customer. Those outcomes must be demonstrable and measurable. You will move comfortably between conversations with managing partners and C\-level executives, working sessions with associates and knowledge teams, and technical discussions with customer IT and Draftwise engineers. You will distill what you learn into clear product requirements, scope them with Product, Engineering, and ML, track them through delivery, and validate the result with users. Every engagement should create leverage beyond a single customer. You will distinguish one\-off requests from recurring needs and help turn validated patterns into reusable product capabilities, evaluations, configurations, and playbooks. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Embed with customers, often onsite, to observe how partners, associates, knowledge professionals, innovation teams, and IT teams work, and uncover high\-value problems they may not yet be able to articulate. * Define the customer outcome before prescribing a solution, then map the workflows, decisions, documents, data, systems, organizational constraints, and incentives that shape where and how Draftwise can create the greatest value. * Work directly with customer documents, data, systems, and Draftwise tools to test feasibility and determine where AI can create transformational value. * Distill user and customer needs into clear product requirements; scope them with Product, Engineering, and ML; make trade\-offs; track the work; and drive it through delivery. * Build and configure prototypes, demos, data transformations, lightweight automations, and evaluations; put them in front of real users early and iterate from evidence. * Identify which needs are customer\-specific and which reveal repeatable patterns; help turn validated patterns into reusable platform capabilities, configurations, evaluations, and playbooks. * Present findings, requirements, trade\-offs, and outcomes credibly to managing partners, customer IT, frontline users, and Draftwise teams, using field evidence to shape what we build next. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in deployment strategy, forward\-deployed work, product discovery, solutions engineering or consulting, or another customer\-facing technical role where you owned outcomes in complex environments. * A track record of taking ambiguous, high\-stakes customer problems from discovery, to clear product requirements, to shipped solutions that produced material customer outcomes. * Strong analytical judgment and the instinct to get beneath stated requirements and understand the workflow, the data, the organizational dynamics, the real constraints, and where value is ultimately created. * Strong technical fluency and hands\-on experience with modern AI tools. You can query data, work with APIs and data models, stand up a prototype or automation, use AI coding tools as a force multiplier, and critically evaluate their outputs and limitations. * Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the range to work credibly with executives, lawyers, technical teams, and frontline users. * The delivery discipline to scope ambiguous work, make trade\-offs, manage dependencies, track progress, and keep a cross\-functional team oriented around the customer outcome. * High ownership, low ego, sound judgment, and willingness to travel and spend meaningful time onsite with customers. **Helpful, but not required** ----------------------------- * Familiarity with legal workflows, law\-firm knowledge systems, document management systems, or other complex professional\-services environments. * Experience practicing law or working in legal innovation, knowledge management, legal operations, or legal technology. **What we value** ----------------- * Clear communication and thoughtful, direct feedback. * Autonomy, ownership, and consistently high\-quality execution. * Curiosity about how people, data, and systems work in the real world. * Comfort with changing objectives and imperfect information. * A collaborative approach that builds trust across customers and internal teams. **What we offer** ----------------- * Meaningful equity, giving you a stake in Draftwise's growth. * Competitive salary. * Private medical care. * A work\-from\-home stipend for necessary equipment and accessories. * Unlimited PTO and sick leave. * The opportunity to shape how a fast\-growing company deploys AI in the legal industry.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II
jobs.description: Electrical Engineer — Capital Equipment \& Industrial Automation **Location:** Northeast Wisconsin (on\-site) · **Type:** Full\-time, exempt (Direct Hire) The opportunity: We are conducting a confidential search on behalf of an established manufacturer of custom capital equipment serving the industrial automation market. Their machines are engineered to order, which means no two projects look the same and no engineer spends their career maintaining someone else's legacy design. This is a role for an electrical engineer who wants ownership. You'll take machines from a blank slate through schematic design, build, factory acceptance testing, and commissioning... and then watch them run in production. If you've been boxed into one narrow slice of the design cycle, this is the opposite of that. Why take this role? * **End\-to\-end ownership.** Concept through commissioning on real, physical equipment you can walk up to and touch. * **Technical variety.** Power distribution, motion and drives, safety circuits, instrumentation, sensors, and controls integration, across a portfolio of custom machine platforms. * **Room to grow.** A clear path toward senior engineer, technical lead, or engineering management for people who want it. Our client promotes from within and is candid about what advancement requires. * **Real autonomy.** Engineers are trusted to make design decisions and defend them, not route every choice through three layers of approval. * **Cross\-functional exposure.** You'll work shoulder to shoulder with mechanical, controls, manufacturing, and field service, and directly with customers. What you'll do **Design and development** * Design electrical systems, circuits, panels, and components for custom capital equipment and automation systems * Develop schematics, wiring diagrams, bills of materials, and specifications to applicable standards and customer requirements * Select and specify components and devices based on application requirements, performance, reliability, safety, cost, and lead time * Support integration of motors, drives, sensors, instrumentation, power distribution, safety circuits, and control devices **Build, test, and commission** * Participate in prototype development, equipment assembly, factory acceptance testing, installation, commissioning, and start\-up * Perform electrical calculations, design reviews, testing, and validation against functional, performance, quality, and safety requirements * Troubleshoot systems and equipment using engineering principles, technical documentation, diagnostic tools, and structured problem\-solving **Support and improvement** * Provide technical guidance to manufacturing, service, customers, and suppliers, resolving production and field issues with practical solutions * Identify opportunities to improve equipment performance, reliability, manufacturability, safety, and cost * Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, and regulatory requirements * Maintain accurate engineering documentation, including drawings, specifications, test records, and change orders **Project leadership** * Manage assigned engineering projects: define requirements, build schedules, coordinate resources, and communicate status * Stay current on relevant technologies, components, and industry practices, and bring forward the ones worth adopting What you'll bring * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline * Five or more years of relevant experience preferred: capital equipment, industrial automation, plastics converting, or a comparable manufacturing environment * Working knowledge of applicable electrical codes, industry standards, and regulatory requirements * Proficiency with electrical design software; experience with tools such as SolidWorks Electrical and/or DraftSight is a plus * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the judgment to diagnose complex issues and commit to a solution * Ability to interpret and develop engineering drawings, schematics, and specifications * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams * Solid project management and organizational skills * Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship Work environment Modern, climate\-controlled, secure\-entry facilities with low noise levels and a genuine safety\-first culture. The role splits time between an engineering workstation and the manufacturing floor, so you'll need the mobility to inspect equipment: bending, reaching, climbing stairs, and standing or walking for stretches: and the willingness to wear required PPE, including safety glasses, hearing protection, and hard hats. Expect moderate exposure to noise, vibration, dust, and varying temperatures typical of a production environment. How to apply Apply directly through this posting, or reach out for a confidential conversation. We're happy to share full details about the company, team, and compensation with qualified candidates before you commit to anything. Pay: $77,309\.04 \- $106,286\.16 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Employee discount * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Valorian is hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (full\-stack TypeScript) to build custom software directly with industrial customers ### **About Valorian, LLC** Valorian builds intelligence systems for industrial operations by integrating data, systems, and AI—designed around how work actually gets done in the field. We combine deep industry business\-process expertise with modern technology to deliver clarity across the full execution lifecycle: planned work, its readiness for safe execution, real\-time performance in the field, outcomes at completion, and variance between plan and execution so teams can continuously learn and improve. ### **Description** **Candidates must be located in the Houston metro. In addition to your resume, please** **submit your video screening****.** **Role Summary** You won't be handed tickets from a backlog written by someone else. You'll sit with the customer, watch how the work actually gets done, prototype in the loop with the people who'll use it, and productionize what works — owning meaningful slices of real products end to end. We're a team of about ten building custom software for industrial operations in an AI\-accelerated world, and we're doing it by putting engineers closer to the customer, not further away. The work you own is visible, the decisions you make carry, and the people who depend on what you build will know your name. **Who We Are** Valorian builds intelligence systems for industrial operations by integrating data, systems, and AI — designed around how work actually gets done in the field. Our customers run petrochemical plants and field operations where visibility, safety, and efficiency have real consequences. Our products replace spreadsheets, paper, and disconnected systems with software shaped around their actual workflow, built on a shared platform: React/Next.js and TypeScript on the front end, Node.js/Fastify APIs, PostgreSQL via Prisma, and Azure underneath. **What You'll Own** * Time with customers every week — working sessions, demos, and on\-site visits — observing real workflows and turning what you learn into well\-scoped tickets with crisp acceptance criteria. * Fast prototypes built alongside customers and our Product/Project Managers to validate direction, then hardened into production\-grade features. * Vertical slices end to end: React/Next.js (TypeScript) front ends, Node.js/Fastify APIs, and PostgreSQL via Prisma. * The written record the team inherits: workflow and integration diagrams, data models, decision rules, and Architecture Decision Records for the calls that matter. * Our shared ontology and data models as new customer domains come into scope — reconciling conflicting sources of truth and naming things once, well. * Testing for your work — unit, API, and Playwright end\-to\-end — wired into CI/CD so regressions surface before a customer finds them. * Contributions to Valorian's Design System and shared packages, so what you learn on one product compounds across all of them. * How we use AI: agents as leverage across spec, implementation, and testing, and a voice in which emerging tools earn a place in the team's daily practice. **What Good Looks Like** * **By 90 days:** you've participated meaningfully in customer sessions, shipped your first vertical slice to production, and can describe a customer's workflow more accurately than the ticket does. * **By six months:** you own a product area end to end, customers ask for you by name, and change orders on your work are small because you validated before you built. You've earned the right to solve bigger problems for them. * **By a year:** your contributions are load\-bearing for the team, and you're influencing what we build next — not just how it gets built. **What We're Looking For** * You've built and shipped full\-stack TypeScript products — React/Next.js, Node, and a relational database — and can point to work running in production * You're comfortable in the room with customers: leading a working session, asking the uncomfortable question early, and saying so when what's being asked for isn't advisable * You can model a business domain and write it down clearly enough that a customer confirms it's right and an engineer can build from it * You design APIs thoughtfully (auth, pagination, error handling, rate limiting) and treat data models, migrations, and security as the places to slow down and think * You keep test suites meaningful in CI — unit, API, and end\-to\-end — rather than green by deletion * You reach for shared, reusable solutions over re\-solving the same problem on every project * You're curious about AI tooling and have the judgment to tell real leverage from novelty **Nice to Have** * Azure (App Service, Functions, Container Apps) and Docker * ETL pipelines and data migrations * AI\-powered features: RAG, embeddings, evaluation loops * Observability: metrics, logs, traces * Prior forward\-deployed, consulting, or customer\-facing engineering experience **Compensation and Benefits** * Base salary for this role is $115,000 to $140,000, depending on experience. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance begin on the first of the month following 30 days of employment. * Paid time off accrues each pay period, totaling 15 days annually. * 10 paid holidays are provided per year. * Employees are provided with the equipment necessary to perform their job. * Travel for customer and team time is company\-paid. **Eligibility Requirements** * Applicants must live in the Houston metro. * Because customer sessions happen live, you'll need to be available during U.S. Central business hours and have a quiet, professional workspace for calls, demos, and screen sharing. * This role requires professional English fluency sufficient to independently lead live customer working sessions and demos. * Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. This role does not offer visa sponsorship. * Employment is contingent on a background check and pre\-employment drug screening, in accordance with applicable law. **How We Hire** * Every application is reviewed by a member of our team. We believe hiring deserves a human perspective, and we want to understand the person behind the resume. * We place significant emphasis on the video interview. Your experience and accomplishments matter, but so do the way you communicate, think through problems, collaborate, and show up as a teammate. * We’re a small but mighty company, and every employee has a meaningful impact. We hire selectively because finding the right fit matters—for our team, our culture, our clients, and for you. * Selected applicants will be invited to a 30\-minute introductory conversation. We’ll share more about Valorian, learn more about your background, and talk about what you’re looking for in your next role. * Next, you’ll meet with the hiring manager for a 30\-minute conversation focused on the role, our tech stack and workflows, and what success looks like in the position. * You’ll then participate in a practical session with one of our engineers**,** working through a real, anonymized customer problem. This gives both of us a chance to see how you approach the kind of work you’d actually be doing. * The final conversation is an introduction to several key members of the Valorian team. It’s an opportunity to get to know the people you may be working alongside and ask any remaining questions. * We respect your time. We aim to move through the hiring process efficiently and will keep you informed about timing, next steps, and where you stand throughout the process. **Our Values** These aren't posters on a wall — they're how we decide what to build and how we treat each other while we build it. We want people who bring their whole selves to work, take ownership of outcomes rather than tasks, and are direct in how they give and receive feedback. * **Trustworthy**: Committed to building long\-term trust by showing up with an authentic high level of care and taking ownership of outcomes, behaviors, and work product. * **Resourceful**: Leverages curiosity, ingenuity, creativity, and innovation to accomplish goals; thinks long term, and is focused on sustainable results. * **Passionate**: Brings infectious energy, passion, and care for what we do and who we work with. * **Balanced**: Strives for harmony in family, health, fun, and energy. * **Connected**: Committed to meaningful communication and healthy conflict through listening, transparency, and the courage to receive and give feedback. **Interested?** If you're excited about building real products, working directly with the people who use them, and helping define what AI\-accelerated development looks like in practice, we'd love to talk. Submit your resume and complete your video screening. #### **Salary** $115,000 \- $140,000 per year

jobs.title: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer, Backend - New York
jobs.description: **About Draftwise** ------------------- Draftwise is a contract drafting, review, and negotiation AI powered by your legal knowledge. We turn a firm's guidance, precedent, and language into a legal ontology, ground our models in it, and run complex drafting, review, and search workflows directly within Microsoft Word and in the browser. We serve top law firms and legal departments globally, including over half the Vault 10, dozens of Am Law 100 firms, and Fortune 500 organizations. We are headquartered in NYC with offices in London and West Palm Beach, are Y Combinator alumni, and raised a $20M Series A from Index Ventures. **The role** ------------ A Forward Deployed Engineer at Draftwise embeds with a firm, learns how their lawyers actually draft, and extends the product until it works the way they work. You will model their precedent and playbooks into our ontology and write the backend behind it, and when the platform cannot do what a firm needs, you build it. This is the early career version of that job, weighted toward backend engineering and the AI systems underneath the product. You will learn forward deployed engineering and ontology modeling from engineers who built those practices at Palantir, with real customer accounts and real code from your first month. The scope is broad. You get ownership and impact across the technology, the product, and our culture, working alongside a first rate engineering team to ship new features, scale the platform, and make it more performant. **What you will work on** ------------------------- * *Ontology modeling for legal knowledge.* Every firm has its own precedent, playbooks, and preferred language, and the ontology is how we turn that into structure the product can reason over. This is the most transferable skill in the role. * *Backend services behind drafting, review, and search.* We are not religious about languages. There is what the codebase was historically built in and there is whatever gets the job done now, and the complexity that lasts sits underneath that: Postgres, OpenSearch, a graph database, and a wide set of AWS services. You will own features end to end and learn how those pieces fit together, which is rarer to pick up early than any one language. * *LLM systems in production.* You will write and test prompts, build retrieval and evaluation scaffolding, and measure quality on real customer data, so the work looks more like building test infrastructure than tuning prompts by feel. * *Scale and performance.* We run large documents and large precedent sets under interactive latency, so profiling, query tuning, and cost work show up as regular engineering here. * *Deployments into elite law firms, with a senior FDE beside you.* You will own pieces of a firm's rollout early, and you will be the one working out why their playbook does not map cleanly onto the product yet. * *Enough frontend to finish the job.* Our surface is a Word add in and a web app in TypeScript and React, and we expect you to ship a UI change without waiting on someone else. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * *High ownership and low ego.* Most of our work arrives as a customer problem instead of a spec, so we look for people who take it off someone else's plate, ask for feedback early, and do not care who jobs.title: Foundation Model Data Engineer
jobs.description: Sciforium is an AI infrastructure company developing next\-generation multimodal AI models and a proprietary, high\-efficiency serving platform. Backed by multi\-million\-dollar funding and direct sponsorship from AMD with hands\-on support from AMD engineers the team is scaling rapidly to build the full stack powering frontier AI models and real\-time applications. **Role Overview** ----------------- Sciforium is seeking a highly technical and visionary **Foundation Model Data Engineer** to lead the strategy, creation, and curation of the massive datasets that power our foundation models. We believe that in the era of LLMs, data is the primary competitive advantage. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end data lifecycle—from raw web\-scale crawling to the fine\-grained human\-alignment datasets that define model behavior. This position is ideal for a scientist who views data as a high\-scale engineering challenge and an analytical puzzle. You will not just "provide" data; you will design the taxonomies, filtering heuristics, and post\-training pipelines that ensure our models are world\-class in reasoning, safety, and multimodal understanding. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Foundation Dataset Strategy:** Own the end\-to\-end creation of pre\-training datasets for LLMs. This includes defining the mix of web data, code, books, and technical papers to optimize for downstream model performance. * **Petabyte\-Scale Curation:** Design and implement sophisticated pipelines for data cleaning, exact/fuzzy deduplication, and high\-quality signal extraction from petabytes of raw, unstructured data. * **Post\-Training \& Alignment Data:** Lead the development of high\-quality post\-training datasets, including Supervised Fine\-Tuning (SFT) instructions, multi\-turn dialogues, and preference modeling data (RLHF/DPO). * **Multimodal Expansion:** Drive the acquisition and processing of vision and video data, navigating the complexities of multimodal alignment, video compression, and temporal data consistency. * **High\-Performance Engineering:** Develop high\-throughput data processing scripts using Python, leveraging multiprocessing and multithreading to handle massive\-scale ingestion and transformation without bottlenecks. * **Data Profiling \& Analysis:** Conduct deep\-dive statistical analysis on training corpora to identify biases, gaps in knowledge, and quality regressions, ensuring the "diet" of the model is mathematically balanced. * **Synthetic Data Generation:** (Added Value) Design pipelines to generate high\-reasoning synthetic data to augment gaps in natural datasets, utilizing existing models for data labeling and refinement. **Must\-Haves** --------------- * **5\+ years of industry experience** in Data Science or Machine Learning, with a proven track record of building and managing datasets for foundation models. * **Deep Proficiency in Python:** Expert\-level skills with a focus on high\-performance code, including **multiprocessing, multithreading**, and efficient memory management for large\-scale data tasks. * **Petabyte\-Scale Experience:** Demonstrated experience working with **petabyte\-scale datasets** that have been directly used to train production\-grade LLMs or Large Vision Models. * **Dataset Reconstruction:** Experience building massive LLM training sets **from scratch**, including raw web crawls (e.g., Common Crawl) and specialized domain data. * **Post\-Training Expertise:** Hands\-on experience building datasets for **RLHF, DPO, and multi\-turn instruction following**, including the management of human\-labeling workflows and quality gold\-sets. * **Data Tooling:** Mastery of data\-at\-scale frameworks such as Spark, Ray, or high\-performance data\-loading formats (e.g., WebDataset, Parquet). **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * **Computer Vision (CV) Curation:** Experience building large\-scale image or video datasets from scratch (e.g., LAION\-style pipelines). * **Multimodal Crawling:** Familiarity with large\-scale crawling of multimodal data and the associated challenges of **video processing, codecs, and compression.** * **Taxonomy Design:** Experience in designing complex labeling schemas for reasoning, coding, and mathematical benchmarks. * **Research Background:** A Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field with a focus on data\-centric AI or information retrieval. **Benefits include** -------------------- * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401k plan * Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages * Flexible time off * Competitive salary and equity **Equal opportunity** --------------------- Sciforium is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Compensation Range: $155K \- $210K

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Gravitate?** At Gravitate, we’re on a mission to put everyday supply and logistics decisions in motion, powered by innovative problem\-solving from industry experts. A lot of companies say it. We mean it: Gravitate is different. Rooted in the spirit of collaboration, we thrive on the smarts of our people and the dynamic we’ve cultivated. **Tell Me About My Job:** If you are considering this role, you are someone who has moved past needing a fully specified ticket. Hand you a feature of moderate complexity and you break it into tasks, deliver it on time, and raise the risks you spot along the way instead of surfacing them late. You’ll own features and components within your product area in Gravitate’s fuel logistics platform, and you’ll be responsible for the quality and ongoing maintenance of what you build — not just the first version that shipped. This is a genuinely full\-stack role. You’ll write Python on the service and API side, model data in MongoDB, and build the React and TypeScript interfaces on top — following a feature from the data model through the API to the screen a dispatcher actually uses. We expect you to be strong on one side of that and genuinely willing to contribute on the other. You’ll also be a reliable member of the on\-call rotation for your product area — debugging incoming bugs and incidents independently, and contributing to the monitoring, observability, and performance improvements that make your area healthier over time. This is a role with room to grow, and we’ll be explicit with you about what the next level looks like. Engineers who do well here start by delivering medium\-sized work accurately and reliably, then take on larger and more ambiguous projects, carry more weight in design discussions, and begin mentoring the engineers behind them. We’re strongly against artificial separations of responsibility and throwing work “over the wall.” As an engineer here, you’re part of the product team — in the room for the product conversation, not downstream of it. **You’re an Ideal Candidate If:** * You deliver reliably. You can take a medium or large\-sized feature with real unknowns, break it into tasks, estimate it honestly, and land it. When something threatens the date, you say so early. * You work end\-to\-end. You’re not precious about which layer a problem lives in. You’ll follow an issue from the UI through the API to the query and fix it where it actually belongs. * You write code other people can live with. Well\-tested, readable, and consistent with the codebase around it. You debug your own problems before escalating them. * You’re building your design judgment. You bring viable alternatives to design discussions rather than waiting to be told, and you can write a clear design doc for a feature in your area. * You give and take feedback well. Your code review comments are specific and constructive. You’re receptive to feedback on your own work and you act on it. * You’re curious about the business. You want to understand what fuel supply and logistics teams actually do with this software, because knowing that makes every decision you make a better one. * You want to work in an AI\-enabled workflow. You see the impact of AI on code generation and are willing and able to see how it can make you more productive. You want to help in building the harness around it so that the team can get more done. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Independently deliver features of moderate complexity on time — breaking work into manageable tasks, estimating accurately with some unknowns, and raising risks early * Build features end\-to\-end across the stack: Python services and APIs, MongoDB data models, and React/TypeScript interfaces * Own features and components within your product area — accountable for their quality and ongoing maintenance * Contribute to design discussions with viable alternatives; produce clear technical designs for features within your area * Write well\-tested, readable code and help improve our automated testing practices and coverage * Be a reliable member of the on\-call rotation — debug and resolve small\-to\-medium bugs, incidents, and issues in your product area independently * Contribute to monitoring, observability, and performance improvements within your product area * Provide constructive, specific code review feedback; informally mentor engineers newer than you * Write clear technical documents; communicate status, risks, and blockers clearly to your team **Required Qualifications:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping production software * Proficiency in both a server\-side language (Python preferred) and TypeScript/React — or real depth in one, plus a demonstrated track record of picking up the other * Demonstrated ability to independently deliver medium\-sized features with some unknowns, on time * Able to debug and resolve small\-to\-medium issues independently, across both the frontend and the backend * Experience writing well\-tested code, plus working knowledge of CI/CD and deployment practices * Comfortable participating in an on\-call rotation for the product area you own * Clear written and verbal communication — able to produce small\-to\-medium technical documents and give constructive code review feedback * Receptive to feedback and actively acts on it * Openness to utilizing and becoming an expert in AI\-assisted development to supercharge your ability to get stuff done. **Nice to Have Experience:** * Hands\-on experience with our stack: Python, React and TypeScript, MongoDB, Kubernetes, GCP or Azure * Experience in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment * Background in a logistics, supply chain, or energy/fuel domain * Experience with data\-dense enterprise interfaces — large tables and grids, scheduling views, or real\-time updates * AI engineering experience – working with production agentic systems and ML / operations models. **About the Gravitate Team:** To understand who our people are, you should first understand what they’re not: replaceable. Each member of the team is chosen carefully and with intention. We believe that finding the right fit is more important than a laundry list of credentials – and that people are people first, and titles second. Because we hire the Gravitate way, our team is certainly one of a kind. We’ve brought together incredible talent that regularly collaborates to create clean, fresh solutions. That effort has led to remarkable opportunities, including work with many Fortune 500 clients. We’ve found that the winning combination of exciting achievements, trust in one another and open communication lays the groundwork for long\-lasting, successful careers. That, and the fact that we clap for each other at every opportunity. Problem solvers, go\-getters and charge\-takers — we (really) want to hear from you.

jobs.title: People Operations

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: Sapience AI is the collective intelligence platform for professional communities. We sit above the CRMs, AMS platforms, and knowledge bases that organizations already run, and we turn the expertise scattered across them into something every member can search, act on, and share. The intelligence a community needs is already inside it. Most organizations just cannot reach it. Knowledge lives in silos, in legacy systems, in the heads of a few experts, and in fragmented records no one can connect. We change that. Our work is grounded in four commitments: technology elevates people and never replaces them, the best expertise is already inside the community, everything is built on trust, and every deployment is purpose\-driven for the organization it serves. **Let's achieve more, together.** **Where this role sits** ======================== This role owns a product area end to end. Where the product marketer is the market lens, you are the person accountable for what we build, how it works, and whether it ships and succeeds. You lead a cross\-functional team of engineers, designers, and applied AI specialists to turn strategy into a product members rely on. You own the roadmap for your area, the decisions inside it, and the outcomes it produces. You work at the center of the product organization, translating a clear point of view into shipped work that moves MINERVA and the COGENT architecture forward through each GR/GA milestone. **Why this role exists** ======================== In an AI market where capabilities can be copied in weeks, the advantage goes to teams that decide well and ship fast. Someone has to hold the point of view, make the calls, and keep a team building the right thing. Collective intelligence is hard product work: reasoning over messy knowledge, earning member trust, and fitting into how communities already operate. It needs an owner who can hold both the ambition and the details. The Senior Product Manager is that owner. You set direction for your area, make the hard prioritization calls, and are accountable for whether the product succeeds with the people it serves. **What you will own (Areas of Responsibility)** =============================================== You hold eight areas of responsibility inside the product organization. Each one is yours to set direction on, build, and measure. **1\. Product strategy and roadmap ownership** ---------------------------------------------- * Own the strategy and roadmap for your product area, grounded in member needs, market evidence, and company goals. * Make clear prioritization calls, and protect the roadmap from reactive churn. * Sequence work so each release builds toward a strategy, not a list of features. **2\. Discovery and definition** -------------------------------- * Run discovery with members, buyers, and internal experts to understand the real problem before committing to a solution. * Write clear definitions of what to build and why, including the assumptions and the bet behind each one. * Validate early and often, so the team learns fast and adjusts faster. **3\. Delivery and execution** ------------------------------ * Lead a cross\-functional team through delivery, unblocking decisions and keeping momentum. * Own trade\-offs on scope, quality, and time, and make them explicit. * Ship reliably, and hold a clear bar for what launch\-ready means. **4\. AI product judgment** --------------------------- * Make sound calls about where AI helps, where it fails, and how to design for its limits. * Design for trust: provenance, guardrails, and honest handling of uncertainty in what the platform tells members. * Partner with applied AI and research to turn capability into dependable product behavior. **5\. Member trust and outcomes** --------------------------------- * Keep member value and trust at the center of every decision. * Define the outcomes your area is accountable for, and measure them honestly. * Own adoption and time\-to\-value, not just shipped features. **6\. Metrics, instrumentation, and learning** ---------------------------------------------- * Instrument your area so you can tell whether a bet is working. * Turn signals into decisions, and shorten the distance from learning to change. * Run experiments where the answer is genuinely uncertain. **7\. Cross\-functional alignment** ----------------------------------- * Align engineering, design, product marketing, and operations around a shared plan and a shared point of view. * Communicate clearly across the company, up and sideways, so people know what is happening and why. * Partner with the product marketer as the market lens, and with go\-to\-market on launch readiness. **8\. Roadmap for platform capability** --------------------------------------- * Advance the underlying platform capability your area depends on, in partnership with platform and architecture teams. * Balance customer\-facing value with the durable investments MINERVA and COGENT need. * Help steer the p oduct management, with a track record of owning a product area end to end. * Experience shipping AI or ML products, with sound judgment about their strengths and limits. * A record of setting strategy, making hard prioritization calls, and delivering outcomes. * Strong discovery and validation instincts with real members and buyers. * Technical fluency to partner credibly with engineering and applied AI. * Analytical rigor with product metrics and the judgment to separate signal from noise. * Excellent communication and cross\-functional leadership. ***Preferred qualifications*** ------------------------------ * Experience with retrieval, agents, knowledge graphs, or neuro\-symbolic systems. * Experience building trust\-sensitive products with sensitive data. * Familiarity with CRM, AMS, or knowledge\-platform ecosystems. * Domain understanding of professional communities or membership\-driven organizations. * Experience helping define a new product or category. **How you work** ---------------- * You lead with the member and name the real problem before the solution. * You hold a clear, bold point of view and defend it with evidence. * You make hard calls, own them, and keep the team moving. * You treat trust and honesty about AI's limits as first\-order. * You communicate clearly and bring people with you. * You treat learning as the job and change course without ego. **Skills \& Competencies** ========================== * Product strategy, roadmap ownership, and prioritization. * Discovery, problem definition, and validation. * AI product design, including designing for model limits and uncertainty. * Metrics, instrumentation, and experimentation. * Cross\-functional leadership and clear written communication. * Trust, provenance, and governance in AI products. * Balancing customer value with durable platform investment. **Services \& Tools Experience** ================================ * Product analytics and experimentation platforms. * Roadmapping, discovery, and collaboration tools. * Familiarity with LLM, retrieval, vector, and graph systems at a working level. * SQL for pulling and reasoning about product data. * Design and prototyping tools for collaborating with design. * Issue tracking and delivery tooling. * Familiarity with Sapience AI's MINERVA platform and COGENT architecture (trained on the job). **Prior Experience \& Background** ================================== * Prior senior product management at a software or AI company. * A track record of owning a product area and its outcomes. * Experience shipping AI\-driven products to real audiences. * Experience in trust\-sensitive or regulated domains is a plus. **Cross\-functional partners** ============================== You work most closely with Engineering, Product Design, Applied AI, and Product Operations, and you partner tightly with Product Marketing as the market lens. You align with go\-to\-market teams on launch readiness while they own the campaigns and sales motion downstream. **How we hire** =============== We review every application, and we encourage you to apply even if you do not match every line above. Research shows that talented people, especially those from underrepresented communities, often hold back when they do not meet every qualification. If that is the only thing holding you back, apply anyway. Sapience AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a workplace where everyone, regardless of background, has a voice in building what comes next. **Compensation** ================ Base Salary: $180,000 \- $190,000 \+ early stage equity Generous health and wellness benefits *Sapience AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation to complete our application process, let your recruiter know.*

jobs.description: **Principal AI Engineer (SDLC)** **Generative AI \& Enterprise Applications** **About the Role** AT\&T is seeking an innovative and results\-driven AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy next\-generation AI\-powered products and platforms across the enterprise. In this role, you will take cutting\-edge AI capabilities, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic workflows, and transform them into scalable, production\-ready business applications. Unlike traditional AI research roles that focus on inventing models, this position focuses on making AI usable at scale by integrating AI technologies into enterprise software solutions through the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). You will collaborate with software engineers, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable, and highly scalable AI solutions that drive business value. This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about application development, cloud technologies, APIs, automation, and delivering AI\-driven experiences that solve real\-world business challenges. **Key Responsibilities** **AI Product Development** * Design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications and platforms that support enterprise business objectives. * Build Generative AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG architectures, and agent\-based workflows. * Develop intelligent assistants, copilots, chatbots, and AI automation solutions that enhance employee and customer experiences. * Transform AI concepts, proofs of concept, and prototypes into production\-ready software products. **Software Engineering \& Integration** * Design and build scalable APIs, \& Platform Engineering** * Deploy and manage AI workloads across cloud environments including Azure and AWS. * Implement containerized and cloud\-native solutions using Kubernetes and modern and lifecycle management of AI solutions. * Support model integration, version management, governance, and operational excellence. * Monitor production environments and continuously improve platform performance and user experience. **Innovation \& Collaboration** * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities for enterprise adoption. * Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, data scientists, UX teams, and business stakeholders. * Contribute to technical architecture decisions and AI engineering best practices. * Drive continuous improvement across AI development methodologies and delivery frameworks. **Example Projects You May Build** * Enterprise Generative AI chatbots and virtual assistants * AI\-powered recruiting and talent acquisition Large Language Models (LLMs) * Integrates with trouble\-ticket and operational systems * Provides intelligent outage recommendations * Surfaces network analytics and operational insights * Delivers a fully deployed, production\-ready software solution **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field * Experience developing enterprise applications using modern software engineering practices * Strong proficiency in Python and modern application development frameworks * Experience building RESTful APIs and microservices * Knowledge of Generative AI technologies, LLMs, and AI application architectures * Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure and/or AWS * Experience working within Agile and SDLC environments * Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and software release management * Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and collaboration skills **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) solutions * Experience developing agentic AI workflows and autonomous AI systems * Knowledge of MLOps platforms and machine learning deployment practices * Experience integrating AI solutions into enterprise business systems * Familiarity with vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation frameworks * Experience developing scalable cloud\-native AI applications * Exposure to enterprise security, governance, and responsible AI practices **Ideal Background** **Candidates may currently hold titles such as:** * AI Engineer * Generative AI Engineer * Machine Learning Engineer * AI Solutions Engineer * AI Application Engineer * AI Platform Engineer **Why Join AT\&T?** Join a team that is transforming how AI is applied across one of the world's largest technology and communications companies. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Health
jobs.description: **We Are:** The beginning of a new Data \& AI decade that will reshape work and society has begun. Accenture is stepping boldly into this future with a clear strategy and purpose: to help clients optimize and reinvent their business with data \& AI — backed by a $3B investment and commitment to our people to do industry\-defining work. With over 45,000 professionals dedicated to Data \& AI, Accenture’s Data \& AI organization brings together our Experienced Innovation, Strategic Investment, Exceptional Talent, and Power Ecosystem. **You Are:** An AI Native Engineer that brings deep technical and domain expertise to AI programs at provider organizations — designing solutions that work inside the realities of the electronic medical record and clinical workflows, extending to the administrative side of care where AI can ease the burden of documentation, prior authorization, coding, and revenue cycle. You'll help providers put AI to work across both the clinical and operational realities of their environment and help define the future of healthcare interoperability. **The Work:** * Embed with provider teams. Work forward\-deployed inside health systems, hospitals, and physician groups – alongside clinical informatics, physicians and nurses, and revenue\-cycle and operations leaders – redesigning processes around AI and co\-creating solutions using AI tooling to move quickly from idea to working solution. * Scope the program. Define the problem, the intended outcome, and what good looks like – and identify where AI can automate or augment clinical and administrative work. * Set the technical architecture. Lead the technical architecture of AI programs in provider environments and articulate it clearly, on paper and in diagrams, for engineers and clinical leaders alike. * Design for trust. Make sure the solutions you shape are safe, compliant, and clinically sound – building the human oversight, transparency and PHI safeguards that AI in care settings demands. * Reimagine the ways of working. Reimagine the future way of working for clinical and operational teams, rather than simply automating today's processes. * Shape interoperability. Help define the future of healthcare interoperability — how the broader ecosystem can connect to the health record in a deep, meaningful way. * Turn engagements into reusable approaches. Distill what works across providers into repeatable methods and accelerators, so each program starts further ahead than the last. Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements. What you need: * 3\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience with cloud\-native systems — APIs, microservices, containerization, and serverless — including working with AI platforms (Claude, OpenAI, Vertex AI, or open\-source models) and at least 1 year designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production * Minimum 1 year of experience delivering AI or technology programs inside payer organizations. * Minimum 1 year hands\-on experience using Claude or an equivalent frontier AI tool to do the work. * 3\+ years of experience hands\-on coding in at least one general\-purpose language (e.g., Python, Java) and the ability to pick up others as engagements demand * 3\+ years of experience with hands\-on production deployment experience — CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging — with demonstrated end\-to\-end delivery ownership in a client\-embedded environment * Bachelor's degree (or equivalent minimum 12 years work experience, or minimum 6 years' work experience with Associate's degree) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Professional Skills Requirements: * Deep understanding of how core administrative and claims platforms work and how claims and member data are structured, with direct QNXT, Facets, HealthEdge, or comparable experience * Fluency with data — non\-trivial SQL, relational modeling, and reasoning about data quality and data lineage * Working knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards and EDI mechanisms: X12 transaction flows (837, 835, 270/271, 276/277, 278, 834\), FHIR APIs, and the broader exchange landscape * Deep understanding of payer workflows — how coverage and payment actually work across eligibility and enrollment, claims adjudication, prior authorization and utilization management, provider network and reimbursement, appeals and grievances, and risk and quality programs — including a real sense of where administrative burden and cost accumulate and where AI can meaningfully relieve it, and how the regulatory environment (HIPAA and CMS requirements) shapes what solutions can look like * AI solution architecture and AI program scoping, with strong written and presentation skills * Comfortable working forward\-deployed, embedded directly with health plans in a fast\-iterating model * Hig rm disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. jobs.title: Head Of Engineeing
jobs.description: Acclinate is a venture\-backed (post\-Series A, lead investors are Cencora and Labcorp) digital health company that leverages patented technology and 6\+ years of proprietary community intelligence to empower communities to take actions for better health. With an engagement platform of over 275K members and more than 100 million data points spanning behavioral and SDOH properties, Acclinate helps leading pharma companies and healthcare providers access, engage, and mobilize underserved communities. ### **About Acclinate Inc.** Acclinate is the catalyst for health equity. We use trust, technology, and community engagement to help the healthcare ecosystem connect with those they aim to serve. Our approach ensures innovation is inclusive, empowering communities to take actions for better health. ### **Description** We are looking for a hands\-on player\-coach to own our engineering function and continue scaling AVA into an enterprise\-grade platform. As a hands\-on player\-coach, you will lead and grow the engineering team while shipping code directly. You prioritize impact over flawless code, collaborating on customer calls to shape and deliver working software from minimal specs without waiting for extensive documentation. Balancing rapid innovation with strict healthcare compliance, you will establish a clear boundary between development speed and rigorous production releases. **What You Will Own** **Architecture \& Systems** * Own the architecture and the full\-stack systems that handle complex proprietary data, analytics pipelines, and LLM\-powered features. * Maintain and modernize our core technology stack, including GCP\-native infrastructure (Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI), containerization, CI/CD, and Ruby on Rails. * Lead in exploring the potential of a new stack to migrate and modernize the frontend/backend. * Own integrations across our data and business ecosystem, including Metabase, HubSpot, and other systems that connect product, analytics, customer, and operational data. * Think in systems. Every feature touches an external platform, a background job, a database, an API contract, a client, and a customer's report. See the whole chain, know where it breaks, and design so the break is visible before a customer sees it. **Data Confidence \& Traceability** * Be confident in the data. The platform pulls from several external platforms, runs predictive scoring models, and reports back. You need to know where every number comes from, trace a wrong metric to its source, and fix the pipeline when an upstream platform changes. * You can write the SQL that answers a customer's question and stand behind the number. You've built or run integrations that pull from third\-party APIs, normalized messy external data into your own models, and kept reporting correct when the upstream changed. **Quality \& Delivery Standards** * Own quality and delivery: small PRs, tests that prove the behavior, migrations that do not break a deploy, structured logs and traces so production tells us what happened. * Maintain strong security and compliance standards, including data security, audit trails, HIPAA compliance, and SOC 2 readiness, without introducing unnecessary development friction. * Modernize engineering processes through streamlined code reviews, automated testing, and production monitoring so teams can ship quickly and confidently. **Product \& Customer Partnership** * Carry product judgment into code. Join customer and partner calls when the work calls for it. Turn a thin spec into working software without waiting for a document that describes how buttons behave. Push back when the ask will not hold up in production. * Serve as a strategic partner to Product, Community, Marketing, Customer Success, and Commercial teams to align engineering output with business objectives \- and challenge assumptions when you see a better path. **Team Building \& Mentorship** * Manage, mentor, and work alongside the existing engineering team, fostering a culture of fast iteration and technical excellence. * Build and scale the team intentionally \- hiring engineers who excel in rapid prototyping, system architecture, and disciplined delivery. * Help onboard. As the team grows, you bring new engineers into the codebase and the customer context. **AI\-Native Development** * Work AI\-native. Drive Claude Code, Cursor, or the equivalent for most of your output. You treat AI tools as collaborators, not crutches. You know when to prompt, when to code by hand, and how to critically evaluate AI\-generated output. * Write the repo instructions, decision records, and plans that make AI agents produce correct code the first time. Structure the codebase and documentation so an AI agent can succeed. * Review agent output with the same rigor you would give a junior engineer's PR. * Actively help the team improve how it leverages AI, whether by refining workflows, sharing best practices, or identifying opportunities to build internal tooling. **What You Bring** Core Leadership \& Engineering Capability \- We're open to: * Someone with 8\+ years of traditional engineering leadership who has recently pivoted to Claude\-native thinking (proven by shipping) * Someone with 5\+ years who has already worked in AI\-native shops and knows this world cold * Someone early\-to\-mid career (3–5 years) who is so clearly exceptional at moving fast and shipping that they've outpaced peers with more time **Technical Depth** * 5\+ years building production systems, with at least one system you took from early design to customers using it. * Data Engineering \& AI: Experience with data pipelines, data security, and integrating modern AI tooling or LLM APIs into production applications. * Cloud Infrastructure: Strong cloud experience (GCP strongly preferred). Working knowledge of Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI, and CI/CD best practices. * Full\-stack capability: Operate across backend architecture, data infrastructure, APIs, integrations, and front\-end experiences. Ruby on Rails and a typed client framework preferred; strong Rails plus React with a willingness to learn Flutter also works. * Data\-model\-first thinking: You design the tables and the API before the screen, and you can explain the tradeoffs. **AI Tooling Fluency** * Daily use of AI coding agents on real codebases, and a clear view of where they fail. * You can describe how you structure a repo so an agent produces correct code, and what you check before you merge its work. * You use AI to accelerate development, explore unfamiliar codebases, and improve productivity while maintaining high standards for code quality, testing, and ownership. **Communication \& Async\-First Mindset** * Plain, direct written communication. Most of your coordination is asynchronous. You write PR descriptions, decision records, Slack updates, and strategy memos that a non\-engineer can follow. * Comfort with a small team and a real customer base. Ambiguity is normal. Shipping is expected. * Systems thinking: You reason about the whole system—data in, jobs, storage, API, client, and the person reading the result. You design for failure modes, not the happy path. **Salary and Benefits** Compensation depends on experience and includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package. At Acclinate, we offer a competitive benefits package, including health, dental, and vision insurance with 50% of premiums covered by the company. We also provide a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy alongside dedicated paid sick leave. #### **Salary** $200,000 \- $220,000 per year

jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ We’re looking for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help us scale our platform with reliability, observability, and operational excellence at the core. You’ll partner with engineers and data scientists to build, automate, and maintain the infrastructure that powers our core platform—including data pipelines, ML workloads, and real\-time analytics systems. This is a hands\-on, high\-impact role with visibility across the stack and the opportunity to shape the future of our infrastructure and operations. We're hiring onsite in Dunwoody, GA. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, build, and maintain scalable infrastructure to support real\-time analytics and machine learning workloads * Improve system reliability and performance through automation, observability, and proactive capacity planning * Own and evolve CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, rollback mechanisms,
