We specialize in designing and installing advanced automation solutions with intuitive and interactive graphical user interfaces. Job Summary: DeBra\-Kuempel is seeking to fill a **Building Automation Systems (BAS) Estimator** position in our Lexington, KY location. This position is responsible for the preparation of accurate, competitive, and profitable cost estimates for building automation systems projects. The BAS Estimator will review and interpret project plans, specifications, and customer requirements to develop comprehensive bids and proposals for new installations, retrofits, and system upgrades. This role also supports business development efforts by maintaining strong relationships with mechanical contractors, consulting engineers, developers, and strategic partners. The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge of BAS and HVAC controls systems with strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills to support project success from initial pursuit through project turnover. Essential Duties \& Responsibilities: * Review and interpret project documents, including architectural/mechanical/electrical plans, specifications, sequences of operation, RFPs, and addenda, to determine scope and requirements. * Perform detailed take\-offs for BAS components, such as controllers, sensors, actuators, valves, dampers, wiring, software, and programming hours. * Develop accurate bill of materials (BOM), labor estimates (installation, commissioning, programming, project management), subcontractor quotes, and overhead/profit margins. * Estimate costs for various project types, such as plan \& spec, design\-build, and performance contracts. * Select appropriate control system hardware/software, including Tridium Niagara, Automated Logic, Johnson Metasys, Siemens Desigo CC, and BACnet\-based building automation systems; ensure compliance with project specs and standards. * Mitigate bid risks and improve competitiveness by identifying competitive vendor pricing opportunities, value engineering opportunities, risks, exclusions, assumptions, and potential change order items. * Support the full bid lifecycle to transition projects to management teams by preparing proposals with scope narratives and pricing breakdowns, and negotiating scope, price, and value engineering requests from clients. * Facilitate continuous improvement by maintaining estimating databases, templates, and historical cost data, and following BAS industry trends, pricing changes, and emerging technologies. * Perform other duties as assigned to support the success of the role and the organization. This position can sit out of our Kennesaw, GA office. The senior manager leads program implementation, engineering evaluations, corrective actions, and long\-term strategic initiatives to ensure plant safety and regulatory compliance for ENERCON clients. The Nuclear Post\-Fire Safe Shutdown/Fire Protection Senior Manager leads a diverse team with talents that span all aspects of a successful fire protection program, including fire suppression system design, fire alarm and detection system design, fire barrier requirements, and fire hazards analysis. patterns, OpenTofu/Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines * Leadership Skills: Proven ability to coach, mentor, and influence teams beyond just writing and implementing solutions **Nice to have** * Experience with LangGraph / LangChain * Hands\-on experience with Vertex AI * Working knowledge of modern DevOps and CI/CD practices * Familiarity with GCP infrastructure resources and their constraints, with the ability to identify optimal resources for designed AI agentic solutions **We offer** * Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (Subsidized) * Health Savings Account * Flexible Spending Accounts jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Introduction: Since 1973, East West Bank has served as a pathway to success. With over 110 locations across the U.S. and Asia, we are the premier financial bridge between the East and West. Our teams of experienced, multi\-cultural professionals help guide businesses and community members on both sides of the Pacific looking to explore new markets and create new opportunities, and our sustained growth and expertise in industries like real estate, entertainment and media, private equity and venture capital, and high\-tech help build sustainable businesses and expand our associates’ potential for career advancement. Headquartered in California, East West Bank (Nasdaq: EWBC) is a top\-performing commercial bank with a strong foundation, an enterprising spirit and a commitment to absolute integrity. East West Bank gives people the confidence to reach further. Overview: East West Bank is seeking an experienced Senior AI Engineering to design, build, and operationalize enterprise\-grade AI and Generative AI solutions across the Bank. This senior technical leader will translate emerging AI capabilities into secure, scalable, production\-ready banking applications that improve operational efficiency, risk management, customer experience, and employee productivity. The role is expected to be hands\-on at the outset while helping establish foundational AI engineering capabilities, operating standards, and a small, high\-performing AI engineering team. Responsibilities: * Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI and Generative AI applications for prioritized banking use cases (e.g., customer service, fraud detection, document processing, knowledge management, and operational efficiency) * Architect LLM\-enabled solutions spanning retrieval\-augmented generation, vector search, agentic workflows, MCP, model orchestration, tool/function calling, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Build production\-grade services and APIs using Python, FastAPI or Flask, Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Databricks, ADLS, and modern cloud\-native patterns. * Integrate AI capabilities into enterprise applications, developer workflows, knowledge management platforms, automation, analytics, and decision\-support processes. * Establish engineering practices for CI/CD, testing, model evaluation, observability, performance optimization, security, and responsible AI controls. * Establish reusable AI engineering frameworks, reference architectures, code standards, deployment patterns, and governance controls to accelerate enterprise adoption. * Partner with business, data, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, legal, and vendor teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory, privacy, auditability, and operational risk expectations. * Prototype rapidly with stakeholders, convert pilots into scalable implementations, and define measurable adoption and impact metrics. * Evaluate LLM platforms for accuracy, latency, cost, security, explainability, and fit for regulated enterprise use cases. * Support hiring, mentoring, and day\-to\-day technical leadership of AI engineers and cross\-functional delivery teams. * Stay current with emerging AI technologies and advise leadership on practical opportunities, risks, and implementation tradeoffs. * Perform other duties as assigned. **AI Fluency \& Hands\-On LLM Skills*** Hands\-on experience with major LLM platforms, including OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot/Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and open\-source models such as Llama or Mistral. * Practical experience with prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, LLM orchestration frameworks, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks, and hallucination mitigation. * Ability to design AI applications that include data protection, source validation, access control, logging, monitoring, traceability, and human review where appropriate. * Strong understanding of Responsible AI, model governance, prompt\-injection risks, data privacy, and production controls for LLM\-enabled solutions. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred. * 10\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, AI engineering, platform engineering or related technology leadership roles, including experience delivering production AI solutions * Proven experience leading AI, data, automation, or emerging technology initiatives from strategy and experimentation through production delivery. * Strong hands\-on engineering background in Python, API design, microservices, cloud architecture, distributed systems, data pipelines, CI/CD, testing, observability, and secure software delivery. * Deep experience with the Azure ecosystem, including Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, Databricks, ADLS, Azure AI Search, and related enterprise integration patterns. * Experience with LLM frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, vector databases, model registries, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring/observability tools. * Strong process and data discipline, including data quality, lineage, metadata, workflow design, controls, operational risk, and measurable business outcomes. * Experience in financial services, banking, fintech, insurance, or another regulated industry with strong understanding of compliance, auditability, risk management, and governance. * Ability to lead cross\-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders, mentor engineers, and translate complex AI capabilities into practical business solutions. * Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to define AI roadmaps, operating models, standards, adoption plans, and success metrics. **Preferred Qualifications*** Master's degree in AI, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. * Experience establishing AI engineering teams, platforms, reusable delivery patterns, and enterprise AI standards. * Experience with copilots, enterprise search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation, and AI\-enabled knowledge management. * Experience driving AI vendor evaluation and selection processes within regulated environments * Familiarity with model risk management, third\-party/vendor risk, privacy impact assessments, and regulated technology delivery. * Experience with MLOps/LLMOps, AI monitoring, evaluation pipelines, model/prompt registries, and production incident management. * Track record of mentoring senior engineers and building high\-performing technical teams. Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time. Compensation: The base pay range for this position is USD $125,000\.00/Yr. \- USD $250,000\.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer – Power, Electronics & EMI/EMC
jobs.description: Job Overview: Elexana LLC is seeking a talented Electrical Engineer who wants to develop into an unusually broad, hands\-on engineering role spanning electrical power systems, electronics, electromagnetic interference, instrumentation, and field investigation. We are not looking for a senior engineer with a narrowly established specialty. We are looking for an engineer with strong fundamentals, technical curiosity, good judgment, and the ability to learn quickly. Elexana is an independent electromagnetic engineering consulting firm specializing in complex EMI/EMC investigations, electromagnetic field measurement, grounding and bonding, sensitive\-equipment environments, medical\-device interference, high\-field environments, power\-system interference, and electromagnetic design. Our work takes us into industrial facilities, power\-generation sites, laboratories, hospitals, advanced manufacturing facilities, and emerging nuclear, AI, robotics, semiconductor, and energy technologies throughout the United States. The successful candidate will work directly with Elexana's senior engineers and will be trained in specialized investigative and measurement techniques that are rarely encountered in conventional electrical engineering positions. Who We Are Looking For We are particularly interested in an early\-career engineer with exceptional technical potential. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in electrical engineering and is genuinely interested in understanding how electrical systems behave in the real world. This person should be equally curious about a high\-voltage distribution system, a VFD, a control cabinet, a circuit board, an oscilloscope waveform, a grounding problem, or an unexpected RF signal. We value practical ability as much as academic knowledge. Experience working as an electrician, electrical technician, field engineer, commissioning engineer, electronics technician, engineering intern, or in another hands\-on technical environment would be especially valuable. Candidates who have built, repaired, tested, wired, programmed, or troubleshot electrical or electronic systems outside the classroom are strongly encouraged to apply. A bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline is required. Recent graduates and engineers with several years of experience will be considered. Previous EMI/EMC experience is useful but is not required. We would rather train a talented engineer with strong electrical and electronic fundamentals than hire someone whose experience is limited to following established EMC test procedures. What You Will Learn and Do This position involves substantially more than routine testing. You will learn to investigate complex electrical and electromagnetic problems for which the cause may initially be unknown. You will work with oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, current probes, differential probes, network analyzers, electromagnetic field instrumentation, and other specialized measurement equipment. Assignments may involve high\-voltage and high\-current electrical systems, low\-voltage controls, electronic systems, power electronics, VFDs, UPS systems, motors, transformers, grounding and bonding systems, conducted and radiated interference, common\-mode currents, harmonics, transients, shielding, filtering, and sensitive electronic equipment. You will participate in field measurements, troubleshooting, engineering analysis, equipment evaluation, mitigation design, drawing review, data interpretation, and preparation of technical engineering reports. As your capability develops, you will progressively take greater responsibility for investigations and eventually be expected to conduct field assignments independently. What Matters to Us We are looking for someone who wants to understand why something is happening rather than simply follow a test procedure. Strong candidates tend to be naturally curious. They take things apart, build things, question unexpected measurements, understand that electrical systems do not always behave like ideal schematics, and enjoy solving problems that cross conventional engineering disciplines. You should be comfortable learning both high\-voltage power systems and low\-voltage electronics. You should want to become proficient with sophisticated measurement instrumentation and develop the ability to move between electrical engineering, electronics, physics, and electromagnetic compatibility. Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, technical integrity, and written communication skills are essential. You must also be comfortable working in industrial environments and traveling to client facilities throughout the United States. Some assignments may require several consecutive days at a project location. Career Development This position is intended for an engineer who wants to grow substantially. Elexana's work is specialized, and we do not expect a new engineer to arrive knowing how to perform every type of investigation we undertake. Training will occur through direct participation in real engineering assignments with experienced engineers. The objective is to develop an engineer who can ultimately evaluate unfamiliar electrical and electromagnetic problems independently, select appropriate measurement methods, understand what the instrumentation is actually showing, identify likely coupling or failure mechanisms, and develop technically defensible solutions. For the right engineer, this position offers exposure to electrical and electromagnetic problems that would be difficult to encounter in a conventional engineering career. Elexana LLC is an independent engineering consulting firm. We do not sell electrical products, receive product commissions, or perform electrical contracting work. Our role is to determine what is occurring, identify the engineering cause, and develop technically sound solutions. Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $102,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Retirement plan Work Location: Hybrid remote in Somers, NY 10589

jobs.title: Principal Security Architect
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Principal Security Architect Main Attributes **Role summary:** Security Architecture \& Engineering needs a senior architect to serve as the dedicated security architect for a major strategic program. The program is cloud\-heavy, built primarily on AWS with additional cloud platforms in scope, and its workloads handle trade secrets and highly sensitive intellectual property. This person owns the security architecture end to end and is the definitive technical voice on cloud and application security for the program. **Qualifications:** Deep security expertise across cloud, application security, identity, and integration patterns. Experience designing controls for workloads handling trade secrets or sensitive intellectual property. Background is open—building and operating secure systems, security engineering, incident response, and security architecture are all relevant paths, provided the depth supports sound judgment on real designs. **Key responsibilities:** Own the security architecture and risk posture for the assigned program; lead architecture reviews, threat modeling, and risk assessments; drive risk acceptance where residual risk remains; and develop reference architectures, design patterns, and security guidance from recurring requirements. **Collaboration:** This role works directly with program leadership, engineering teams, and partners across Security Architecture \& Engineering, Tech@Lilly, privacy, legal, and audit. What You'll Be Doing As Principal Security Architect on the Security Architecture \& Engineering team, you will be the dedicated security architect for a major strategic program built primarily on AWS, with workloads handling trade secrets and highly sensitive intellectual property. You will own its security architecture across cloud platforms, data flows, identity, and third\-party integrations, and lead architecture reviews, threat modeling, and risk assessments. You will develop reference architectures and design patterns that scale across the program, provide technical direction to engineers supporting the work, and ensure technology is deployed securely and in alignment with enterprise security standards. jobs.description: * **Location:** Remote * **Department:** Engineering * **Reports to:** Engineering Manager * **Contract:** 3\-month contract **About Us** ------------ ELSA is a global leader in AI\-powered English communication training, dedicated to transforming how people learn and speak English with confidence. Powered by proprietary speech\-recognition technology and generative AI, ELSA delivers real\-time, hyper\-personalized feedback to help learners improve pronunciation, fluency, and overall communication effectiveness. Our B2B flagship platforms, **ELSA Enterprise** and **ELSA Schools**, empower organizations and educational institutions to elevate communication capabilities and unlock personal and professional opportunities for their people. You'll work across the full product stack — from backend services and APIs to frontend experiences — while making strong product and UI/UX decisions along the way. You won't simply receive tickets and execute them. You'll work closely with stakeholders to understand the problem, shape the solution, and ship polished, production\-ready experiences. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Own the B2B Dashboard end\-to\-end.** Build and improve core experiences across the ELSA B2B Dashboard, owning both engineering execution and product quality. * **Drive full\-stack product development.** Work across **Go and Python on the backend** and **Vue on the frontend**, building reliable APIs, business logic, and user\-facing experiences. * **Make product decisions with autonomy.** Translate business and customer needs into practical product solutions. Think carefully about information architecture, interaction patterns, usability, and visual consistency. * **Work AI\-natively.** Use AI coding and development tools as a core part of your workflow to understand unfamiliar codebases, accelerate implementation, debug issues, and ship high\-quality work quickly. * **Collaborate cross\-functionally.** Work directly with product, business, design, and engineering stakeholders. Bring structure to ambiguous requirements and turn them into shipped product. **What You Will Bring** ----------------------- **This role is defined by seniority, autonomy, and product ownership.** You should be comfortable operating with incomplete requirements, making decisions independently, and taking a feature from problem definition through production. * **Strong product sense.** You think in terms of users and outcomes, not just technical requirements. You can evaluate user flows, identify usability issues, and build intuitive interfaces without needing every interaction specified for you. * **Senior full\-stack engineering capability.** You are comfortable moving between backend and frontend and can independently deliver production\-grade features across the stack. * **AI\-native mindset.** AI tooling is a core part of how you work. You use it to move faster, learn unfamiliar systems, improve code quality, and increase your development leverage. * **High autonomy.** You unblock yourself, make pragmatic trade\-offs, and take ownership of the quality of what you ship. * **Strong communication.** You can work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, clarify ambiguity, and communicate technical and product trade\-offs clearly. **Must\-Haves** --------------- * Proven experience as a **Senior Product Engineer, Senior Full\-stack Engineer, or equivalent**, with strong end\-to\-end product ownership. * Strong backend engineering experience with **Go and/or Python**. * Strong frontend engineering experience with **Vue.js** or a comparable modern frontend framework, with the ability to work effectively in an existing Vue codebase. * Strong **product and UI/UX sense**, with demonstrated ability to build intuitive and polished user experiences. * Experience turning ambiguous business or user requirements into practical product solutions. * Hands\-on, fluent use of **AI development tools** as part of your day\-to\-day engineering workflow. * Strong judgment around **code quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability**. * Ability to work independently and deliver meaningful product improvements within a **3\-month contract period**. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Flexible work setup:** Global remote arrangement. * **Competitive compensation package.** * **Collaborative, international team culture.** * **High\-impact ownership:** Opportunity to directly shape and improve a core B2B product. * **Global exposure:** Work with a distributed team and stakeholders across multiple markets. * **Startup impact:** Opportunity to contribute to a fast\-growing, well\-funded Silicon Valley startup with global impact.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Esker as a Site Reliability Engineer** Esker is a global leader in AI\-powered business solutions for the Office of the CFO. Our Source\-to\-Pay and Order\-to\-Cash platform serves 3,000\+ customers \- including NVIDIA, Whirlpool, Sony, and Trek \- supporting 1\.2M users and generating $200M\+ in annual revenue. Founded in 1985, we've grown to 1,200\+ employees worldwide with a culture focused on improving working capital, human relationships, and environmental sustainability. Esker operates in five continents with global headquarters in Lyon, France, and two U.S. locations in Madison, WI, and Denver, CO. **The Role** We’re seeking a **Site Reliability Engineer** to join our US\-based SRE team of 10 engineers, part of a global SRE organization of 35\+ professionals responsible for the reliability, scalability, and performance of our multi\-tenant SaaS platform. In this role, you’ll work hands\-on with large\-scale production systems, collaborating with experienced engineers while helping drive automation, observability, and reliability improvements across the platform. This is an exciting opportunity for someone moving from systems administration or DevOps into SRE, or for an early\-career SRE looking to deepen their expertise across a broad and modern technology stack—all while supporting a platform used by millions of users worldwide. **What You'll Do** * **Improve platform reliability and availability** by participating in our on\-call rotation, learning from real production incidents, and helping evolve our incident response and post‑incident practices * **Increase delivery speed and consistency** through infrastructure and deployment automation using Terraform, Ansible, and Azure DevOps * **Reduce time to detect and resolve issues** by building actionable monitoring, alerting, and dashboards that improve visibility into system health and performance * **Enable scalable growth** by designing and operating infrastructure that supports a rapidly expanding global customer base across Azure and on‑premises environments * **Empower engineering and support teams** by delivering self\-service tools, automation, and guardrails that allow safe and efficient production operations * **Strengthen a culture of reliability and continuous improvement** through agile collaboration, knowledge sharing, blameless postmortems, and cross‑team initiatives **Our Technology** You'll work in a hybrid cloud environment with infrastructure spanning Azure and on\-premises data centers. Our stack includes Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Kafka, Redis, and modern observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Automation is central to how we work: Terraform and Ansible for infrastructure, Azure DevOps for CI/CD. **What We're Looking For** * **3\+ years in a Site Reliability, DevOps or a related role supporting production systems** * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience operating and maintaining **Linux** systems in live production environments (Windows server experience is a plus) * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field preferred (equivalent experience considered) * Practical experience with **Infrastructure as Code** tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, Puppet, or similar * A solid foundation in **networking concepts**, including TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, and proxying * Experience working with **relational and/or NoSQL databases** in production environments * **Scripting proficiency** in one or more languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell **Schedule \& On\-Call** This is a hybrid role requiring at least two days onsite in Middleton, WI per week. The team primarily works standard business hours (Monday–Friday), with flexibility to support collaboration and focused work. The role includes participation in a **rotating, well‑balanced on‑call schedule** designed to be sustainable and predictable. On‑call responsibilities are **compensated**, including additional pay and per‑incident compensation, and are supported by strong documentation, escalation paths, and a collaborative team approach. On‑call coverage consists of: * One evening approximately every two weeks (5–9pm CT) * One weekend approximately every 6–8 weeks (Friday 5pm – Sunday 7pm CT) **Why Join Us** * Gain experience across a diverse, modern tech stack with mentorship from a global team * Clear career development path with promotion opportunities and access to roles across Esker * Work on systems at meaningful scale supporting major enterprise customers * Collaborative agile environment with emphasis on knowledge sharing and psychological safety **Salary Range**: $95,000\-119,000 \+ on call pay **Employee Benefits** * Student loan repayment assistance * Flexible work schedule, summer hours, and work from home options * Profit sharing options * Paid time off for community outreach and volunteer opportunities * Yearly stipend for employee wellness, hobbies, or educational activities * Dog\-friendly work environment * Competitive salary and benefits package **Come as You Are** Esker is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to maintaining an inclusive and mutually respectful work environment. jobs.title: Process Engineer/ AEROSPACE PLATING & MACHINED PARTS
jobs.description: ### **POSITION SUMMARY** Our client is seeking an experienced **Process Engineer** with mandatory aerospace experience and direct knowledge of plating, chemical\-processing operations, and precision machined parts. This individual will provide hands\-on technical ownership of special processes, translate customer and industry specifications into robust production methods, improve first\-pass yield and process capability, and develop controlled routings, technique sheets, and standard work that reduce dependence on tribal knowledge. ### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Provide technical process ownership for aerospace hard chrome, cadmium, electroless nickel, and related chemical\-processing operations; support passivation, chem\-film, cleaning, masking, baking, blasting, and associated inspection requirements as applicable. * Review customer drawings, purchase orders, and governing specifications and translate requirements into controlled master routings, technique sheets, work instructions, and process parameters. * Develop robust processing methods for precision machined components, including masking, racking, current\-density/rectifier considerations, plating thickness, dimensional buildup, runout, post\-plate machining/grinding interfaces, and protection of critical features. * Work directly with machinists, platers, maskers, Quality, NDT, Planning, and Operations to resolve technical issues and ensure manufacturable, repeatable process sequences. * Lead root\-cause investigations for adhesion failures, thickness variation, burns, pitting, roughness, contamination, dimensional nonconformance, salt\-spray failures, hydrogen\-embrittlement concerns, and other plating defects. * Analyze tank chemistry, operating parameters, agitation, filtration, rectification, anode condition, racking, and process controls to improve first\-pass yield and process stability. * Support qualification, validation, periodic testing, and customer/Nadcap audit readiness; ensure technical documentation remains aligned with current specification revisions. * Create and maintain process control plans, PFMEAs, capability studies, validation plans, engineering trials, and structured improvement actions where appropriate. * Evaluate new customer work for technical feasibility, process risk, tooling/racking needs, capacity, and special requirements before production release. * Support Estimating with accurate process assumptions, cycle times, masking complexity, tooling needs, and technical risk for new RFQs. * Develop fixtures, racks, masking concepts, and process improvements that increase throughput while protecting part quality and dimensional requirements. * Lead technology transfer and operator training so critical process knowledge is documented, standardized, and repeatable across technicians and shifts. * Support capital\-equipment and facility improvement projects involving tanks, rectifiers, filtration, agitation, ovens, process controls, and other plating infrastructure. ### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS — MUST HAVE** * Aerospace manufacturing experience is mandatory; candidates without direct aerospace experience will not be considered. * Minimum 5 years of process/manufacturing engineering experience supporting metal finishing, electroplating, chemical processing, or closely related aerospace special processes. * Hands\-on experience with plating facilities and precision machined parts, including understanding of dimensional tolerances, surface condition, masking, plating buildup, and post\-process requirements. * Working knowledge of aerospace specifications and customer\-controlled processing requirements; experience interpreting engineering drawings and specifications. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot plating defects using structured root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions. * Experience developing routings, technique sheets, work instructions, process parameters, and other controlled manufacturing documentation. * Strong understanding of process control, chemistry/parameter discipline, validation, measurement systems, and data analysis. * Ability to work effectively on the shop floor with technicians while communicating technical issues clearly to customers, Quality, and leadership. ### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Materials, Mechanical, Manufacturing, or related Engineering discipline. * Experience with hard chrome and cadmium plating of aerospace landing\-gear, actuator, hydraulic, fastener, or other precision machined components. * Nadcap Chemical Processing experience and familiarity with AS9100 quality systems. * Lean Six Sigma, DOE, SPC, or PFMEA experience. * Experience with plating line equipment, including rectifiers, agitation, filtration, tank controls, and process monitoring. ### **KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** * First\-Pass Yield and Defect Reduction * Process Capability / Parameter Compliance * Reduction in Rework and Scrap * Technique Sheet / Master Routing Completion and Accuracy * Corrective Action Effectiveness * New Process / New Product Qualification Success * Cycle\-Time and Throughput Improvement * Audit and Specification Compliance ### **TECHNICAL PROFILE** A practical, shop\-floor engineer who can translate aerospace specifications, machined\-part requirements, and plating knowledge into controlled, repeatable processes that reduce tribal knowledge and improve scalability.

Across the company, people who aren’t engineers (we call them Builders) are already using AI and AI\-assisted coding tools to get internal apps and prototypes most of the way there on their own. This role focuses on closing the last mile: making that work secure, scalable, tested, observable, and maintainable so it can reach production. The ideal candidate is a strong engineer who is also a patient enabler, someone who multiplies other people’s output by unblocking, reviewing, and hardening their work rather than taking it over. This position will report to **VP, Architecture and AI Technologies** **What you will do:** * Design and lead training for our Builder Program * Advise Builders on architecture and tooling early, so they start a use case on a sound foundation instead of refactoring later. * Give Builders a technical safety net as they build: answer questions, unblock, and steer decisions without taking the work over. * Review, harden, and deploy Builder\-created apps, covering secure auth and secrets handling, data governance, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation. * Define the production path and a clear support model for each app, including who owns it after launch, so you don’t become the default permanent owner of everything. * Build reusable templates, starter kits, and guardrails that turn one good solution into a pattern everyone can reuse. * A few times a quarter, take on complex, cross\-functional, or strategic builds end\-to\-end: scope, architect, build, and ship them tested, documented, and packaged as reusable templates. * Make Builders measurably more self\-sufficient over time, so each new build is faster and safer than the last. * Partner with engineering, security, and data teams when builds need deeper review, and raise the bar on production standards across the company. **What you can bring:** * 5 of professional software development experience, at a senior or staff level of judgment and ownership. * Deep, hands\-on experience across the full path to production: architecture, secure auth and secrets handling, data modeling and governance, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation. * Experience building AI applications, including LLM APIs, prompt engineering, agents, RAG, and evals/testing, with sound judgment about where AI fits and where it doesn’t. * Comfort across a modern, fast\-moving stack such as Next.js and Vercel, Supabase and Postgres, GitHub, and automation tools like Zapier, Make, n8n, or Retool. These tools are illustrative; the ability to learn and reason across a stack matters more than any specific one. * Proven ability to teach, unblock, and review the work of non\-engineers patiently and pragmatically, raising the quality bar without seizing the keyboard. * Pragmatism about production standards: you know which corners can be cut for an internal prototype and which absolutely cannot. * Experience building internal platforms, developer enablement, or “paved road” tooling a plus. * Ideal candidate brings foundational AI literacy, including experience using generative AI tools, and a proactive mindset to experiment with new technologies to drive productivity and innovation. * Background in technical coaching, mentorship, or enabling low\-code/citizen developers a plus. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted frontend tools such as v0, and with edge/serverless patterns, a plus. **Where We Are:** * This role will be based in our El Segundo Headquarters **Compensation \& Total Rewards:** At Fabletics we believe work and life should fit together! We continue to build a culture of flexibility, to empower you to do your best and put yourself first. Our Total Rewards program rewards employees for their hard work, supporting their health, well\-being, families, and ultimately their life journey. Total Rewards at Fabletics includes: * Hybrid Work Schedule\* * Discretionary Paid Time Off\* * Summer Fridays\* * Healthcare Plans * Employee Discounts * 401k * Annual Bonus Program * Equity Program\* * And More * Varied for retail, fulfillment and fully remote roles. Offered base salary will be dependent on factors including the scope and complexity of the role, candidate’s related work experience, subject matter expertise and work location. \#LI\-LS1 \#LI\-Fabletics \#LI\-Onsite **Security Alert: Protect yourself from scams** At Fabletics, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Fabletics emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Teams or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit\-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means. Fabletics, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, employ, compensate, develop, and promote regardless of race, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable. At Fabletics, Inc., we champion a vibrant workplace culture that thrives on diversity law and do not tolerate discrimination or harassment. jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Description: Fervo Energy is applying first\-principles engineering and a manufacturing mindset to geothermal power, an industry that has operated the same way for decades. Rather than deploying one\-off energy projects, we are building standardized, repeatable GeoBlocks designed to get cheaper, faster, and more reliable with every iteration. Fervo deploys an Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC) power plant to convert heat to electricity. At the heart of the power plant is heat transfer and fluid handling equipment, including the air\-cooled condenser, shell\-and\-tube heat exchangers, feed pumps, pressure vessels, and the piping and cabling that connect them. That equipment is the biggest driver of the power plant construction cost, footprint, and thermal performance, which makes it the place where designing a product instead of a project pays off the most. The Engineering Manager owns the ORC equipment and plant layout: everything in the power cycle except the turbine and generator. That means the air\-cooled condenser, heat exchangers, pumps, piping, cabling layout, and associated low\-voltage equipment. You own design, cost, and schedule for that scope from preliminary design through startup, on every project in every basin Fervo builds in. You lead a cross\-functional team of process, mechanical, electrical, and structural/civil engineers and are accountable for schedule, budget, cost forecasting, quality of work, and the performance of the OEMs and suppliers who build the equipment. You will work every day with the electrical, controls, turbine and pipeline teams, as well as with Supply Chain, Construction, and Operations. We are looking for an engineer who knows thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid systems cold, has led and grown a team of engineers before, and has shipped real hardware in a manufacturing or hardware business. This role reports to the Director of Engineering. Requirements: ***Responsibilities*** * Own budget, schedule, and technical execution for the ORC equipment and layout scope, including air\-cooled condenser, heat exchangers, recuperators, feed pumps, piping, cabling layout, and associated low\-voltage equipment, across all projects and basins * Take responsibility from preliminary design through detailed engineering, analysis, procurement, fabrication, construction, commissioning, and startup, and hand it over to Operations * Own the plant layout and 3D model: where the equipment sits, how the pipe and cable are routed, and whether people can build it, reach it, and maintain it. * Support the whole group's design reviews and disseminate higher level requirements to the group to help them determine their individual equipment and system requirements * Own how our OEMs perform on your equipment: evaluate technical bids, own the specifications and datasheets, review vendor drawings, run factory acceptance tests and inspection plans. Supply Chain owns the commercial side; you own the technical side, and you work as one team * Make the heat exchange train cheaper and better with every version using thermal analysis, process simulation, and performance data * Hire, mentor and lead a team of engineers while holding a high technical bar, driving individual ownership and ensuring everyone understands the priorities/goals of the company * Help build out processes and strategy that will allow for an order of magnitude scaling in both speed and number of deployed units. This encompasses technical infrastructure, communication practices and technical capability. ***Qualifications*** *Required* * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, or another engineering discipline * 6\+ years of professional engineering experience designing, building, and delivering hardware in a manufacturing, energy, aerospace, automotive, or heavy industrial environment * Experience directly managing an engineering team, including hiring, performance management, and technical mentorship * Experience owning a piece of equipment or a system from concept and design through analysis, procurement, build, test, and startup or production release * Track record of high performance in a fast\-paced, fast\-scaling, or manufacturing\-mode environment * A highly collaborative approach and dedication to continuous improvement * Willingness to travel to project sites and OEM facilities as needed, including time in the field during construction, commissioning, and startup *Preferred* * Proficiency in 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Inventor, NX, Creo or similar) or plant design tools (AutoCAD Plant 3D, SmartPlant, Revit or similar) * Strong thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid dynamics background applied to heat exchangers, air\-cooled condensers, pumps, and ORC, steam, or refrigeration cycles * Experience with thermal and process analysis tools such as HTRI, Aspen HYSYS or CFD * Working knowledge of the codes and standards this equipment is built to including ASME B31\.1/B31\.3 piping and ASME Section VIII pressure vessels, API 610/660/661and NFPA * Experience managing OEMs and suppliers, including technical bid evaluation, vendor drawing review, factory acceptance testing (FAT), and inspection and test plans (ITPs) * Piping design, pipe stress analysis, pipe support, and plant layout experience * Experience running design reviews, change control, and standardizing or modularizing a product that used to be built one at a time * Hands\-on commissioning and startup experience with rotating equipment, heat exchangers, or process piping systems * Power generation, geothermal, renewable energy, oil and gas, or chemical process facilities background * Experience working with EPC contractors and managing multiple projects simultaneously * Excellent written and verbal communication skills ***WHO THRIVES AT FERVO*** * We screen for attributes as much as experience. The people who do best here share a few things in common: * First\-principles thinkers who question industry norms and trace problems back to physics and economics * Individuals who have an extreme ownership mindset and a bias for speed and iteration * Simplifiers who cut complexity relentlessly * Collaborators who see engineering and the business as inseparable * Individuals who are mission\-driven and motivated to push the larger goals of the company forward

jobs.title: VP, Territory Sales
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. ### **Impact in this Role** The Vice President, Territory Sales leads the national territory field sales organization — six frontline sales directors, each leading six to eight field account executives, for a combined organization of roughly 50 — with full ownership of the territory revenue plan and the mandate to sell the entire solution offering across Custom, Configurable, and Standard components. This is a P\&L\-minded operator role charged with raising the ceiling of a proven, revenue\-producing organization: elevating frontline sales management, instilling disciplined account planning and pipeline rigor, and shifting the conversation from part numbers and price to productivity, uptime, and total cost of ownership. You will report to the Chief Revenue Officer. ### **What You’ll Be Doing** **Revenue Ownership \& Operating Rigor** * Own the territory field sales revenue number — forecast accuracy, pipeline coverage, and quota attainment across all six director teams. * Install a consistent operating cadence: territory reviews, account plans, pipeline inspection, and win/loss discipline. * Manage to a P\&L mindset — balance growth investment, seller productivity, and gross profit against the plan. **Full\-Solution, Value\-Based Selling** * Lead the shift from transactional, catalog\-led selling to value\-based, consultative selling across the full field organization. * Drive the team to sell the entire solution offering — Custom, Configurable, and Standard components — rather than defaulting to the historical standard\-catalog motion. * Drive adoption of the MEDDPICC\-based discovery and qualification framework in partnership with VP, Sales Acceleration. * Reorient territory coverage, account tiering, and time allocation toward expansion of the installed base. **Frontline Leadership Development** * Lead and develop six frontline sales directors through coaching standards, talent upgrades, and clear performance management. * Own hiring to plan for the field organization within the November 30, 2026 leadership hiring milestone and beyond. * Build a repeatable talent engine that develops the company's next generation of sales leaders. **One Selling Organization \& Coverage Partnership** * Model and reinforce the unified MISUMI Americas identity — one team, one customer experience — across legacy organizational lines. * Partner with VP, Emerging Accounts to extend coverage across the territory and coordinate account development and hand\-offs. * Coordinate with the enterprise organization on territory\-to\-named\-account transitions, carrying the integration standard through the April 1, 2027 go\-live and beyond. ### **Desired Traits and Qualifications** **Required** * Has led a multi\-region B2B field sales organization with full revenue ownership — with a demonstrated record of growing the book, not maintaining it. * Proven multi\-layer leadership: has led leaders of leaders (sales directors and their seller teams), not just individual contributors. * Has operated through significant organizational scaling or transformation, and can speak concretely to what had to change in coverage, management discipline, and selling motion. * Direct experience shifting a transactional or catalog\-driven sales motion toward consultative, full\-solution, value\-based selling, with specific measurable outcomes. * Operating rigor: CRM discipline, pipeline analytics, territory design, and structured qualification methodologies (MEDDPICC or equivalent). * Change leadership under integration conditions — able to unify teams across legacy organizational lines. * High say:do ratio — moves fast, holds commitments, and builds organizations that operate the same way. **Strongly Preferred** * 15\+ years of B2B sales leadership in industrial manufacturing, factory automation components, industrial distribution, or adjacent technical product sectors. * Has personally led a book of business of $250M or more. * Career experience inside a company that scaled through and beyond $1B in revenue. * Has led a field sales organization of comparable scale — roughly 50 sellers across multiple frontline management layers. * Experience selling a multi\-product solution (custom, configurable, and standard, or equivalent breadth) rather than a single\-line catalog. * Deep fluency in the catalog motion, the MRO and plant\-floor buyer, and the specific behaviors being transformed. * Experience applying AI tools to seller productivity, territory planning, or account prioritization. **Leadership Character** * A sales manager's sales manager — energized by developing frontline leaders and being in the field, not managing from the tower. * Direct, honest, and accountable; communicates with clarity and takes challenges well. **Travel** Ability to travel approximately 50% annually, national, in\-territory and field\-facing, for director ride\-alongs, key account visits, sales kickoff (SKO), quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and integration milestones. **Physical Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Standard office and home\-office work environment with extensive computer, phone, and video\-conference use. Ability to travel by air and drive within assigned territory, including navigating customer plant floors and manufacturing environments during field visits. ### **Perks and Benefits** * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401K plan * Parental leave programs * Paid volunteer days * And much, much more! **Salary: $340,000 to $420,000 OTE** **Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.** We’re actively seeking teammates who: * Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company. * Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team. * Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth. * Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins. * Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Industrial Systems Data Platform (ISDP)
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid We made history and now we work to transform the future – for our customers, our communities and our families. You'll see your work on the road every day, helping people move freely and pursue their dreams. At Ford, you can build more than vehicles. Come build what matters. **Enterprise Technology** plays a critical part in shaping the future of mobility. If you’re looking for the chance to leverage advanced technology to redefine the transportation landscape, enhance the customer experience and improve people’s lives, this is the opportunity for you. Join us and challenge your IT expertise and analytical skills to help create vehicles that are as smart as you are. Ford's Industrial Systems Data Platform (ISDP) unifies data from **Product Development, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain** applications into a single logical data model. We are building an **AI\-queryable knowledge graph** over that data — a BigQuery property graph derived from a canonical domain event store — and an **MCP (Model Context Protocol) server** that lets **agents** reason over it. We're looking for an **AI Engineer** to own this system end to end: design, develop, test, and **deploy the graph layer to Production on a Google Cloud Platform–native stack**, and build the agent\-facing serving layer on top of it. You will turn raw industrial event data into a governed, traversable graph that powers Ford's next generation of engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply\-chain agents. **Domain you'll master** Ford's Industrial Systems and the ISDP logical data model — how Product Development, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain applications describe programs, parts, ECUs, sites/plants, suppliers/organizations, requirements, verifications, quality problems, and warranty/returns — and how those entities interconnect in the knowledge graph. **Graph Layer** * Design, develop, test, and deploy the ISDP knowledge graph from the domain event store to Production using cloud\-native data pipelines. * Model and evolve the graph's entities and relationships as new data sources are onboarded. **MCP serving layer** * Design, build, and operate the **MCP server** that exposes the ISDP graph layer and event store as tools to consumers — including GQL graph query, event\-store query, and schema/DDL discovery. * Define tool contracts, context, and guardrails so agents produce grounded, accurate, non\-hallucinated responses over the graph. * Ensure low\-latency, secure, and cost\-efficient serving for interactive and batch agent workloads. **Reliability, monitoring \& observability** * Own **monitoring and observability** of the graph layer and the MCP server — data freshness, pipeline health, query latency/cost, tool\-call success rates, and answer quality. * Instrument SLOs, dashboards, alerting, and tracing; drive incident response and continuous reliability improvements. **Collaboration \& data onboarding** * Partner with **Data Engineers** and **Application Data Source Owners** across Product Development, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain to **ingest and validate their data into ISDP**. * Establish data contracts, schema validation, and quality checks; support source owners through onboarding, mapping to the ISDP logical model, and troubleshooting. * Contribute to data governance, cataloging, and lineage for the graph and its sources. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering or equivalent combination of education \& experience * 5\+ years of experience with Strong software engineering in **Java**, **Python**, with production\-grade testing, CI/CD, and code quality practices. * 3\+ years of experience with Hands\-on experience deploying data/AI systems to Production on a **GCP\-native stack**: **Vertex AI,****BigQuery**, **Dataflow / Apache Beam**, **Pub/Sub**, **Cloud Run / GKE**, **Cloud Storage**, and **Cloud Build / Artifact Registry**. * 3\+ years of experience with **graph data modeling** and querying — property graphs and **GQL / graph query patterns** (BigQuery property graphs, or equivalent such as Neo4j/Spanner Graph). * 3\+ years of Hands\-on experience with **Vertex AI** (Agents, model serving, embeddings) and evaluation of agent answer quality. * 2\+ years of Experience building **LLM/agent** systems: tool\-use, RAG/grounding, and integrating models via APIs (e.g., Vertex AI or enterprise LLM gateways). Familiarity with **MCP** or comparable agent tool protocols. * **Observability** expertise: Cloud Monitoring/Logging, OpenTelemetry, SLOs, dashboards, and alerting for data pipelines and services. * 3\+ years of experience with **Infrastructure as Code** (Terraform) and secure\-by\-default engineering (IAM, least privilege, secrets management). * Ability to work directly with data producers to model and validate real\-world **industrial/enterprise data**. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Familiarity with **Dataplex / Data Catalog** for governance, lineage, and business glossaries. * Streaming/CDC and event\-driven architectures; append\-only/event\-sourced data modeling. * Design and build user\-facing applications and dashboards that surface Knowledge Graph data to end users. * Domain exposure to **PLM / product development, manufacturing execution, quality, or supply\-chain** systems and their data. * Data quality frameworks, schema evolution, and blue\-green/zero\-downtime data deployments. You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! As an established global company, we offer the benefit of choice. You can choose what your Ford future will look like: will your story span the globe, or keep you close to home? Will your career be a deep dive into what you love, or a series of new teams and new skills? Will you be a leader, a changemaker, a technical expert, a culture builder…or all of the above? No matter what you choose, we offer a work life that works for you, including: * Immediate medical, dental, vision and prescription drug coverage * Flexible family care days, paid parental leave, new parent ramp\-up programs, subsidized back\-up childcare and more * Family building benefits including adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility treatments, and more * Vehicle discount program for employees and family members and management leases * Tuition assistance * Established and active employee resource groups * Paid time off for individual and team community service * A generous schedule of paid holidays, including the week between Christmas and New Year’s Day * Paid time off and the option to purchase additional vacation time. This position is a range of salary grades 7\-8 and ranges from $99,600\-$192,900\. **Final determination of salary grade will be based on candidate's skills and experience, and base salary will be set within the applicable range according to job scope, responsibility and competitive market value.** For more information on salary and benefits, click here: https://fordcareers.co/GSR **Visa sponsorship is available for this position.** **Domestic relocation is not available for this position.** Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please call 1\-888\-336\-0660\. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer II
jobs.description: ### **Description** Are you ready to be a part of a dynamic team where your passion meets purpose, and every day is an opportunity to make a difference in our global communities in providing access to water, fuel and electricity? **We are seeking a dedicated Manufacturing Engineer. In this role, you will be responsible for conceptualizing, designing, developing, improving, and implementing manufacturing processes. The engineer will provide technical leadership to shop operations and maintenance to improve departmental performance.** Franklin Electric is a diverse team of innovators making a positive global impact since 1944\. We offer innovative water solutions, ensuring access, treatment, and efficient management of this vital resource. Our commitment to excellence is reflected in our innovative products, industry leading quality products, exceptional customer service, employee development, and passion for social responsibility. Join us to create a better future while growing professionally in a supportive environment!### **What You Will Be Doing:** * Troubleshoot and correct production problems. * Analyze scrap and defect reports to focus areas of improvement. * Improve workflow and efficiency. * Design new and revise existing production fixtures. * Support manufacturing by introducing new products and repairing and maintaining existing parts. * Create and maintain process instructions and train employees with changes to instructions. Design new test equipment. Define, specify, quote, order, approve, implement, and debug new production equipment. Perform any other related duties as required or assigned. ### **What You Need:** **Education \& Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field (required) * Experience designing and developing tooling, products, and manufacturing processes (preferred). * Minimum three years relevant experience (required) **Skills/Abilities*** Ability to effectively communicate information and respond to questions in person\-to\-person and small group situations with customers, clients, general public and other employees of the organization. * Ability to maintain confidentiality and use discretion with business information. * Ability to read and understand documents such as policy manuals, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. * Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. * Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane, algebra, solid geometry, and trigonometry. * Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of known variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram formats. Ability to plan the time, method, manner, and/or performance sequence of own work; may also occasionally assist in planning work assignments performed by others within a limited area of operation. * Ability to frequently make decisions of both minor and major importance, which may affect the work operations of other employees and/or clientele to a moderate degree. * Ability to complete tasks using structured practices or policies and directed as to execution and review. Interpolation of learned things in moderately varied situations where reasoning and decision\-making are essential. * Regular use of complex machines and equipment; specialized or advanced software programs. **Software Skills Required*** **Intermediate:** CAD, Excel * **Basic:** Word processing, Database ### **Why Work at Franklin Electric?** Becoming a part of the Franklin Electric team not only provides outstanding benefits, it also opens doors to opportunities for future growth. Enjoy peace of mind with a world\-class company. But more importantly, be satisfied in knowing you make a difference. FE provides many opportunities to learn and grow through development opportunities such as training, certifications, mentorship, leadership programs, tuition reimbursement, one\-on\-one coaching and more! We offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and amenities such as:* Generous paid time off \& holidays * Paid parental leave \& on\-site motherhood rooms * 401(k) with matching \& service contributions * Health, dental, vision, life insurance * Short \& long\-term disability * Fertility \& adoption support * Undergraduate \& graduate tuition reimbursement * Professional development assistance * Health \& wellness programs ### **About Franklin Electric** Franklin Electric is a global leader in water and energy systems, committed to continuous improvement and innovation to meet the diverse needs of our customers. Our founders in 1944 named the company after America’s pioneer electrical engineer, Benjamin Franklin, which lives on today in our culture to drive us to push boundaries and create meaningful change. We offer a comprehensive range of pumps, motors, drives, and controls for residential, commercial, agricultural, industrial, and municipal applications. More than just a workplace, Franklin Electric is a vibrant and inclusive community of forward\-thinkers, united by our mission to drive positive impact worldwide. Our culture fosters career growth and personal development, with a focus on promoting from within and nurturing talent. Our recent awards in “America's Most Responsible Companies”, “Most Trusted Companies” by Newsweek, “America’s Climate Leaders” and “Indiana’s Best Places to Work” attest, we're dedicated to upholding the highest standards of corporate responsibility. At Franklin Electric, we believe that everyone deserves to be treated fairly and respectfully, and that our diversity of thought, culture and experience makes us a stronger company. Our commitment to social responsibility is evident in programs like the Franklin Women's Network and our philanthropic efforts through the Franklin Wells for the World Foundation. Through these endeavors, we've provided clean water to over 284,000 people in 12 countries, addressing the global water crisis head\-on, Locally in our communities, the Franklin Electric Charitable and Educational Foundation (FECEF) supports causes close to our hearts, such as United Way, Boys \& Girls Club, and Big Brothers Big Sisters. Our dedication to excellence extends beyond our products and services, shaping a brighter future for both our employees and the communities we serve. Join us in driving meaningful change and making a difference with Franklin Electric.

jobs.title: Junior AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Friedman Real Estate is looking for a Junior AI Solutions Engineer to join their team in Farmington Hills, MI. You will help design, build, and deploy AI solutions for our brokerage, property management, accounting, and construction teams. This is a hands\-on role with exposure to senior leadership and a defined growth path. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, data science, AI, or a related field. * 1–3 years of relevant experience; internships and substantial academic or personal projects will be considered. * A portfolio or examples of AI solutions you have built. * Demonstrated knowledge of Python and JavaScript. * Working knowledge of APIs, data pipelines, and system integration. * Familiarity with the Microsoft ecosystem (Azure, Power Platform, Copilot) and with LLM tools such as Claude. * Understanding of data quality, privacy, cybersecurity, and governance principles. * Ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical staff. * Sound judgment and a realistic understanding of the capabilities and limitations of AI. Nice to have: Power BI, Azure Machine Learning, or Microsoft Fabric experience. **What You'll Do** * Build AI workflows, integrations, and reusable components based on business requirements from brokerage, property management, accounting, and construction. * Work within our technology platform: Claude, Microsoft 365 / Copilot, Azure, Power Platform, Power BI, and Yardi. * Support testing, deployment, monitoring, and tuning of solutions in production. * Maintain data pipelines and system integrations; monitor data quality and model performance. * Work within our security, data governance, and compliance standards (Entra ID, Purview, Intune, Defender). * Develop onboarding materials, user guides, and documentation to support adoption. * Gather user feedback after deployment and implement improvements. **Why Join Us** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits * Medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and 401(k) * 3\+ weeks PTO and 10 paid holidays * Continuing education reimbursement * Referral bonuses and recognition programs **About Friedman Real Estate** Friedman Real Estate is one of the Midwest's largest commercial real estate providers, with integrated brokerage, property management, construction, and mortgage banking practices. We manage millions of square feet of commercial space and thousands of multifamily units. We are building enterprise AI capability in\-house on a governed Microsoft and Anthropic platform, and this role will support that effort. Friedman Real Estate is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Data Product Manager - Analytics & AI

In Data, Digital and Analytics, you will work as a trusted, objective advisor and expert, recommending critical decisions and actions to be taken with credibility and a focus on driving measurable impact. You will be part of a thriving culture built on collaboration and innovation. **The Opportunity** As a **Senior Data Product Manager \- Analytics \& AI**, you will drive the development, execution, and optimization of strategic data products across the organization, with a primary focus on forecasting data products and AI context and strategy support. Reporting directly to the Director AI \& Digital Data Products, you will operate as a fully autonomous product leader—defining the product vision, leading cross\-functional execution, and ensuring alignment with enterprise\-wide objectives. You will elevate our data and AI capabilities by championing advanced forecasting frameworks, mentoring agile squads, and delivering scalable, high\-impact data solutions that drive measurable business value. **Key Responsibilities** * **Forecasting \& AI Strategy \& Vision:** Develop and communicate a clear, value\-driven vision for forecasting data products and AI integration aligned with Genentech’s broader organizational objectives. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. * 3 years of experience in designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting large\-scale distributed systems. 2 years of experience leading projects and providing technical leadership. * ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering. **About the job** ----------------- Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is what you get when you treat operations as if it’s a software problem. Our mission is to progress, protect, and provide for the software and systems behind all of Google’s public services \- Search, Ads, Gmail, Android, YouTube, and AppEngine, to name just a few \- with an ever\-watchful eye on their availability, latency, performance, and capacity. This is an unusual job, unlike others in the industry. Like traditional operations groups, we keep important, revenue\-critical systems up and running despite hurricanes, bandwidth outages, and configuration problems. Unlike traditional operations groups, we also have full access to and authority to fix, extend, and scale the code to keep it working and harden it against all the vagaries of the Internet. We hire people from both systems and software backgrounds. Strong candidates will have experience with both. Just as what we do is unique, where we do it is unique too. At Google, we have the good fortune to have developed many interesting systems ranging from planet\-spanning databases to near real\-time scalable data warehousing to fault\-tolerant datastream joining. In SRE, we flip between the fine\-grained detail of disk driver I/O scheduling to the big picture of continental\-level service capacity, across a range of systems and a user population measured in billions. We own those products in production. We drive reliability and performance across massive scale by mastering the full depth of the stack. We literally do learn something new every day \- usually surprising things \- that have the potential to transform the lives of billions of our users around the world. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $174000 \- $252000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design, through to deployment, operation and refinement. * Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews. * Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health. * Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity. * Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally\-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever\-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large\-scale system design.
