jobs.title: Growth Account Executive II
jobs.description: **About Guru** AI is everywhere at work now, but it's only as good as the knowledge behind it. When that knowledge is scattered, outdated, or ungoverned, AI gives confident, wrong answers, and that's a real problem for companies trusting it with sensitive information. Guru fixes that at the foundation: we structure your company's knowledge, govern and continuously improve it, and power every AI and human workflow from one trusted source, with permissions and citations built in. We're a Series C venture\-backed company, built lean and AI\-native on purpose. That means less bureaucracy and more room for you to make a real impact, fast. We believe in cultivating a welcoming, inclusive culture that encourages personal growth through hard work and enjoying the journey along the way. Launched in September 2015, our vision is backed by an incredible group of investors, including FirstMark Capital, Salesforce, Michael Dell, the Slack Fund, Emergence Capital, Thrive Capital, and Accel. As we enter our next stage of growth, we're looking for passionate people to join us. This is a full\-time position that can beperformed **\[Remotely and/or out of our Philadelphia]** office. Re\-location and/or Visa Sponsorship is not included in our hiring package. Applicants will need to be authorized to work in the US and residing in a state where Guru is a registered employer. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All are welcome here. At Guru, being inclusive is very important to us. Regardless of race, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identification, or background. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at **talent@getguru.com** to request accommodation. **The Opportunity** Guru is looking for a Growth Account Executive II to own a high\-volume book of growth accounts, and run it with speed and precision. This role is built for someone who thrives on process and cadence rather than bespoke, high\-touch relationship management. You'll manage a larger portfolio of accounts through a repeatable renewal and expansion motion, and stay organized enough to keep pace as that portfolio shifts under you. This isn't a role for someone chasing a handful of marquee logos. It's for someone who wants to prove they can scale a book, run a system that works across volume, and build a track record that opens the door to strategic accounts down the line. **Why the Role Matters?** Every enterprise AI initiative runs into the same wall: the knowledge underneath it is fragmented, outdated, and ungoverned, so the AI hallucinates, employees stop trusting it, and their investments stall. As a Growth Account Executive II, you're the one making sure a wide swath of Guru's customer base keeps realizing that value, renewal after renewal. The volume you manage well becomes the proof that our motion scales. The patterns you see across dozens of accounts, what renews cleanly, what needs intervention, what expands on its own, shape how we run this playbook.**What Makes You the Perfect Fit** ---------------------------------- This role is a fit if you've carried quota in a high\-volume book and you're energized by the discipline that it takes, not by chasing the single biggest deal in the room. You run a tight system: your CRM is always current, you know which accounts need attention before they become a problem, and you don't let volume become an excuse for things slipping through the cracks. **You've proven you can perform in a high\-volume book*** You bring 4\+ years of quota\-carrying SaaS sales experience * You can run dozens of accounts in parallel without losing track of where each one stands * You're comfortable with a lighter\-touch, higher\-frequency cadence rather than long, bespoke sales cycles **You treat process and organization as your edge*** You default to playbooks and repeatable motions over one\-off approaches * You're process\-driven and excited to help build the playbook that this team runs on, not just execute someone else's * You keep your pipeline, forecast, and account notes clean and current as a matter of habit, not an afterthought * You spot renewal risk early through usage signals and outreach cadence, and you act on it before it becomes a save **You make the system around you better*** You flag what's working and what isn't in the renewals motion so the playbook keeps improving * You partner well with Customer Solutions Engineers and marketing to keep expansion moving without needing every touch to come from you **Bonus*** Experience selling through AWS Marketplace or other cloud marketplaces **What You'll Actually Do** --------------------------- **Own a high\-volume, tiered growth book:** Manage renewals and expansion across a large portfolio of accounts, prioritizing daily and weekly based on renewal date, usage signal, and risk. **Field scaled account maintenance:** Handle ad\-hoc commercial and subscription questions with urgency, and proactively manage a shared understanding of account health across your book so nothing at\-risk goes unnoticed. **Run sales motions that drive expansion:** Leverage product and customer data, usage patterns, growth rates, and account signals to identify, hunt, and close expansion opportunities, and develop new champions to expand usage within new teams and departments. **Run a scalable renewal motion:** Execute a consistent, repeatable renewal cadence across your full book, completing dozens of renewals per month, using standard playbooks rather than building custom strategies account by account. **Spot and act on expansion signal:** Identify accounts where usage data points to expansion, and run a lightweight, efficient motion to capture it without slowing down the rest of your book. **Keep the system honest:** Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records in Salesforce across your entire book, pipeline, forecast, activity, and account context, so leadership can trust the numbers at volume. **Qualifications** * 4\+ years of quota\-carrying SaaS sales experience * Proven ability to manage a large volume of accounts simultaneously with strong organizational systems * Proficiency in Salesforce CRM * Familiarity with enterprise SaaS platforms and renewal/expansion motions * BS/BA degree or equivalent professional experience **Nice\-to\-Have:** * Experience selling through AWS Marketplace or other cloud marketplace channels * Background in knowledge management, AI\-powered SaaS, or enterprise productivity tools * Experience with tools like Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, or Pylon The base salary compensation range for the position outlined is $111,300\-$149,600, depending on location. This role reports to the Director of Sales and is classified as IC3\. We believe in reasonable accommodations and are committed to enabling qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions successfully. **Benefits to you** * Competitive salary * Employee Incentive Stock Option Plan * Generous medical benefits package * Tax\-advantaged accounts * 401k * Unlimited Flexible Time Off * Paid Parental, Family \& Medical Leave * Wellness Stipend * Tuition Stipend * Guru\-sponsored company \& team events, no matter where you work * Thrive After Five: in recognition of our long\-tenured employees, Guru celebrates your five year anniversary with a $10,000 personal travel reimbursement * Again at Ten: in recognition of our long\-tenured employees, Guru celebrates your ten year anniversary with a $20,000 personal travel reimbursement

jobs.title: eCommerce Implementation Specialist (Remote)
jobs.description: Description: **We are HALO!** We connect people and brands to create unforgettable, meaningful, and lasting experiences that build brand engagement and loyalty for our over 60,000 clients globally. With over 2000 employees, 1,100 Account Executives and 40\+ sales offices across the United States, HALO is the global leader of our $25B industry. HALO is looking for an **eCommerce Implementation Specialist** who thrives in a fast\-paced environment to build and launch websites using our enterprise ecommerce platform. You own the build from kickoff through go\-live, turning client requirements and brand direction into a polished, fully functional website. You equally manage building, problem solving, and partnering with clients. Success in this role means understanding how a website is built. You will work with UI/UX design, responsiveness, and platform configuration, so proficiency with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is important. You're exceptionally skilled, resourceful, and accountable, which allows you to support several websites builds in parallel. Above all, you take full ownership of what you do. You're someone who takes responsibility for a project and will consistently deliver quality work on time with minimal direction. You use the resources and people around to solve problems, escalate early, and launch successful projects. **Responsibilities:** * Own the end\-to\-end build of eCommerce websites, from project kickoff through launch, translating requirements and brand direction into a complete, fully functional storefront. * Design and build responsive storefronts across desktop and mobile, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to configure layout, navigation, content, and the overall user experience. * Configure and validate core store functionality, including product catalog, search, cart and checkout, customer flows, custom domains, analytics, SEO, and third\-party integrations. * Troubleshoot build and functionality issues within the platform, using available documentation, tools, and internal resources to resolve them efficiently. * Recognize when work falls outside platform capabilities and requires a developer or SME, and escalate early with clear, complete context to keep timelines on track. * Review and validate requirements before building, identifying gaps, risks, and dependencies up front and asking the right questions to confirm the approach. * Accountable for the build timeline, workload, keeping status, progress, risks, and blockers visible to the project team for all webstore work including external development and integration teams. * Perform quality assurance on your own work throughout the build and support formal testing, identifying and resolving issues before client review and launch. * High confidence as the technical point of contact in client conversations, demonstrating the website, explaining functionality in clear terms, and answering build and design questions. * Document your work and deliver a clean handoff at launch to the teams that support the store after go\-live. * Other duties as assigned. Requirements: * 4\+ years of experience building, configuring, or implementing eCommerce websites, or web applications. * Hands\-on experience with UI/UX design, front\-end development, configuring online stores or websites on a robust enterprise, SaaS, or custom ecommerce platform. * Working proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with the ability to read, write, and troubleshoot front\-end code. * A strong eye for design and the ability to translate brand direction into clean, responsive, on\-brand storefronts across devices. * Proven ability to independently own a project from start to finish, stay organized, and deliver on deadline with minimal direction. * Resourceful problem\-solving skills, with sound judgment on when to solve an issue independently and when to escalate for support. * Familiarity with eCommerce and B2B integration concepts such as single sign\-on (SSO), punchout and procurement integrations, APIs, and data feeds is a plus. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in client\-facing conversations and the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * Highly detail oriented and organized, with the ability to manage multiple builds and deadlines with a high level of accuracy. * Strong work ethic with the ability to work independently under minimal supervision and collaboratively within a cross\-functional team. * Ability to work well under pressure, meet deadlines, work overtime or off\-hours when required. **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in information technology, communications, business, or a related field required **Compensation**: The estimated salary range for this position is between $50,000 \- $80,000 annually. Please note that this pay range serves as a general guideline and reflects a broad spectrum of labor markets across the US. While it is uncommon for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the ra and have the application prefill with your information. There are 5 sections to complete in total, including General information, Work History, Education, Compliance, and optional demographic questions. Once you have successfully submitted your application, you will receive a submission confirmation email from our system. **Application Deadline**: Applications are reviewed and processed only when there is a specific need or opportunity, rather than on a fixed schedule or at a set deadline. Because they are reviewed on an as\-needed basis, a job posting will be removed once the position has been filled or is no longer available. **More about HALO** * At HALO, we unleash the energy of our client's brands and amplify their stories to capture the attention of those who matter most. For that reason, more than 60,000 small\- and mid\-sized businesses work with HALO and have made us the global leader of the branded merchandise industry. * Career Advancement: At HALO, we love promoting from within. Internal promotions have been the key to our exponential growth in the last few years. With so many industry leaders at HALO, you'll have the opportunity to accelerate your career by learning from their experience, insights, and skills and gain access to HALO's influential global network, leadership experiences, and diverse thinking. * Culture: We love working here and know that you will too. You can expect a positive culture of ingenuity, inclusion, and relentless determination. We push the limits of possibilities and imagination by staying curious, humble, and provocative in order to break through yesterday's limit. Diversity is the source of our creativity and we thrive when each of us contributes to an inclusive culture of respect, dignity, and equity mindset in everything we do. We keep our promise for excellence with an unrelenting commitment to achieving results and supporting one another to stay accountable, transparent, and dependable. * Recognition: You're going to succeed here, and you can count on us to celebrate your wins. Colleagues across the company will join in recognizing your big milestones and nominate you for awards. Over time, you'll earn so much recognition that you can convert into gift cards, trips, concerts, and merchandise at your favorite brands. * Flexibility: We pride ourselves on flexible schedules that help you find a balance between professional and personal demands. We believe that supporting our customers is the priority and trust that you and your manager will find a schedule to achieve that priority. HALO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We insist on an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Inclusion is a core value at HALO and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people. HALO participates in E\-Verify. Please see the following notices in English and Spanish for important information: E\-Verify Participation and Right to Work. HALO is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process – including the online application and/or overall selection process – you may email us at hr@halo.com. Please do not use this as an alternative method for general inquiries or status on applications as you will not receive a response. Reasonable requests will be reviewed and responded to on a case\-by\-case basis.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco, CA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $220K – $300K *For cash compensation, we set standard ranges for all U.S.\-based roles based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including geographic location as well as candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.* **About Handshake** ------------------- Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions. In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month. **Why join Handshake now:** * Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel * Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions * Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders * Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue **About Handshake AI** Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data\-intensive post\-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3\-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale. **About the Role** ------------------ As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Handshake AI Enterprise, you'll embed directly inside enterprise customer environments as part of a small, expert team. You'll learn each customer's business deeply — their workflows, their bottlenecks, where the real leverage is — and translate that understanding into production\-grade AI agents that measurably change how they operate. This isn't an implementation or consulting role. You'll own the full stack: defining the solution, building and deploying agents, designing evals, and iterating until performance actually moves. Over time, you'll become a genuine domain expert in your customer's vertical — and use that expertise to build AI that keeps getting better. If you've built AI that works in the real world and want to do it again at much higher stakes — with better data, closer lab relationships, and a founding team that moves fast — this is the role. * Embed directly with enterprise customers as part of a small deployment team, developing deep understanding of their business and workflows * Define AI\-driven solutions based on real business needs — not theoretical use cases * Build and deploy production\-grade agents tailored to specific customer use cases, owning end\-to\-end delivery * Design and run evals to measure agent performance; iterate and hill\-climb until results move * Become a domain expert in your customer's vertical and use that expertise to build better AI over time * Work closely with Product and Platform engineers on your team to ship cohesive, reliable solutions * Establish engineering best practices, agent patterns, and reusable frameworks that help the forward\-deployed team scale output without sacrificing quality * Surface insights from deployments that inform Handshake's platform and product roadmap **Location:** San Francisco, CA \| 5 days / week in\-office **Desired Capabilities** ------------------------ * 5\-6\+ years of engineering experience, full\-stack with strong backend depth * Real\-world experience building and shipping AI applications in production — not just fine\-tuning or prototyping * Strong understanding of agent architectures, evals, and how to measure and systematically improve AI performance * Comfort working directly with enterprise customers in ambiguous, high\-stakes environments * Strong systems thinking — you can zoom out to the business problem and zoom in to the technical solution without losing either thread * High ownership mentality — you care about outcomes, not just outputs * Strong communication skills — you'll be in the room with senior stakeholders regularly and need to earn their trust quickly **Extra Credit** ---------------- * Background at a company with a forward deployment or field engineering model * Experience building multi\-agent systems in production * Domain expertise in a specific enterprise vertical (recruiting, finance, ops, legal, etc.) * Familiarity with enterprise security requirements, VPC deployments, or on\-prem configurations * History of building evals infrastructure or AI quality measurement tooling **Perks** ========= Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported—and thrive at work and in life. ***The below benefits are for full\-time US employees.*** **Ownership:** Equity in a fast\-growing company **Financial Wellness**: 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching **Family Support:** Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching **Wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, $500 wellness stipend **Growth:** $2,000 learning stipend, ongoing development **Remote \& Office:** Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office **Time Off:** Flexible PTO, 15 holidays \+ 2 flex days **Connection:** Team outings \& referral bonuses Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at joinhandshake.com/careers. Compensation Range: $220K \- $300K

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who can hit the ground running. You will be a core builder of our data infrastructure, owning end\-to\-end pipelines, shaping our Microsoft Fabric environment, and leading API integration work as we scale. This role is ideal for someone who can take a rough requirement, ask the right clarifying question, and ship both accurately and quickly. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, managing your own time, surfacing blockers early, and delivering production\-quality work with minimal oversight. **JOB TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** **Data Pipeline Development** * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines within Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Power BI datasets). * Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all pipeline outputs. * Proactively identify performance bottlenecks, data quality issues, and architectural improvements. **API Integration** * Lead and execute API integrations with payer systems, EHR platforms, clearinghouses, and internal tools as we expand our connectivity footprint. **Stakeholder Collaboration** * Translate business and operational requirements from stakeholders into clean, well\-documented technical solutions. * Collaborate with program management, product, and operations teams to surface the right data at the right time. * Document work clearly so the team can build on it. * Manage own workload, prioritize effectively, and communicate progress and blockers without being prompted. **SKILL SET** **Required Skills and Competencies** * Strong proficiency in SQL and Python. * Strong grasp of data modeling, ETL/ELT design patterns, and data warehouse concepts. * Ability to work from high\-level requirements and independently drive solutions to completion. * Self\-directed: manages own queue, asks smart questions, and doesn’t wait to be told what to do next. * Excellent communication skills — able to explain technical decisions to non\-technical stakeholders clearly and concisely. * Experience with cloud\-based data platforms, modern data warehouse technologies, and Medallion architecture. * Experience with complex DAX language and ability to simplify joins and/or migrate into semantic models. * Experience with data orchestration, automation, and CI/CD practices. * Experience supporting enterprise analytics and business intelligence initiatives. * Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance best practices. * Ability to mentor data engineers to produce high\-quality work that is both precise and quick to deliver. * Ability to translate business requirements into technical requirements and envision the final product. **Nice to Have** * Experience in healthcare, RCM, or a similarly regulated, data\-intensive industry. * Familiarity with HL7/FHIR standards or payer/clearinghouse API ecosystems. * Exposure to Agile or Scrum workflows. * Comfort working in a high\-growth, startup\-adjacent environment where priorities can shift quickly. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Required** * 6\+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong proficiency in SQL and Python. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or a demonstrable ability to ramp quickly (Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Power BI Premium experience strongly considered). * Proven experience building and maintaining REST API integrations in a production environment. * A track record of delivering accurate, production\-quality work under real timelines. **Preferred** * Relevant cloud, database, or data engineering certifications. * Experience in healthcare, RCM, or a similarly regulated, data\-intensive industry. **BENEFITS** * 100% remote first company to foster flexibility, inclusivity, and autonomy. * Competitive salary and performance\-based increases. * Comprehensive health insurance plans. * Retirement savings plan (401(k)) with employer matching. * Responsible PTO and holidays. * Professional development opportunities. * Collaborative and supportive work environment. * Recognized as a Great Place to Work by our employees.

With our trusted brands like Persil®, ‘all®, Loctite®, Snuggle®, and Schwarzkopf® and our cutting\-edge technologies, you’ll have countless opportunities to explore new paths and grow. This position is with our Adhesive Technologies business unit – where we empower our people to transform industries and provide our customers with a competitive advantage through adhesives, sealants and functional coatings. **Dare to learn new skills, advance in your career and make an impact at Henkel.** #### **What you´ll do** #### **Henkel Adhesives is seeking a customer\-facing Field Application Engineer to support our Tissue \& Towel business. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Creative Lead
jobs.description: **Why work at Higgsfield AI?** Higgsfield AI is the fastest\-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M\+ users worldwide, 6M\+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI\-powered video creation and next\-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high\-impact team shaping the future of AI\-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like. **About the role:** We’re looking for a **Forward Deployed Creative Lead** to sit at the intersection of generative AI, cinematic production, and enterprise customers. You’ll turn customer briefs into exceptional demos and pilots, build production\-ready AI workflows, and work directly with creative teams to bring Higgsfield into real\-world production. The creative bar is extremely high. You understand why a shot works — from lensing, lighting, and composition to camera movement, pacing, and edit rhythm — and know how to reliably achieve commercial\-quality results with generative models. **What you'll do:** * Own the technical and creative execution of enterprise demos, pilots, and deployments from brief through final delivery. * Direct and produce cinematic AI content, including shot design, generation, consistency, editing, and delivery. * Build repeatable production workflows using generative models, prompting systems, APIs, MCP, automation, and agentic workflows. * Reverse\-engineer reference ads, film looks, and visual styles into reproducible Higgsfield workflows. * Lead live demos, workshops, and hands\-on training for customer creative teams. * Partner directly with CMOs, creative directors, production leaders, and technical stakeholders. * Bring customer insights, product gaps, and emerging use cases back to Product, Engineering, and Research. * Stay at the forefront of image and video generation and continuously push what’s possible with Higgsfield. **Requirements:** * Exceptional portfolio of cinematic AI work at commercial quality — portfolio first. * 5\+ years of experience in film, advertising, commercial, or creative production, including 2\+ years hands\-on with generative AI. * Deep fluency across image and video models, consistency techniques, VFX, motion, and AI production workflows. * Strong cinematic fundamentals across shot design, lighting, composition, storyboarding, camera movement, and editing. * Experience delivering customer\-facing pilots, PoCs, or productions from brief through final output. * Comfortable presenting to executives and running live demos. * Ability to translate complex AI workflows for non\-technical creative teams. * High agency, strong ownership, and the ability to move quickly in a startup environment. * Excellent communication skills. **Compensation \& Benefits:** * We offer a competitive and thoughtfully structured compensation package designed to align with impact, experience, and long\-term growth. * **Base Salary:** The anticipated salary range for this role is **$125,000 \- $200,000**, depending on experience, skills, scope, and location. * **Bonus:** This role is Bonus eligible and may participate in the Company's discretionary annual bonus program. * **Equity:** In addition to cash compensation, employees are eligible to participate in the company’s stock option program and share in Higgsfield AI’s long\-term growth. * **Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employees professionally and personally, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a competitive 401(k) retirement plan with company matching, and additional benefits and perks. * The opportunity to work on ambitious AI products alongside a highly experienced, fast\-moving, and international team. * Significant ownership, direct impact, and opportunities for professional growth as the company scales. This is required to be based in **Los Angeles** for team meetings, planning sessions, company events, and other in\-person collaboration. Team members are expected to be available during agreed working hours and maintain sufficient overlap with the relevant team’s time zone. While we work remotely, we value active communication, responsiveness, and close collaboration across teams. *Higgsfield AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.* Compensation Range: $125K \- $200K

jobs.description: **WHO IS HILLIS\-CARNES?** Hillis\-Carnes Engineering Associates (HCEA) is a multi\-disciplined ENR Top 500 engineering firm with 20 offices in the mid\-Atlantic and Florida. We have demonstrated a history of success for the past 35 years. We are 100% employee\-owned ESOP, and our history of success can be attributed to our motivational employee owners. Duties may include but are not limited to; general geotechnical engineering practice including the preparation of geotechnical reports/calculation, technical support of field staff, review of construction inspection daily field reports, and occasional project site field visits related to the projects you are involved in. This position is currently listed as non\-managerial but depending on the qualifications of the applicant could be re\-categorized as a Managing Principal. **Requirements** * Local to Lehigh Valley region or willing to relocate * Bachelor and/or Master of Science in Civil Engineering, Geological Engineering, or similar ABET accredited Engineering degree * 12\+ years of progressive experience in the geotechnical engineering consulting industry. * Professional Engineering (P.E.) license in Pennsylvania or the ability to obtain such license through reciprocity within 3 months of hire date. * Willingness and ability to mentor junior staff. **Preferred Qualifications**. * Local Pennsylvania market experience including local industry relationships. * Familiarity with geotechnical software (i.e., tablogs/Tablabs, L\-Pile, SLIDE, Settle 3D, MSEW, etc.). * Strong oral and written communication skills. * Strong business development skills and experience. * Ability to interpret engineering and construction plans/specifications. * Experience with senior review of geotechnical reports prepared by staff engineers. We are a proudly an employee\-owned company and we believe our employees should have the best benefits! Hillis\-Carnes' benefits package which includes paid holidays, generous paid time off, medical (with Health Savings Account options), dental, vision, long\-term and short\-term disability, 401k plan with a company match, Employee Stock Ownership Plan (that means you have ownership in the company upon eligibility), employee assistance plan, company events, wellness program, employee self\-service site, and much more. jobs.description: **Location:** (HTA) NCP (Hillsboro, OR) **Job ID:** R0144180 **Date Posted:** 2026\-09\-16 **Company Name:** HITACHI HIGH\-TECH AMERICA, INC. **Profession (Job Category):** IT, Telecom \& Internet **Job Schedule:** Full time **Remote:** No **Job Description:** **POSITION:** **AI Data \& Security Governance Engineer** **DIVISION:** Metrology and Analysis Systems Division (MAD) **COMPANY:** Hitachi High\-Tech America, Inc. (“HTA”) **LOCATION:** Hillsboro, OR **TRAVEL:** Up to 25% (domestically and internationally) **REMOTE WORK:** Hybrid (\+50% Onsite) – Onsite 60% / Remote 40% **EXPECTED PAY RANGE:** $134,476 \- $184,905 annually *This pay range is for the position’s base pay only. This position may be eligible for other compensation including incentive pay and/or allowances. Candidates will receive additional information during the interview and selection process.* **POSITION SUMMARY** As an AI Data \& Security Governance Engineer (AIE) at HTA, you will build the technical guardrails that allow our distributed engineering and data science teams to innovate safely. Instead of just writing policies, the AIE will implement ‘governance as code.’ The AIE will design and deploy automated security controls, manage data access infrastructure, and integrate model evaluation and security checks directly into our CI/CD pipelines. The AIE will work closely with HTA divisions to ensure that our data storage, LLM deployments, and application architecture remain secure, compliant, and highly performant. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Data Security, Access \& Infrastructure Security** * Automated Access Controls: Design, implement, and maintain granular Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and identity management across our cloud infrastructure and internal tools * Data Protection Pipelines: Build automated data masking, anonymization, and encryption mechanisms into data ingestion and processing pipelines * Infrastructure Security: Secure distributed storage solutions and ensure secure configurations across compute instances and databases * Cloud IAM hardening, secret management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), and zero\-trust data access patterns * Secure vector database architecture (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone, pgvector) with tenant isolation and metadata\-level filtering **AI/MLSecOps \& Guardrail Implementation** * Generative AI Security: Engineer and deploy technical safeguards for large language models (e.g., Llama or similar architecture), including input/output filtering to prevent prompt injection and data leakage * CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated security scanning, fairness/bias testing, and model performance evaluations directly into standard CI/CD deployment manuals * Model Monitoring: Build telemetry and alerting systems to track model drift, anomalous API usage, and compliance adherence in real\-time **Data Governance Infrastructure** * Metadata \& Lineage: Develop automated processes to extract and catalog metadata, ensuring end\-to\-end data lineage is tracked programmatically * Audit Automation: Build automated reporting scripts and dashboards to provide continuous visibility into data access logs and model compliance for security audits * Other duties as assigned **EDUCATION, LICENSES, and/or CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS** * Master’s degree in Computer Security, AI Engineering/Governance, Software Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education and experience **EXPERIENCE and TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS** **Technical Experience** * Minimum of five (5\) years of software, data, or security engineering experience * Minimum of five (5\) years of experience of programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Bash, Go, or similar languages used in data and infrastructure engineering * Minimum of five (5\) years of experience with AI/ML Ops deploying and securing machine learning models (including generative AI/LLMs) in production environments * Minimum of five (5\) years of experience with DevOps \& Automation CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows (e.g., monorepo architecture), and infrastructure\-as\-code tools * Minimum of five (5\) years of experience in Governance platforms such as Collibra, Immuta, Privacera etc. * Minimum of five (5\) years of experience with frameworks and audits such as NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, OWASP LLM Top 10 **Domain Expertise** * Minimum of one (1\) year of hands\-on experience implementing AI guardrails and moderation pipelines (e.g., NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, Guardrails AI) * Minimum of one (1\) year of experience in AI red teaming, adversarial robustness testing, and hallucination/bias monitoring * Deep understanding of data security principles (encryption, IAM, secure network architecture) * Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed storage architecture * Knowledge of AI vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs) and mitigation strategies **Preferred Qualifications** * Minimum of five (5\) years of experience working with distributed teams across multiple geographic regions * Familiarity with compliance frameworks (GDPR, CCPA) and translating them into technical requirement * 25% travel (international and domestic) **SKILLS and ABILITIES REQUIREMENTS / SAFETY REQUIREMENTS** * Ability to work under pressure and with aggressive release timelines * Ability to work in a challenging, small team environment (less than 10 members) * Ability to prioritize and multitask between multiple responsibilities * Must have strong problem\-solving skills * Demonstrate strong work ethics * Demonstrate strong verbal and written communication skills with people at all levels within the organization and outside of the company * Ability to quickly transport from location to location (i.e., air, car, etc.) * Must comply with all corporate safety requirements and directives * Expected to use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when required * Follow all equipment\-specific safety protocols ***Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE)*** *Hitachi High\-Tech America, Inc. is an equal opportunity* *employer. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Holland America Line has been exploring the world since 1873\. Our ships offer innovative features and enriching experiences focused on destination exploration and personalized travel, inviting guests to savor the journey. The Senior Engineer, DevOps is responsible for driving the company's DevOps and platform engineering implementation, transforming infrastructure and application delivery from manual, one\-off processes into automated, repeatable, and scalable practices. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on engineer with deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and immutable infrastructure patterns. This role sits within the Cloud and DevOps Platforms function in Infrastructure and Operations and leads a small team (3\-5 FTEs and/or contract resources) that builds the automation, tooling, and standards supporting the company's commercial, business, and fleet application environments, including automated provisioning on the virtualization and container platform and its native Kubernetes capabilities. The platform team builds and maintains the paved road that application teams drive on: it owns CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure such as code, cloud automation, deployment tooling, and the standards and guardrails application teams build on top of. Application teams retain ownership of application code and application\-level production support, and a managed services partner operates the platform against defined standards. The Senior Engineer champions DevSecOps and shift\-left practices, embedding security and compliance validation into automated pipelines, and fosters shared ownership across development, operations, and security teams in place of siloed, manually maintained systems. This role will be challenged with competing priorities and deadlines and will be required to ensure all recommendations are in compliance with corporate policies and procedures, all while living out the company's culture essentials. Here’s a summary of what Holland America Line is looking for. Is this you? **Responsibilities:** * Designs, builds, and implements the target DevOps operating model. Delivers Infrastructure as Code and automated provisioning so environments are version\-controlled, repeatable, and disposable, and establishes centralized secrets management, configuration management standards, and policy\-as\-code guardrails for security, cost, and compliance. Replaces manual “ClickOps” processes and one\-off solutions with standardized deployment pipelines, golden\-path reference templates, and defined lifecycle management, including upgrade paths, version tracking, and integration into the broader delivery ecosystem. Partners with business owners, IT product managers/business analysts, and infrastructure teams to scope and prioritize automation work. * Leads and manages a small team (3\-5 FTEs and/or contract resources) responsible for DevOps and platform engineering. Leadership of the team includes setting clear expectations, offering constructive feedback, and nurturing professional growth, including building team skills in Linux, containers, automation, and IaC tooling. Monitoring team performance, resolving conflicts, and fostering cross\-departmental collaboration are crucial for aligning project priorities with organizational goals. Promotes continuous improvement and a shared\-responsibility culture between development and operations to drive successful project execution. * Builds and operates CI/CD pipelines and platform automation to provide premium service to our customers. Automates provisioning, deployment, and scaling on the virtualization and container platform, including software\-defined networking, load balancing, and the native Kubernetes/container stack. Establishes monitoring, alerting, and performance optimization frameworks, including SLO/SLI\-based reliability measurement and self\-healing and high\-availability patterns, and produces the consistent, structured operational data that AIOps and AI\-driven insights depend on. Performs proof\-of\-concepts for new business and technical use cases and serves as the L3 escalation point for platform and infrastructure issues, working with internal engineers and the managed services partner to permanently resolve integration and performance issues. * Implements DevSecOps and shift\-left practices: integrates security and compliance checks early in the development lifecycle and automates continuous validation of security policies within delivery pipelines. Defines security policies and compliance measures in partnership with the Global Security team. Develops comprehensive error handling, disaster recovery, and high\-availability strategies within a robust security and compliance framework. Represents DevOps on internal Architectural Review Boards and participates in code, configuration, and design reviews to ensure alignment with architectural and security standards. * Documents automation, pipelines, and platform pro  identifying root causes rather than applying manual fixes, and productive collaboration with others to deliver automated, repeatable solutions to a wide range of problems. * Impact: This role makes decisions to help ensure daily activities proceed smoothly and directly advances the company's infrastructure modernization strategy, reducing technical debt, operational overhead, and security risk. Decisions have short term consequences and long\-term value. * Leadership: This role leads a team of 3\-5 FTEs and/or contract resources. **Essential/Minimal Qualifications:** * Minimum Experience (if preferred but not required, list as such): * Minimum of 5 years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability, or infrastructure automation roles * Prior experience leading or mentoring a small technical team is preferred but not required **Essential Experience Required:** * Minimum 5 years in a corporate technology environment * Demonstrated hands\-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code in production environments * Strong Linux and container/Kubernetes experience * Experience with public cloud platforms; Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) experience highly desirable * Experience with VMware platforms and their container/Kubernetes capabilities highly desirable * Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and automated compliance/security validation * Strong focus on Operational Excellence * Experience defining standards for and working alongside a managed services partner highly desirable * 5\+ years in the cruise line or hospitality industry is highly desirable Travel: No or very little travel likely Work Conditions: Work primarily in a climate\-controlled environment with minimal safety/health hazard potential. Physical Demands:. Must be able to remain in a stationary position at a desk and/or computer for extended periods of time. This position is classified as “Hybrid.” As a Hybrid role, it requires employees to work from a designated Holland office Monday through Thursday each week. Employees may work from their homes on Fridays. Holland provides comprehensive and innovative benefits to meet your needs, including: **What You Can Expect** * Cruise and Travel Privileges for You and Your Family * Health Benefits * 401(k) * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Training \& Professional Development * Tuition \& Professional Certification Reimbursement * Base ***Salary*** Range: $124,600 to $168,200\. The range is applicable for the labor market where the role is intended to be hired. jobs.title: 2nd Shift Operations Supervisor
jobs.description: **2****nd** **Shift Operations Supervisor** **POSITION SUMMARY** The Operations Supervisor is a key frontline leader responsible for overseeing production on their assigned shift, ensuring safe, efficient, and high\-quality operations. This role plays a critical part in executing the company's performance management operating model, which includes tiered performance reviews and action meetings, and drives continuous improvement across the platform. The Operations Supervisor directly manages hourly production staff on their shift and serves as the main point of contact between the line team and production floor, fostering collaboration with Manufacturing Process Owners, Maintenance, Manufacturing Engineers, Quality Leads, and other cross\-functional team members. Success in this role requires leading by example, taking pride in one’s work, and consistently demonstrating The Hudsonville Way through teamwork, a positive attitude, and a strong work ethic. **WORK SCHEDULE \& AVAILABILITY** The Operations Supervisor is expected to maintain regular and predictable attendance. This position is assigned to a designated shift and requires flexibility to adjust work schedules as needed to support business demands, staffing needs, and operational priorities. Additional hours, weekends, and schedule adjustments may be required to ensure effective leadership coverage and operational success. **DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** **Safety, Quality, and Compliance** * Champion a safety\-first approach, enforcing compliance with safety protocols, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and participating in our Observation\-Based Safety program. * Maintain rigorous standards of quality and food safety by enforcing compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs). * Conduct routine safety and quality audits on the production floor, collaborating with Manufacturing Process Owners and Quality teams to identify and resolve issues promptly. **Shift Leadership and Team Management** * Lead, motivate, and develop a team of hourly production team members, setting clear expectations and providing ongoing coaching to achieve daily and shift\-level targets modeling our core values. * Drive team accountability and performance by facilitating daily tiered meetings, reviewing key performance metrics, and executing action plans. * Provide day\-to\-day direction, problem\-solving support, and feedback to team members, promoting a culture of ownership and continuous improvement. * Perform tactical duties: Resource planning (people scheduling, time off requests, payroll), end\-of\-shift reporting. **Production Management and Execution** * Oversee the day\-to\-day operations of assigned production lines, ensuring that production schedules are met while minimizing downtime and maximizing equipment efficiency, escalating when appropriate. * Collaborate with the Manufacturing Process Owner to monitor and adjust centerlines, optimize throughput, and drive compliance with operational standards. * Support execution of line trials, product changeovers, and other production activities, ensuring smooth transitions and minimal disruptions. **Performance Management and Continuous Improvement** * Participate actively in the performance management operating model, leading shift\-specific reviews and contributing to tiered performance meetings at various levels. * Utilize Lean and Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) tools to identify process bottlenecks, eliminate waste, and implement sustainable improvements. * Partners with cross\-functional teams to analyze data, identify root causes of performance gaps, and develop action plans to enhance safety, quality, delivery, and cost (SQDC) outcomes. **People Development and Training** * Foster an inclusive work environment where team members are empowered, valued, and motivated to contribute to the organization’s success – know your people and build into your team through consistent team and one\-on\-one connections. * Develop team members' technical skills through hands\-on training (OIFs \& HOD, coaching, and formal development plans (IDPs), ensuring high levels of competence and flexibility across shifts. * Collaborate with the Manufacturing Process Owners and Operations Manager to create and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and ensure consistent training and adherence across the team. **Communication and Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Serve as the main communication bridge between shift teams and cross\-functional resources, ensuring alignment on shift objectives, production priorities, and key issues. * Facilitate effective communication across all levels, including escalation of critical issues to line leadership and active participation in shift handovers. * Work closely with the Maintenance Manager and Manufacturing Engineer to ensure equipment readiness, minimize downtime, and support ongoing maintenance activities. **Operational Excellence a k to drive process enhancements. **Additional Responsibilities** * Perform other duties, responsibilities, and assignments as required to support business operations. **DISCLAIMER** The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this role. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required. Team members may be required to perform duties outside of their usual responsibilities as needed, and management reserves the right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time. **QUALIFICATIONS** **Education and Experience:** * High School diploma required. Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred. * 1\-3 years of relevant experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in food production or CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods) industries. * Previous supervisory experience with a proven track record of leading teams to achieve safety, quality, and operational excellence. **Skills and Competencies:** * Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, coach, and develop high\-performing teams. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization. * Sound problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities, particularly in dynamic and fast\-paced environments. * Knowledge of Lean manufacturing principles, continuous improvement methodologies, and performance management practices. * Technical aptitude and familiarity with manufacturing equipment and production processes including GMPs, HACCP, \& SQF. * Demonstrates The Hudsonville Way through teamwork, a positive attitude, and a strong work ethic. * Commitment to workplace safety through adherence to established standards, procedures, and best practices. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** * **Mobility:** Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the manufacturing facility, including frequent movement between production lines, workstations, and support areas. Ability to remain on the production floor for the majority of the shift while supervising operations, conducting observations, coaching team members, and responding to production issues. Occasional sitting is required for administrative tasks, meetings, and computer work. * **Manual Dexterity:** Ability to use hands and fingers to operate computers, tablets, handheld devices, production controls, and standard office equipment. Ability to write, complete documentation, and manipulate small objects as needed. * **Physical Strength:** Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, and/or pull up to 50 pounds. May occasionally move production materials, tools, supplies, or equipment. * V**ision:** Visual acuity for reading detailed documents, viewing screens, labels, instrumentation, and analyzing data. This includes close, distance, color, peripheral, and depth vision, with or without correction. * **Hearing and Communication:** Ability to communicate effectively in a manufacturing environment with elevated noise levels, using hearing protection when required. Must be able to hear alarms, equipment signals, and verbal communications, with or without reasonable accommodation. * **Safety Equipment:** Ability to wear all required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hearing protection, hairnets, beard nets, gloves, appropriate footwear, and any other required food safety or safety equipment. **WORK ENVIRONMENT** This role is based in a manufacturing facility and requires the ability to work safely around active industrial equipment, with varying temperatures and elevated noise levels. Team members must be able to work in cool conditions (typically 35°F–45°F) and in wet environments, including areas where strobe or flashing lights may be present. Some work areas may also have strong magnetic fields that could interfere with certain implanted medical devices.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Frontend UI
jobs.description: Hume AI is looking for a product\-minded frontend engineer to help build the interfaces through which developers, enterprises, and consumers interact with Hume’s voice AI platform. Join us in the heart of New York City and contribute to our endeavor to ensure that AI is guided by human values, the most pivotal challenge (and opportunity) of the 21st century. **About Us** ------------ Hume AI is a Series B startup dedicated to building artificial intelligence that is directly optimized for human well\-being. You will work primarily in TypeScript, React, and Next.js, collaborating closely with backend engineers, product managers, designers, and research teams. This is a product\-oriented role focused on frontend architecture, performance, usability, and engineering quality. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy and own features from design and implementation through testing, rollout, and production support. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, and maintain production web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js. * Build intuitive interfaces for Hume’s voice AI products, developer platform, and enterprise tooling, thoughtfully surfacing real\-time model behavior, system state, and other AI\-specific interactions. * Develop reusable frontend components and shared engineering patterns. * Integrate frontend applications with APIs, WebSockets, and real\-time services. * Build and maintain automated frontend tests. * Diagnose and improve frontend reliability, performance, and usability. * Collaborate closely with product and design to ship polished user experiences. * Write clear technical documentation for the systems and features you build. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * Significant professional experience building production web applications. * Strong proficiency with TypeScript, React, and Next.js. * Strong understanding of modern JavaScript, HTML, CSS, browser rendering, caching, and frontend performance. * Strong product and UI intuition, particularly for AI\-powered applications where interactions and information hierarchy may differ from traditional deterministic web applications. * Experience designing maintainable frontend architectures, including application state, data fetching, and data flows. * Experience building responsive, accessible, and polished user interfaces. * Experience with automated frontend testing, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing. * A strong sense of ownership and the ability to make pragmatic engineering decisions independently. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * The ability to use AI\-assisted coding tools effectively while retaining ownership of the resulting code, including being able to explain, validate, debug, and modify it independently when necessary. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience building developer\-facing products, dashboards, consoles, or API platforms. * Experience with WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming APIs, or other real\-time applications. * Experience working with audio, video, visualization, or other rich interactive media. * Experience building component libraries or design systems. * Familiarity with modular frontend approaches. * Experience with frontend performance profiling, observability, or testing infrastructure. * Experience with Playwright or similar end\-to\-end testing frameworks. * Experience integrating authentication and authorization systems such as Auth0\. * Familiarity with AI or machine\-learning products. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Inference Backends
jobs.description: Hume AI is looking for a systems\-oriented engineer to own the path from trained model to production inference. Join us in the heart of New York City and contribute to our endeavor to ensure that AI is guided by human values, the most pivotal challenge—and opportunity—of the 21st century. **About Us** ------------ Hume AI is a Series B startup dedicated to building artificial intelligence that is directly optimized for human well\-being. You can learn more about us on our website (https://hume.ai/) and read about us in WIRED, Forbes, and Venturebeat. **About the Role** ------------------ As the first engineer dedicated full\-time to inference backends at Hume, you will own the systems that take trained models from checkpoints to production inference: graph export, engine compilation, runtime integration, serving contracts, client libraries, artifact verification, and the performance and correctness of what runs in production. You will work closely with research scientists, machine learning engineers, backend engineers, and the Data Plane team to bring new models and inference capabilities into production. This is a systems\-oriented role focused on performance, numerical correctness, reliability, and efficient use of accelerators. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, make sound architectural decisions, and own systems throughout their lifecycle—from initial design and implementation through deployment, observability, optimization, and production support. **About the Role** ------------------ As the first engineer dedicated full\-time to inference backends at Hume, you will own the systems that take trained models from checkpoints to production inference. This includes graph export, engine compilation, runtime integration, serving contracts, artifact verification, and production performance and correctness. You will also own Hume’s internal inference platform, which serves many of our in\-house models across products. This includes deployment, routing, load balancing, health checking, observability, capacity management, and safe model rollout. You will work closely with research scientists, machine learning engineers, backend engineers, and product teams to turn new model capabilities into reliable production systems. This is a systems\-oriented role focused on performance, numerical correctness, reliability, and efficient use of accelerators. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy and own systems from design through production. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Own the path from trained checkpoint to served request, including graph export, engine compilation, runtime integration, and serving configuration. * Build and evolve Hume’s internal inference platform for serving multiple models across products and workloads. * Design and operate serving infrastructure, including routing, load balancing, health checking, autoscaling, capacity management, and failure handling. * Build reproducible, versioned inference artifacts and tooling for validation, deployment, promotion, and rollback. * Build verification gates that catch numerical, behavioral, and performance regressions before production. * Design and maintain internal client libraries and standardized serving contracts. * Profile and optimize latency, throughput, memory usage, batching, scheduling, and accelerator utilization. * Diagnose production issues across application, runtime, container, networking, driver, and hardware boundaries. * Improve observability, resilience, testability, and operational safety across the inference stack. * Write clear technical documentation for the systems and APIs you build. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * Significant professional experience building server\-side, infrastructure, distributed, or systems software. * Strong Linux fundamentals and hands\-on experience troubleshooting and profiling production systems. * Professional experience with at least one systems\-oriented language such as Rust, Go, C, or C\+\+. * Experience with distributed systems concepts such as load balancing, health checking, failure recovery, observability, and capacity management. * A practical understanding of neural\-network execution, including computation graphs, tensor shapes, data types, and accelerator execution. * Experience profiling and optimizing production systems. * Comfort working across languages and tooling, including Python for model export, validation, and integration workflows. * Strong ownership, independent technical judgment, and clear written and verbal communication. * The ability to use AI\-assisted coding tools effectively while retaining the ability to explain, validate, debug, and modify the result independently. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience building or operating shared model\-serving or inference platforms. * Experience with GPU inference, CUDA, ONNX, TensorRT, PyTorch, Triton, vLLM, or similar systems. * Experience diagnosing numerical correctness issues such as precision loss, numerical drift, or nondeterminism. * Experience building high\-performance client libraries, SDKs, or networked systems. * Experience with containers, CI/CD, or deploying software into on\-premises or customer\-managed environments. * Contributions to systems, inference, distributed\-systems, or machine\-learning infrastructure open\-source projects. Compensation Range: $170K \- $280K

jobs.title: Mechatronics Engineer
jobs.description: **IMI plc** We are a global specialist engineering company that creates breakthrough solutions. We are curious and like to solve problems, partnering with our customers to solve the demands of today and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow. We embrace innovation and care about outcomes that are good for business, everyday life and making a better world – creating lasting impact for everyone. We design, build and service highly engineered products in fluid and motion control applications. We focus on five market sectors: Industrial Automation, Process Automation, Climate Control, Life Science and Fluid Control, and Transport. Our partnership approach breaks through problems and reduces complexity. We don’t invent in isolation – we collaborate with our customers. We listen closely and we think differently, creating space for diverse minds to innovate. We are working together to make businesses safer, more sustainable and more productive. **Role Overview****:** The Mechatronics engineer provides engineering support in the design, development, deployment, documentation, installation, validation and commissioning of industrial automation systems for material handling. **Work Environment****: Onsite in Saline, MI** **Pay range:** $95,000 \- $110,000 Within this range, individual pay is determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications relative to the job requirements. Base pay information is aligned with market location and may be subject to prevailing wage laws, if applicable. **Key Responsibilities:** * Identify, design, develop, and implement custom engineered solutions, including automation systems that are meeting or exceeding customer specifications and all industry and regulatory requirements. * Lead project teams, research requirements, present design options, and document results for project teams and engineering management. * Responsible for designing automation systems, integrating mechanical systems with electronic systems. * Lead the team (sales, engineering, applications, operations) to analyze client requirements, technical specifications, and project scopes to develop competitive proposals * Prepare detailed cost estimates, including labor, materials, and production expenses * Travel to customers to identify new opportunities and specify scope of active projects * Collaborate with internal teams to gather pricing, technical details, and project feasibility insights. * Generate CAD models, calculations, and possibly simulations to develop and communicate concept solutions, owning the concept development process with the customer from initial requirements through proposal alignment. * Ensure all proposals are accurate, competitive, and aligned with business objectives. * Responsible for the designing, developing, analyzing and testing of actuators, motors, power electronics * Proficient in the use of analytical tools (FEA, DOE, stress/strain analysis etc) to design and problem solve products. Resultant solutions must meet all requirements for cost, performance, creative content, manufacturability, and be delivered to agreed timeframes. * Applies advanced engineering judgment to problem solving in both design work and in productions issues. * Researching and staying updated with the latest technological advancements in mechatronics and related fields. * Lead the development/application of diagnostic tools to troubleshoot durability issues. * Support hardware development and testing of devices. * Optimize and refine automation systems for quality and manufacturability. * Establish and execute design verification test plans for embedded control software. * Manage the organized release of official control software versions to meet program content and timing requirements * Integrate Siemens/Allen Bradley PLC’s into the design of the overall system. * Study the Image Stitching Software Techniques or patterns and support implementation in Inspection System design. * Define electrical requirements and select appropriate technology for electrical devices * Work with design team to develop sequence of operations * Work with controls team to ensure device and system controllability and appropriate failure mode effects management **Critical Competencies for Success:** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering * 3\+ years of experience in related field required, including post\-graduate experience preferred * Hands on experience troubleshooting linear actuators, PLC programming, and pneumatic systems a plus * Effective written and verbal communication skills including presentations to customers, peers and executives. Writes and communicates technical reports. Solid technical writing skills (procedures, reports, etc.) * Competent complex problem solving/troubleshooting skills. * Effective design risk management using Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA). * Ability to operate effectively in the project team environment and communicate with Customers. * Working knowledge of standards an g processes, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing. * Effective time management skills. * Development of intellectual property. * Proficient in Solidworks, Siemens NX, or other CAD software **Physical \& Work Environment Requirements** Ability to sit and stand for extended periods * Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment with exposure to machine noise, coolants, and moving equipment. **What IMI Can Offer You** At IMI, one of our top priorities is to create an inclusive culture of health. We strive to remove barriers to care (whether that be physical or financial) and in doing so, we offer choice for all your health and wellbeing needs. See below for a general overview of our amazing perks and benefits: * Multiple health plans to choose from: HMO, PPO, and High Deductible Health Plans with a low\-cost share * Best\-in\-class 401K plan with zero vesting and up to 6% contribution matching * 14\-week maternity leave at full pay (Adoption benefits are equivalent) * 4\-week paternity leave at full pay (Adoption benefits are equivalent) * Employee Resource Groups that offer community and support, like our Pride Network and Network of Women groups * PTO, encompassing inclusive holidays * Career Development opportunities (IMI’s ‘Catalyst’ Program) * Employer contribution for Health Savings Account, and in many cases free virtual telemedicine, and teletherapy. * Mental Health and wellness programs to support you and your family * Full suite of voluntary benefits to tap into, including but not limited to: Critical illness insurance, hospital indemnity, legal insurance, identity theft protection, and pet insurance or home \& auto insurance through our discount advantage platform * Short \& long\-term disability as well as basic life insurance at 2x your basic salary at no cost to the employee * Free financial advisors, webinars, and classes through Charles Schwab * Annual Employee Stock Purchase Plan with option to purchase IMI shares at a reduced employee only price \- no opportunity to lose, only to profit or refund your investment 100% \*\*Benefits plans change year over year, but we have guiding principles in place to ensure our employees have the tools and resources available to stay connected and up to date\*\* **Health \& Safety** The physical demands described within the Key Duties \& Responsibilities section of this job description are required to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities. Please contact your local HR representative to discuss the specific Work Conditions and Physical Requirements of this role. Health, Safety, and Environmental Duties – At IMI we are all personally committed to protecting our people, minimizing our impact to the environment, the communities we operate in and our company. All members of our workforce have the duty to ensure the health, safety and welfare of themselves, others, and the environment. Every employee is expected to follow all HSE operating procedures, also to challenge any observed behaviors or unsafe acts. Code of Ethics IMI requires the highest standard of ethics in all business dealings, particularly with customers, suppliers, advisors, employees, and the authorities. In accordance with the IMI Way: Our Code of Responsible Business. Changes to This Job Description IMI may amend this job description in whole or part at any time. By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data in line with IMI’s policies. For information about how IMI processes candidates’ data, please see the Candidate Privacy Notice at www.imiplc.com/candidate\-privacy\-notice, available in multiple local languages. IMI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, or veteran status.
