jobs.title: Project Manager II - Mission Critical
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Ryan Companies US, Inc. has an immediate career opportunity for a Construction Project Manager II to join our National Mission Critical team! We are seeking a results\-driven Project Manager II to join our Mission Critical team. In this role, you will manage the execution of Core, Shell, and Tenant Improvement (TI) scopes of work on large\-scale data center projects. Working within a larger, multi\-disciplinary project team, you will collaborate closely with field superintendents, MEP managers, design engineers, and trade partners to deliver building enclosures, structural elements, and white\-space fit\-outs on schedule and within budget. **Some things you can expect to do:** **Core, Shell \& TI Scope Execution** * Lead the day\-to\-day management of civil, structural steel, precast concrete, roofing, building envelope, and interior fit\-out/TI packages. * Coordinate handoffs between core/shell structural delivery and tenant improvement/MEP fit\-out teams to ensure seamless sequencing. * Review drawings, specifications, and constructability details to identify and resolve field clashes or constructability issues early. **Trade Partner \& Procurement Management** * Develop detailed, comprehensive Scopes of Work (SOW) and bid packages for core/shell and architectural trade partners. * Manage trade contractor performance, contracts, submittals, requests for information (RFIs), and change order requests. * Track long\-lead material deliveries for envelope, structural, and interior finishes to prevent schedule bottlenecks. **Project Administration \& Cost Controls** * Maintain accurate cost tracking, budget updates, and monthly forecasting for assigned scopes of work. * Prepare owner billings, review subcontractor pay applications, and track potential change items (PCIs). * Lead weekly subcontractor coordination meetings and publish detailed action item logs and minutes. **Safety, Quality \& Field Collaboration** * Partner with the site Superintendent team to enforce safety policies and maintain a culture of jobsite safety. * Support the project Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) plan, conducting inspections to ensure architectural and structural work meets mission critical standards prior to MEP integration. * Coordinate closely with MEP coordinators and commissioning agents during white\-space buildouts and transition to commissioning. **Qualifications \& Requirements** ---------------------------------- * **Experience:** 5 to 8 years of commercial construction management experience, with at least 2 years focused on mission critical, advanced tech, industrial, or large\-scale core/shell projects. * **Scope Expertise:** Demonstrated experience managing building envelope, structural systems, architectural scopes, and tenant interior fit\-outs. * **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in project management software (Procore, Bluebeam, BIM 360/Autodesk Build, Microsoft Project or Primavera P6\). * **Collaboration:** Strong ability to thrive in a large, integrated team environment and manage high\-volume daily communication across multiple trades and internal peers. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical field experience). **Eligibility:** Position requires verification of employment to work in the U.S. **Benefits:** * Competitive Salary * Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits * Retirement and Savings Benefits * Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts * Life Insurance * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability * Educational Assistance * Paid Time Off (PTO) * Employee Assistance and Wellness Programs * Family Planning \& Parenting Benefits * Employee Discount Programs * Pet insurance * Charitable Donation Matching * Volunteer Time Off (VTO) * Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) *Disclaimer: Eligibility may vary based on factors such as role, hours worked, employment status, length of service, location, and other considerations. Detailed information will be shared with eligible candidates during the hiring process, and the official terms and conditions will be outlined in each individual offer document.* Ryan Companies is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. **Notice to Candidates:** *Please be advised that initial outreach regarding employment at Ryan Companies will only occur via email from the domain* @ryancompanies.com *email address. If you recieve communication from someone you believe is impersonating Ryan Companies, please report it to us at* humanresources@ryancompanies.com **Non\-Solicitation Notice to Recruitment Agencies:** Ryan Companies kindly requests that recruitment agencies and third\-party recruiters do not submit unsolicited resumes or candidate information to any Ryan Companies employee or office. Ryan Companies will not be responsible for any fees or expenses associated with unsolicited submissions. If recruitment services are required, we will reach out directly to agencies on our approved vendor list. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager
jobs.description: SM Energy is seeking a strategic and delivery\-oriented IT Program Manager to lead cross\-functional technology and digital initiatives within the Business Improvement Office (BIO) Execution team. Reporting to the BIO Senior Manager of Project Execution, this role is responsible for driving project and program delivery strategy, managing complex technical initiatives, and translating enterprise strategic priorities into execution while ensuring initiatives are aligned, coordinated, and delivered in a way that maximizes business value. The IT Program Manager provides program leadership, delivery oversight, and stakeholder coordination across a broad portfolio of technology initiatives, including enterprise applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data platforms, integrations, automation, artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and custom development. Operating with both strategic perspective and execution discipline, this role sets direction, manages dependencies, identifies interdependencies, resolves competing priorities, drives clarity in ambiguity, and promotes adoption of solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes. This position requires a strong strategic mindset, the ability to influence without direct authority, and the capability to mobilize diverse teams toward shared objectives. The IT Program Manager partners closely with business leaders, IT leadership, project managers, and technical teams to keep projects aligned with program goals, guide teams through ambiguity, and deliver outcomes that support SM’s strategic priorities. **Essential Roles and Responsibilities** * Lead concurrent complex, enterprise\-wide technology initiatives across business and IT teams. * Connect strategic business objectives to technology programs, ensuring initiatives remain aligned with enterprise priorities. * Support data governance efforts by defining ownership, improving data quality, and establishing accountability structures across technology platforms. * Lead change management efforts across initiatives, ensuring end\-user adoption of new processes, systems, and digital capabilities to achieve sustained business outcomes. * Ensure successful transitions from project delivery to sustainable operations by overseeing hyper care, establishing clear process ownership, support models, documentation, controls, and support for ongoing performance. * Measure program success by defining milestones, KPIs, value realization measures, and benefits tracking. * Partner with technical teams to deliver capabilities through enterprise applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data platforms, integrations, automation, and custom\-built solutions. * Lead and coordinate AI\-enabled initiatives, including opportunity identification, use case framing, stakeholder alignment, solution delivery, adoption planning and value realization. * Identify and manage cross\-project dependencies, risks, budgets\[CS1] , vendor needs, and resource constraints across technology workstreams. * Mentor and collaborate with project managers to ensure individual projects align with broader program objectives, integrated roadmaps, delivery standards, dependencies, and expected business outcomes. * Translate business problems into program requirements, partnering with architecture, security, infrastructure, applications, data, and operations teams to deliver scalable solutions. * Partner with data architecture, cybersecurity, legal, and business stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are responsibly designed, governed, secured and aligned with business value. * Lead current state and future state process design, identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, clarify ownership, improve governance controls, and enable processes through technology. * Drive clarity and forward progress in ambiguous or evolving problem spaces. * Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration and alignment between business leaders, technical teams, IT architecture, security, operations, and external partners. * Influence stakeholders and decision makers across multiple organizational levels to maintain momentum and remove barriers to technology adoption. * Establish program governance, delivery frameworks, steering routines, decision forums, and communication structures that provide transparency and accountability. * Proactively identify risks, conflicts, and competing priorities and drive resolution before they impact delivery. * Translate complex technical and operational initiatives into clear updates, options, and recommendations for leadership. * Coordinate with leadership and program managers to define roadmaps, timelines, budgets, resource plans, and sequencing of work. * Support the scaling of technology capabilities across the organization through thoughtful change management, training, communications, and business stakeholder relationships. * Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across program teams. * Provide leadership and mentorship to project managers and cross\-functional team members. * Clearly and concisely convey ideas in written and verbal formats, actively listen, and communicate effectively vertically and horizontally throughout the organization. * Other general duties as assigned. **Role\-Specific Technical Knowledge \& Skills** * Strong understanding of modern technology ecosystems within upstream oil and gas, including enterprise applications, data platforms/architecture, E\&P technical applications, and field applications. * Experience delivering initiatives involving system implementations/integrations, data governance frameworks, AI solution, machine learning, automation, and advanced analytics solutions. * Ability to work effectively with application owners, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity, data engineers, software engineers, vendors, project managers, and business stakeholders to translate operational problems into scalable technical solutions. * Experience contributing to program lifecycle activities, including roadmap development, scope definition, integrated planning, dependency management, budget and resource coordination, vendor coordination, change management, and adoption strategies. * Experience working within Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project environments. Ability to translate technical topics into business context for stakeholders and drive adoption of new capabilities. * Expert with tools such as MS Teams, Azure DevOps, Excel, Visio, SharePoint, and PowerPoint. Demonstrates strong technical fluency across the tools and technologies supporting enterprise solutions and can lead meaningful discussions with technical and business teams. Experience supporting initiatives involving: + Enterprise application implementations and upgrades + Infrastructure, network, endpoint, and workplace technology initiatives + Cybersecurity, identity, access, compliance, and IT governance programs + Data platforms, analytics, reporting, automation, and integration solutions + Vendor technology implementations and cross\-functional transformation effort. **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in related field is preferred. * Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred. * Program or portfolio management experience preferred. * Experience or coursework related to information technology, systems delivery, cybersecurity, data analytics, automation, or enterprise applications preferred. **Typical Experience:** * 8–10\+ years of experience in program management, project management, technology delivery, or a hybrid role leading complex technology initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders. * Experience leading multiple concurrent and interdependent technology workstreams involving senior business and IT stakeholders with projects including enterprise applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, automation, integration, cloud, AI, advanced analytics, or transformation. SM Energy offers competitive compensation and benefits programs which include, but are not limited to, variable pay, health care coverage, retirement plan, protection coverage, time off and leave programs, training and development opportunities and a range of allowances connected to specific work situations. Details are available at Careers :: SM Energy Company (SM) (sm\-energy.com). Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

jobs.description: Job Posting: Environmental Scientist State Water Resources Control Board JC\-532305* Environmental Scientist ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENTIST $4,418\.00 \- $9,321\.00 per Month New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **Final Filing Date:** **9/30/2026** **Application Methods:**Electronic (Using your CalCareer Account) By Mail Drop\-off Print Job Save Job ### **Job Description and Duties** **Please note, the Water Boards do not participate in E\-Verify.** *Are you passionate about protecting water quality and making a difference in the community? Join a team of dedicated professionals who care about environmental protection and public health. The State Water Resources Control Board, Los Angeles Region, is excited to offer a job opportunity for a Environmental Scientist, in the Municipal Stormwater Permitting Unit, to help shape the future of stormwater management. The position is located at 320 West 4th Street Suite 200, Los Angeles, California in the heart of downtown right across from the Metro subway station and other public transportation.* *Join a caring and dedicated team of professionals committed to the Water Board’s mission \- “****To preserve, enhance and restore the quality of California water resources and drinking water for the protection of the environment, public health, and all beneficial uses, and to ensure proper water resource allocation and efficient use, for the benefit of present and future generations****.”* *As a part of the Municipal Stormwater Permitting Unit, you will contribute to the protection of California’s water quality by regulating discharges to the Municipal Separate Storm Sewer System (MS4\). As an Environmental Scientist, you will be responsible for developing and managing MS4 permits. Please review the Duty Statement for a detailed description of roles and responsibilities.* **Additional information:** Candidates must possess essential personal qualifications including integrity, initiative, dependability, good judgment, the ability to work cooperatively with others, and the ability to perform the assigned duties of the class. In accordance with the Statewide Telework Policy and GC 14200, the successful candidate must reside in California upon appointment. Proof of residency may be required. For classes with alternate ranges, placement is based on education/experience. The Hiring Unit Contact is available to answer questions regarding the position. **Department Website:** https://www.waterboards.ca.gov/ **Human Resources Contact:** Danielle Klemencic (916\) 319\-8293 danielle.klemencic@waterboards.ca.gov **Hiring Unit Contact:** Erum Razzak (213\) 620\-2095 Erum.Razzak@waterboards.ca.gov Please direct requests for Reasonable Accommodations to the interview scheduler at the time the interview is being scheduled. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category Software Engineering Job Details **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **About the Team** Salesforce Trust Platform, providing foundational security, availability, compliance, and resilience for the Agentic Enterprise. From the hardware\-backed Root\-of\-Trust to application guardrails for administrators, end users, and ISVs, we make every layer of technology secure\-by\-default. We make it extremely hard to attack Salesforce, misconfigure Salesforce, or introduce security bugs at Salesforce. We scale our zero\-trust, always available infrastructure for the most mission\-critical enterprise workloads of the world. We multiply our impact with AI. We use agents and automation to achieve auto\-containment and time\-to\-recover targets that are only possible without human\-in\-the\-loop. **Your Impact** As an engineer, your job responsibilities will include: * Build and ship high\-quality, production\-grade software ,with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high\-quality code. * Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale. * Architect and maintain resilient backend services integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) via external APIs, while implementing robust observability frameworks (logs, metrics, traces) to monitor long\-running AI jobs. * Critically evaluate code (Human or AI\-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance. * Develop test automation and quality tooling, focusing on unit/CI test generation, test failure analysis, and flake awareness. **Required Skills:** * 4\+ years of professional Java development experience. * A demonstrated, genuine AI\-first approach to engineering, using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty. * Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc.) in active development workflows. * Ability to design, iterate on, and test system and user prompts that produce structured, parseable LLM outputs (JSON classification, multi\-field extraction). * Designing and consuming RESTful APIs alongside working knowledge of AWS (S3, STS, KMS, Lambda, DynamoDB). * Experience with Bazel or Maven and a strong willingness to work in a monorepo. * Experience with Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD pipelines, Docker image creation, and container operations. * Experience with TypeScript (Node) and/or Python service development is a strong plus. * Office\-Flex: work in\-person three days per week; or 10 days per quarter for some engineering teams. Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;The typical base salary range for this position is $117,200 \- $313,700 annually. In select cities within the San Francisco and New York City metropolitan area, the base salary range for this role is $141,200 \- $344,700 annually.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

jobs.title: Airport Network Support Administrator II – Video Surveillance Systems
jobs.description: **Position Title:** Airport Network Support Administrator II – Video Surveillance Systems**Job Description:** Provides technical support and administration for the Airport’s enterprise video surveillance systems, including cameras, servers, workstations, switches, and related network infrastructure. Troubleshoots complex video, hardware, software, and network issues while supporting system installations, upgrades, security, and end users. Experience with enterprise CCTV/video management systems, IP networks, VLANs, PoE, Windows environments, and field\-based technical work is highly desirable. Various work schedules may be required to accommodate the hours that the Help Desk and onsite technical support staff are available for City customers. Occasional weekend work and on\-call work may be required. About the Position: The Airport Network Support Administrator II – Video Surveillance Systems provides technical support and system administration for complex, networked video surveillance systems at the Airport. This role installs, configures, maintains, troubleshoots, and optimizes cameras, recording and storage servers, workstations, switches, and related network infrastructure while partnering with technical teams, vendors, and end users. The ideal candidate has experience with large enterprise CCTV/video surveillance systems and networked video management systems, along with knowledge of IP networks, VLANs, PoE, routing, Windows environments, and remote diagnostic tools. OEM video management certification, experience with structured cabling and low\-voltage testing equipment, and strong communication, documentation, customer service, and problem\-solving skills are highly desirable. **Position Hourly Range:** $27\.89 \- $38\.04/hr based on qualifications and experience. **This position is eligible for full city benefits, including:** * Health Insurance * Dental, Vision and Life Insurance * Paid vacation and personal leave * 6\-12 weeks of paid parental leave available * Retirement contributions toward a pension plan and/or 401(k) * A robust Employee Assistance Plan (EAP) * Up to $4,000 tuition reimbursement annually * Discounted supplemental benefits like pet insurance and legal services Desired Qualifications * Experience administering and maintaining large enterprise CCTV/Video surveillance systems including Cameras, Recording/Storage Servers, Video Workstations, Media Converters, Switches, and Microphones with varying end user requirements. * Experience Troubleshooting and resolving hardware, software, and network issues pertaining to camera, workstation, and server infrastructure. * Must be able to utilize and understand testing equipment for structured cabling, video, network, and low voltage systems * Experience in designing, installing, and administering complete networked video management systems. * Basic understanding of IP networks, Switches, VLANs, PoE and Routing in a multicast video environment. * Knowledge of Windows operating systems with experience imaging, updating, patching, and troubleshooting workstations/servers in an enterprise environment. * Experience with remote access, diagnostic, and monitoring tools. * OEM certified on video management systems/platforms. * Understanding of Camera and video parameters: Frame rates, image resolution, compression, video format, etc. * Experienced with system management, documentation, and certification best practices. * Strong written and verbal communication with ability to express technical knowledge to all levels of understanding. * Customer service experience: professional interaction with end users, vendors, and other stakeholders. * Ability to work independently and as part of a team. * Physical aptitude for fieldwork: Ladders, rooftops, hand tools, heavy lifting, utilizing lifts and other machinery, exposure to elements and construction zones. Minimum Qualifications: * **Graduation from a four\-year accredited college with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field and four (4\) years experience in supporting PCs (using Windows OS) and LAN administration or an equivalent combination of education and experience substituted on a year\-for\-year basis.** * Possession of one (or more) of the following certifications may also be required (depending on position requirements): Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE), or a Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate (MCSA), or a combination of 2 or more of the following certifications: Microsoft Certified Office Specialist Master, Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician (MCDST), Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), HP Printer Support, HP Hardware Support, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Network Associate Voice (CCNA Voice), CompTIA A\+, CompTIA Network\+, CompTIA Security\+. * Considerable knowledge of Microsoft operating systems, topologies and protocols. * Must be able to demonstrate considerable and highly technical knowledge of pers wide security on the network and for remote users. This includes the evaluation and installation of necessary software components needed to maintain a secure operating environment for the network users and departments. * May serve as a primary contact for hardware and\\or software vendors through which vendor provided service and support will be coordinated. * Assists customers using desktop and mobile computer systems by troubleshooting complex hardware and software problems, such as system compatibility and configuration issues, hardware failures, and provides end\-user training. * Installs, configures, and maintains desktop and mobile computer systems using various tools such as: imaging software, package creation and deployment software, and PC remote support software. Installs, configures, and maintains network printers and associated print drivers. Installs, configures, and maintains wireless network products, such as air\-cards and wireless network interface controllers (WNIC), etc. * Answers and resolves trouble calls from customers over the phone and in person. Must use and understand the call taking process and utilize the call tracking system to document all solutions and to share knowledge. * Assists with PC life cycle management processes such as: technology purchasing, data retention and deletion, inventory surplus, etc. * Provides software integrity while meeting licensing requirements for all LAN software, including the evaluation of potential software products, maintaining licensing requirements set forth by the manufacturers and the City, and installing accurate and timely software upgrades. * Documents all essential technical processes and procedures ensuring that repeatable processes are in place, shared and followed. * Assists with network backup and restore processes. * Maintains an inventory of boards, connectors, and other related replacement parts for the phone and data systems. * Coordinates with the Network System Engineer Team to provide and maintain communications between multiple protocols. This includes all hardware and software requirements to enable LAN communication on a standard protocol level such as TCP/IP. * Assists in the audio / digital video production phase of SLCTV. * Analyzes functionality of voice and data communication and network equipment. This can include but is not limited to configuring, diagnosing, and repairing telephone services, VoIP services, and voicemail PBX communication systems. * Creates, configures, and maintains scripts and software automation. This can include but is not limited to configuring, diagnosing, repairing, upgrading, and optimizing VBScript, AutoIt, AutoHotkey, batch files, and Bash. * Performs various other duties as assigned. Working Conditions: * Moderate physical effort. Moderate lifting required, intermittent sitting, standing and walking. Intermittent exposure to moderate noise levels. Comfortable working conditions. * Regular exposure to stressful situations as a result of human behavior and the demands of the position. * Attends meetings, conferences, workshops and training sessions to become and remain current on the principles, practices and new developments in assigned work areas. Career Ladder Note: * After all qualification requirements for a Network Support Administrator III are met, incumbent may be promoted to a Network Support Administrator III with approval of CIO and Department Head, provided sufficient funding is appropriated for the impacted budget year. ### **The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by persons assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and skills required of personnel so classified.** ### **All requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities.** POSITION TYPE Full\-Time DEPARTMENT Airport **Full Time/Part Time:** Full time**Scheduled Hours:** 40

jobs.description: Responsibilities: **This position allows for a hybrid work schedule with a mix of work spent in office and working remote from home.*** This position will offer you the opportunity to utilize and expand your drafting skills, while working in a multi\-disciplined team environment with other designers and/or engineers in the preparation of design drawings based on design input * You will have the opportunity to apply your computer\-aided drafting skills, while receiving hands\-on training in 3D design software environments. * You will be involved in creating master sketches to scale showing relation of proposed installations to existing facilities and exact specifications and dimensions * You may accompany and assist experienced designers on walkdowns at client facilities to gather information for your design project * While interfacing with vendors and construction contractors, you may be given the opportunity to explain your drawings so appropriate design adjustments can be made Qualifications: **We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.*** An Associate's Degree in a technical area including drafting or a high school diploma and equivalent technical design experience * Advanced drafting experience using standard computer drafting tools (i.e MicroStation) * Ability to visualize parts in 3D without the aid of the computer * Knowledge in MicroStation * Ability to multi\-task from project to project Valued but not required skills and experience:* Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principals involved in production of technical plans, drawings, and models * Knowledge of the practical application of engineering science and technology, including the ability to relate various equipment to a technical design Technology \& Innovation: Sargent \& Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high\-quality outcomes for our clients. jobs.description: ### **Why join Stryker?** Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture. We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description** We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine! We are proud to offer you 12 paid holidays annually. For an overview of our benefits and time off, please follow this link to learn more:US Stryker employee benefits.**What you will do:** As our Senior Principal Engineer, you will serve as the Enterprise Digital Technology Innovation Lab's lead software engineer and technical authority. You will be responsible for translating business problems and emerging opportunities into working prototypes, proofs of concept, pilots, and in some case even production ready solutions. You will be the senior/most technical resource within the Innovation Lab and will lead the technical delivery of multiple innovation initiatives across the enterprise. Additionally, the focus will be on accelerating experimentation, reducing time from idea to proof of value, and helping transition successful solutions into broader delivery teams when appropriate. * Providing technical leadership and architecture direction for Innovation Lab initiatives * Designing, building, and reviewing full stack software solutions and AI enabled applications * Rapidly prototyping new concepts and validating ideas with business stakeholders * Establishing engineering standards, development practices, and technical governance for the lab * Partnering across ED\&T, cybersecurity, architecture, data, and business teams to accelerate innovation efforts * Mentoring engineers and helping build the lab's long\-term technical capabilities * Evaluating emerging technologies and determining their applicability to Stryker **What you need:** **Required:** * A Bachelor's degree is needed for this position. * 10\+ years of progressive professional software engineering experience, with a proven record of hands\-on software delivery, senior technical leadership, and meaningful impact across complex software systems, products, platforms, or enterprise technology environments. * 8\+ years of senior technical leadership experience as a Chief Engineer, Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, Senior Architect, Software Director, Startup CTO, Founding Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leader. * 7\+ years of deep full\-stack engineering experience across modern front\-end, back\-end, cloud, API, database, integration, and DevOps technologies. The candidate must have hands\-on mastery of both front\-end and back\-end systems and be able to own features end\-to\-end, review code, make architecture decisions, and set the engineering quality bar for the team. * 5\+ years of experience architecting scalable, secure, cloud\-native, enterprise\-grade systems, including distributed systems, data\-intensive applications, APIs, integrations, cloud services, and modern software platforms. * 3\+ years of recent applied AI, machine learning, or generative AI experience, including hands\-on experience building AI\-enabled applications, prototypes, automations, agents, or internal tools. **Preferred:** * Strong hands\-on experience with modern software technologies such as TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, Node.js, Python, Django, .NET, Java, Go, Rust, SQL, NoSQL, REST APIs, GraphQL, and event\-driven architectures. * Strong cloud\-native and DevOps experience, including AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless architectures, microservices, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure as code, secure deployment practices, and modern DevSecOps principles. * Experience building AI\-enabled solutions using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, AI agents, model evaluation, workflow orchestration, semantic search, or AI\-assisted development tools. * Fluency with AI\-native engineering practices, including the effective use of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar AI coding assistants to accelerate software delivery while maintaining engineering discipline. * Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous business problems from concept to working software quickly, especially in prototype\-driven, startup\-style, innovation lab, advanced engineering, or rapid delivery environments. * Strong understanding of cybersecurity, privacy, data governance, identity and access management, secure architecture, responsible AI, and enterprise software risk management. * Experience integrating with enterprise systems, internal data platforms, APIs, identity providers, business applications, and data sources while navigating access, security, privacy, governance, and compliance constraints. * Experience in medical technology, healthcare, life sciences, regulated software, digital health, sales enablement, field service, hospital operations, or enterprise healthcare systems. * Prior experience in medtech, healthtech, financial services, aerospace, defense, or another regulated industry where security, privacy, quality, auditability, and compliance are critical. * Familiarity with regulated software practices, including quality management systems, design controls, risk management, validation, auditability, traceability, and healthcare data privacy. * Experience building or leading innovation labs, digital factories, rapid prototyping teams, advanced engineering groups, startup studios, internal product incubation teams, or enterprise AI teams. * Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Snowflake, Databricks, ERP systems, CRM systems, identity platforms, data warehouses, and business intelligence tools. * Experience building software for sales representatives, commercial teams, internal operations, customer support, field service, business unit leaders, or enterprise IT organizations. * Experience with product discovery, design thinking, lean experimentation, customer research, user experience design, and prototype validation. * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical field preferred. Posted Date: 09/16/2026 This role will be posted for a minimum of 3 days. **United States of America Pay Ranges:** * **USN**: $155,900 \- $259,700 USD Annual * **US5**: $163,700 \- $272,700 USD Annual * **US10**: $171,500 \- $285,700 USD Annual * **US15**: $179,300 \- $298,700 USD Annual * **US20**: $187,100 \- $311,600 USD Annual * **US30**: $202,700 \- $337,600 USD Annual View the U.S. work location and transparency guide to find the pay range for your location. jobs.title: Applications Engineering, Staff Engineer
jobs.description: Sunnyvale, California, United States **Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18761 **Base Salary Range** $129000\-$193000 **Date posted** 09/15/2026 ### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent years solving real engineering problems, not just running simulations. The kind where a customer's product launch depends on getting the structural analysis right, and you know how to work backward from their constraint to a solution they can actually use. You understand that the best technical answer means nothing if it does not fit their workflow, their timeline, or their team's skill set. You are comfortable walking into a room where you are the only one who understands both the physics and the software, and you can translate between those worlds without making anyone feel lost. When a customer describes a packaging failure or a thermal issue, you are already thinking about which solver to use, what assumptions to test, and how to script the setup so they can repeat it next month. You do not wait for perfect data. You work with what is available, ask the specific questions that matter, and move the project forward. If a demo does not go as planned, you troubleshoot in real time and turn it into a teaching moment. At Synopsys, you will work with customers who are building the next generation of semiconductors and electronics, and what you help them solve actually ships. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Lead technical engagements throughout the sales cycle, from discovery calls where you map customer workflows to live demos where you show how Ansys software solves their specific structural, thermal, or reliability challenges * Work directly with semiconductor and electronics packaging engineers to understand their design problems, then configure, script, and deploy simulation solutions using Ansys tools that fit into their existing CAD and PLM environments * Build Python\-based automation scripts and custom workflows using Ansys APIs to help customers move from manual, one\-off analyses to repeatable, scalable simulation processes * Collaborate with Ansys product teams to translate what you are hearing from customers into feature requests, test pre\-release builds on real\-world problems, and document best practices that become part of the product roadmap * Deliver consulting services and training sessions, from introductory workshops to deep\-dive technical implementations, helping customers get value from day one * Support field marketing efforts by authoring technical content, presenting at industry conferences, and creating application examples that demonstrate differentiated value in electronics and semiconductor markets * Travel to customer sites, trade shows, and internal meetings up to 25% of the time, with flexibility to increase based on project needs ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Customers will close design cycles faster because the simulation workflows you built actually work in their environment, with their data, under their constraints * Sales teams will win competitive opportunities because you showed up with a solution that addressed the customer's specific failure mode, not a generic pitch * Product teams will build features that matter because you brought them real customer requirements, not guesses, and tested those features before they shipped * Engineers at semiconductor and electronics companies will trust simulation more because you helped them see accurate correlation between their models and physical test results * Synopsys will expand its footprint in electronics packaging and semiconductor reliability because you made the software accessible to teams who previously saw simulation as too complex or disconnected from their workflows * New users will ramp faster because the training materials, scripts, and examples you created give them a clear path from installation to productive work * The business will grow because the technical relationships you build turn into renewals, expansions, and references that open doors in new accounts ### **What You'll Need** * BS in Mechanical Engineering or related field with 5\+ years in an engineering software environment, or MS with 3\+ years, or PhD with industry exposure to structural, thermal, or reliability simulation * Deep subject matter expertise in structural mechanics applied to electronics or semiconductor domains, including packaging, PCB assemblies, or chip\-level reliability analysis * Hands\-on experience with Ansys software or other commercial CAE tools like COMSOL, Abaqus, or similar platforms used for finite element analysis * Strong Python scripting skills with demonstrated experience building automation workflows, integrating APIs, or developing custom applications on top of commercial engineering software * Ability to diagnose complex simulation problems, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders, and write documentation or presentations in fluent English * Willingness to travel domestically up to 25% of the time for customer meetings, on\-site implementations, and industry events * Experience in customer\-facing roles such as applications engineering, technical support, or consulting services is a strong plus, especially if you have worked with senior engineering leaders or executives ### **Who You Are** * You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a vague description of a product failure, and walk out with a clear plan for which analysis to run, what boundary conditions to test, and how to set up the model so they can reuse it * When a demo goes sideways, you do not panic. You troubleshoot in front of the customer, explain what you are doing, and turn the problem into a teaching moment that builds credibility * You have worked in environments where the answer is not in the user manual. You dig into APIs, test scripts, read source code if you have to, and figure out how to make the tool do what the customer actually needs * If a customer asks for a feature that does not exist yet, you do not just say no. You find a workaround, document it, and loop in the product team with enough detail that they can prioritize it properly * You are comfortable presenting technical content to a room full of PhD engineers and then simplifying the same concept for a program manager who needs to understand risk and timeline, not equations * You manage your own calendar, follow up without being reminded, and treat customer commitments like they matter, because they do ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** You will be joining the Ansys Customer Excellence team within Synopsys, a group that works directly with customers to deploy simulation software, solve real engineering problems, and support the sales process with deep technical expertise. This is a multi\-disciplinary team that spans different physics domains, industries, and customer types. You will collaborate with sales, product development, and other applications engineers to deliver solutions that help customers engineer what is ahead. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, reporting lines, and how this role fits into the broader Synopsys organization during the interview process. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary bonuses. Synopsys offers comprehensive health, wellness, and financial benefits as part of a competitive total rewards package. The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of job\-related factors, including location, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details on the total rewards package upon request. The base salary range for this role is across the U.S.

We'd rather align ourselves to the goals we're working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically. **We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:** Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren't tied to our own. We proactively source input. We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there's a better or more impactful way to solve problems. **We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:** We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is. We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long\-term retention. We answer questions and address problems early and proactively. We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically. **We Execute For Impact:** We don't subscribe to "best practices" or "industry KPIs". We're uninterested in how we compare to "benchmarks"; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don't subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper\-focused on improving customer retention and experience. **We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption**: We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, "what's the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?". We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don't expect to be perfect the first time. **How You'll Make An Impact** ----------------------------- * Serve as the NetSuite functional and technical SME, providing guidance on system architecture, data integrity, and best practices for financial systems. * Architect and maintain advanced dashboards, saved searches, and custom reports in NetSuite and dedicated BI tooling (Looker, Sigma, etc) to support real\-time financial and inventory visibility across the organization. * Gather requirements and lead a group of cross\-functional stakeholders to architect, implement and support scalable technical solutions, including full system implementations. * Collaborate with TFD's engineering function on custom solutions inside and adjacent to our financial systems. * Own the order\-to\-cash sys ence with version control (e.g., Git) and basic scripting (JavaScript, Python) for automation and integration support. * You're a skilled communicator and have the ability to absorb and distill complexity into simple terms to drive decision making. * You are an owner, have expert\-level problem\-solving skills, and can prioritize tasks effectively, with a strong attention to detail and a focus on efficiency. * You love dogs! **Office Guidelines** --------------------- We are an in\-office culture, made of in\-office people who thrive on the collaboration and magnetism of working in a shared space. We ask all team members to be in office 4 \- 5 days a week to build a collaborative and invested environment to foster our unique in\-person culture we are proud to have. This office policy is subject to change at company discretion. **Our Belonging Philosophy:** ----------------------------- At TFD, we believe Belonging is a shared commitment to creating a workplace where every person feels respected, valued, and empowered to be themselves. When people feel a true sense of belonging, they do their best work, take smart risks, and bring forward diverse perspectives — leading to stronger decisions and deeper relationships. We anchor this belief in a simple phrase: "Everyone's welcome at the dog park." No matter your background, identity, or role, there's space for you here. There's no one way to show up at the dog park— just shared space, mutual respect, and the freedom to be yourself. Being included is just the beginning, it's about contributing your voice, growing through challenges, and building trust through shared goals. This philosophy guides how we lead, how we hire, how we communicate, and how we grow. We continuously evaluate to ensure we are creating a consistent experience that cultivates belonging for all employees, from hiring and performance reviews to talent development. We also believe Belonging happens in everyday moments of connection; lunch with a new teammate, a shared laugh, or a quick story about your weekend. Our structure includes biannual employee surveys, manager training, TFD camps, and support from Humans to ensure we're listening and learning from our Team. Together, these efforts reflect what Belonging means at TFD: a culture where everyone can thrive. **A Few of Our Best Benefits** ------------------------------ * Dog\-friendly office in SoHo * Market\-competitive compensation and equity packages * Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, and Vision * Company supported mental health benefits * 12 week paid parental leave * Competitive 401k plan with company match * Flexible PTO * Discounted fresh food for your pup * Your pet interrupting video calls (and in\-person meetings) is now a feature, not a bug **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** ------------------------------------------ The Farmer's Dog, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer II
jobs.description: At Thorlabs, we design and manufacture components, instruments, and systems that transform the world by identifying, enabling, and accelerating key photonics (i.e., light\-based) technologies. Backed by a dedicated workforce of more than 3,000 employees worldwide, Thorlabs contributes to cutting\-edge research and real\-world innovation. Whether you're early in your career or bringing years of experience, you’ll find opportunities to grow, take ownership, and make meaningful contributions from day one. We know every employee brings unique talents and perspectives that fuel our success, and we seek driven individuals who are excited to make an impact in a fun, fast\-moving culture. The position conceives, plans, designs, develops, and implements real\-time firmware for microcontrollers to be used in complex instruments. The position is expected to develop basic software and user interfaces for testing. Activities include design documentation, prototype verification and debug, test development, and transfer to manufacturing. It requires troubleshooting complex electronics and system problems and being committed to customer satisfaction. Although the location of the position is in Newton, NJ, from time to time it may be required to undertake duties at other Thorlabs locations. **Essential Job Functions include the following, but are not limited to:** * Develop embedded firmware to control and or monitor many different optical, mechanical, and electrical components within an integrated system * Design and support documentation including, but not limited to: firmware theory of operation, SDK definition, source control, and revision tracking, test procedures, and end user’s manuals. * Specify and perform the testing required to characterize catalog or system products. This includes technical data such as qualification test procedures, acceptance test procedures, report, testing jigs and fixtures, etc. * Work closely with software group to maximize functionality and technology usage * Take a design from an initial concept through prototyping, debugging, and manufacturing phases * Manage project timeline * Troubleshoot and resolve electronics\-related system issues * Develop test fixtures for manufacturing * Assist and/or troubleshoot our production team when problems arise. **In addition to the essential functions and duties listed above, all positions are also responsible for:** * Meeting company standards pertaining to quantity and quality of work performed on an ongoing basis, performing all work\-related tasks in a manner that is in compliance with all Company policies and procedures. * Adhering to Company policies, procedures, and directives regarding standards of workplace behavior in completing job duties and assignments. The Company retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position. **Requirements** **Physical Activities:** This is largely a sedentary role; however, some filing is required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand, as necessary. **Qualifications:** * 3\+ years’ experience with embedded software / firmware and debugging **Education:** * MS Degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering * Experience can substitute for MS Degree (BS \+ 5\+ Years) **Specialized Knowledge and Skills:** * Thorough knowledge in embedded hardware, such as a microprocessor and microcontroller\-based control and monitoring circuits. * Expert in in C, C\+\+, C\#. * Experienced in using an oscilloscope. * Direct experience working with FreeRTOS. * Experiences with version control software, such as DevOps. * PID control implementation in Firmware. * Experienced with developing firmware for real\-time I2C, SPI, USB protocols. * Proven expertise in troubleshooting and resolving electronic issues in instruments. * Experienced with design and implementation of optoelectronic circuits and control systems. * Knowledge of motion control with different type of actuators * Knowledge of Analog or Digital boards and systems * Strong communication skills and presentation skills * Strong ability to take initiative. * Flexibility/adaptability in a fast\-paced \& dynamic environment **The salary range for this position is $99,200 \- $120,000 D.O.E.** **Benefits** ***Thorlabs offers a complete benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision insurance, company paid life insurance, a generous PTO package, a 401(k) plan, and tuition reimbursement just to name a few.***

The GIS Coordinator’s primary purpose is to plan, design, manage, and maintain utility geospatial information to support activities such as utility system operations and maintenance, plan review, asset management, modeling, and master planning. Work is performed under the supervision of the Utility Engineering Supervisor and will lead the GIS Team while orchestrating complex GIS endeavors that drive tangible impact. In this role, you will serve as a trusted GIS leader and subject matter expert, partnering with utility professionals across Cary to ensure accurate, accessible, and innovative geospatial information supports critical decision\-making. We're seeking a dependable individual who thrives with minimal direction, taking ownership of tasks and delivering exceptional results. Effective communication is paramount conveying information to diverse stakeholders, including staff, citizens, design professionals, contractors, and elected officials. As a GIS Coordinator, you'll possess the remarkable ability to deconstruct massive projects into manageable components, ensuring the realization of our primary objectives. In Cary, caring for our community and upholding its values isn't just a duty—it's a way of life. Your leadership within this role, coupled with sound judgment, will be pivotal to our shared success. If you're ready to make a meaningful impact, seize this opportunity to join our amazing team and help shape Cary's future! **\*\*The anticipated hiring range for this position is $80,059\.20 \- $95,700\.80\. Applicants who possess relevant certifications and experience may be eligible for higher starting pay.** **Typical Tasks** ----------------- * Provides GIS leadership for the planning, design, management, improvement, and maintenance of Cary’s utility GIS systems and data. * Coordinates and monitors daily tasks and activities of the two Utility GIS Specialists and provides technical training and guidance. * Serves as the utility GIS program liaison, technical support contact, and subject matter expert, both within the Utilities Department as well as Cary\-wide. * Manages periodic GIS improvement projects and GIS data acquisition surveys. * Creates and maintains utility GIS standards, procedures, and best practices for data collection, integration, editing, management, and archiving. * Trains and educates staff regarding the use of GIS and assists with GIS analysis and problem resolution. * Coordinates communication and data interaction between utility GIS and other Cary data sources such as Salesforce, ESO fire software, SAS, and Naviline. * Performs other job\-related tasks as required. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** ----------------------------------- Thorough knowledge of civil engineering practices and procedures; jobs.title: Facilities Maintenance Worker - Winter Seasonal Readiness
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE POSITION** ---------------------- The Town of Truckee is looking for dedicated, dependable individuals to join our Seasonal Readiness team in the Public Works Department. This temporary position plays a critical role in keeping our town accessible and functioning smoothly during winter storms and challenging weather conditions. Snow removal isn’t just about clearing pathways – it’s about maintaining safe, accessible sidewalks and public spaces so residents can move freely and visitors can enjoy all that Truckee has to offer. Your work helps keep the entire Town operational when it matters most. The ideal candidate is responsible, available as the storms come in, and can work in a skilled and independent manner without close supervision. The primary duties of this position include snow removal and general facilities/trails maintenance. This position is a Facilities I entry level position with no previous facilities maintenance experience required. The position is expected to last from early October through March and requires a minimum of a Class C drivers’ license. Under direct supervision, performs a variety of maintenance and repair work on Town buildings, facilities, landscaped areas, trails, and physical assets including painting, plumbing, carpentry, minor electrical, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC), irrigation, landscaping, and trail maintenance; removes snow and ice from Town streets; and performs related work as assigned. **SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED** Receives direct supervision from assigned supervisory and/or management personnel. Exercises no direct supervision over staff. **CLASS CHARACTERISTICS** This is the entry\-level classification in the Facilities Maintenance Worker series. Initially under close supervision, incumbents learn and perform routine painting, plumbing, carpentry, minor electrical, landscaping, trail, and HVAC maintenance and repair duties. As experience is gained, assignments become more varied, complex, and difficult; close supervision and frequent review of work lessen as an incumbent demonstrates skill to perform the work independently. Positions at this level usually perform most of the duties required of the positions at the II\-level but are not expected to function at the same skill level and usually exercise less independent discretion and judgment in matters related to work procedures and methods. Work is usually supervised while in progress and fits an established structure or pattern. Exceptions or changes in procedures are explained in detail as they arise. Positions in the Facilities Maintenance Worker class series are flexibly staffed; positions at the II\-level are normally filled by advancement from the I\-level; progression to the II\-level is dependent on (i) management affirmation that the position is performing the full range of duties assigned to the classification; (ii) satisfactory work performance; (iii) the incumbent meeting the minimum qualifications for the classification including any licenses and certifications; and (iv) management approval for progression to the II\-level **EXAMPLES OF TYPICAL JOB FUNCTIONS (Illustrative Only)** --------------------------------------------------------- *Management reserves the right to add, modify, change, or rescind the work assignments of different positions and to make reasonable accommodations so that qualified employees can perform the essential functions of the job.* *Positions at the Facilities Maintenance Worker I level may perform some of these duties and responsibilities in a learning capacity.* * Performs framing, rough and finished carpentry, and cabinetry; installs and maintains tiles, flooring, and carpet. * Performs minor electrical repairs; installs, monitors, and/or repairs light fixtures, ballasts, switches, outlets, circuits, panels and breakers, wiring, emergency generators, alarm systems, data loggers, auto dialers, heat trace and snow/ice melt systems. * Installs, repairs, and maintains sinks, faucets, toilets, drinking fountains, pumps, and related equipment. * Installs and repairs drywall; patches plaster; prepares surfaces for painting or repainting; applies interior finishes such as paint, paneling, varnishes, etc. * Maintains, repairs, and performs preventative maintenance on building and facility exteriors, such as waterproofing, repairing gutters and roofing, and replacing exterior fixtures. * Monitors, adjusts, inspects, maintains, and repairs mechanical systems such as heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems and fire protection systems. * Irrigates, mows, weeds, trims, mulches, and fertilizes lawns and landscaped areas; plants, waters, and maintains various vegetation; trims and prunes bushes, trees, and shrubs; stakes trees as necessary; sweeps, rakes, blows, and/or removes debris from landscaped areas and trails. * Turns irrigation system on and off based on season; opens, tests, and closes valves; identifies, troubleshoots, a nce from other staff. **WORKING CONDITIONS** * Employees work in a shop and field environment and are exposed to loud noise levels, cold and hot temperatures, inclement weather conditions, road hazards, vibration, confining workspaces, chemicals, mechanical and/or electrical hazards, and hazardous physical substances and fumes. * Employees may interact with upset staff and/or public and private representatives in interpreting and enforcing departmental policies and procedures. * Positions require occasional overtime and weekend and shift work. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Equal Opportunity Employer** The Town of Truckee is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, military or veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. **Reasonable Accomodation Process** The Town of Truckee provides reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. jobs.title: Electrical Engineer (2027 Grad)
jobs.description: The Electrical Engineer I in Product Line Engineering supports the ongoing development, maintenance, and improvement of existing products across the company's vehicle and automation product lines. This role focuses on executing engineering changes, resolving electrical and embedded system defects, validating updates, and supporting product line variant development. The engineer collaborates with cross\-functional teams to ensure all electrical designs, cable harnesses, schematics, and documentation meet performance, reliability, and quality standards. **Job Functions:** * Assist in the design and development of embedded electronic circuits and system\-level electrical architectures for new product variants. * Implement and support engineering changes (ECOs) for existing products, including defect resolution and incremental design improvements. * Create and update electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and cable harness designs. * Support embedded circuit updates and limited firmware modifications under guidance. * Perform validation and functional testing of updated or revised electrical systems using lab instruments and data acquisition equipment. * Document design changes, test results, and updates in the company's PLM or document control system. * Some support of Allen Bradley PLC product control * Participate in root cause analysis and problem\-solving for product defects or field issues. * Ensure all changes comply with company standards, quality processes, and regulatory requirements. * Provide input on reliability, manufacturability, and maintainability of electrical designs. **Travel Requirements:** * 5% overnight travel (Travel expenses paid by Bastian Solutions) **Preferred Skills and Required Qualifications** **:** * Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering or related field. * 0\-2 years of relevant experience in electrical design, testing or vehicle systems * Familiarity with schematic capture and PCB design tools (e.g., Altium, OrCAD, Mentor Graphics). * Exposure to cable harness design and documentation practices. * Basic understanding of embedded systems and microcontroller\-based designs. * Experience using lab equipment such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and data acquisition systems. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Ability to work collaboratively in a cross\-functional engineering team. * Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced product development environment. * Strong Microsoft Office experience, including MS Excel, Word, \& PowerPoint * Exposure or experience with AutoCAD Electrical, Solidworks Electrical, Altium Designer, Studio 5000, and/or other eCAD \& PLC software packages * Must be eligible to work in the US long\-term without the need of sponsorship * Employees must follow all information security policies, protect confidential data, complete required training, and report any suspected security incidents to support our information security controls. **About Toyota Automated Logistics:** Toyota Automated Logistics is your global partner for integrated warehouse automation. Our team combines the talents of Bastian Solutions, Vanderlande's warehousing business and viastore under one brand to deliver scalable systems, intelligent software and life\-cycle services. In addition to exciting work at a growing company, we offer the following benefits: * Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401(k) Retirement Plan with a company match * Vacation / Holiday Pay * Paid Volunteer time off * Tuition Reimbursement * Professional Associations, Conferences and Subscriptions * Company Meetings \& Events *Toyota Automated Logistics does not work with outside recruiting agencies. No solicitation phone calls please.*

jobs.title: Sr Software Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** Designs systems of electrical and fluid controls for a variety of applications including welders, robots, assembly, conveyance and transfer systems. Applies expert/expertise knowledge, principles and techniques in engineering and computer science to generate required hardware design schematics and develop software system programming and documentation. This is a professional position, requiring resource management skills to direct and monitor tasks of others. Must be capable of making autonomous decisions based on experience and project requirements. Has specialized training either formal or through on\-the\-job work experience. Has extensive technical knowledge gained through customer and project experience. Position will be required to work in office and be willing to travel to customer locations when need. **Duties and Responsibilities \- Hardware** · Understands customer specifications (corporate and plant), standards, and local and/or national electric codes for use in designing hardware schematics. · Constructs electrical and Fluid schematic packages by laying out I/O, designing magnetic circuits, fusing, control panel layouts, bills of material, and cable layouts. · Performs the required sizing calculation for power, heat dissipation, wire sizing, fusing, etc. · Performs the required calculations for network layout and traffic analysis. · Research, develop and customize new hardware and software interfaces. · Coordinate and review with Technical Leaders, Automation Engineers, Sr. Controls Engineers, and colleagues to maintain consistency within a given project. · Checks hardware schematics detail work of Entry Level Controls Engineers · Works within the scope definition and timing (due date) requirements. **Duties and Responsibilities \- Software** · Understands customer specifications (corporate and plant) along with standards for use in designing software programs. · Research, develop and customize new hardware and software interfaces. · Modifies existing logic for ‘kit’ designs and create logic utilizing existing references on simple to intermediate complexity systems. · Must be capable of developing Human Machine Interface (HMI) screens and interface from scratch. · Coordinate and review with Technical Leaders, Automation Engineers, Sr. Controls Engineers, and colleagues to maintain consistency within a given project. · Checks Logic and HMI work of Entry Level Controls Engineers · Works within the scope definition and timing (due date) requirements. **Qualifications (Education, Training, Certification, Licenses, Experience)** · **Overall Experience** — 5 years minimum previous work\-related skill, knowledge, or experience on projects in the Automotive sector (GM, Ford, FCA etc.) as well as Tier 1 suppliers (Dana, Magna, Tower etc.) is required for this position. Must master all competencies of Jr. and Mid\-level Controls Engineers. · **Job Training** — Employees in this occupation usually need training involving both on\-the\-job experience and informal training with experienced workers. · **Education** — Bachelor’s degree in Electrical / Computer Engineering or Electronics Technology, or a minimum of five years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. **Knowledge \& Skills** · **Computers** — Knowledge of Windows, and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and a high degree of competence with AutoCAD / ePlan. High degree of competence in HMIs along with Control and Safety PLCs (Allen Bradley, Siemen’s, Modicon, Dynex etc.) and associated application software. · **Mathematics** — Knowledge of basic arithmetic, base 2 (binary), base 16 (hexadecimal), base 8 (octal) and Real (floating point) numbering systems and their applications. Knowledge of Word / Bit addressing schemes. Knowledge of logical operators (i.e., AND, OR, NOT, XOR). · **Mechanical** — Knowledge of machines, tools, and print reading. An understanding of mechanical systems, their components, and the relationship of those systems to the controls design. · **Originality** — The ability to produce unusual or clever ideas about a given topic or situation, or to develop creative ways to solve a problem. This includes the ability to curb or limit creativity when customer requirements and /or commonality of designs dictate. · **Writing** \- Ability to write technical documents and reports for use as reference by engineering and technical writers as well as documentation for the project. · **Reading** — Ability to read, analyze, and interpret customer specifications, electrical controls schematics, technical procedures, and governmental regulations. · **Training** — Ability to train and mentor other Controls Engineers. · **Systems Analysis** — Determining how a system or process should work and how changes in conditions, operations, and the environment will affect outcomes. · **Systems Evaluation** — Identifying measures or indicators of system performance and the actions needed to improve or correct performance, relative to the goals of the system. · **Troubleshooting** — Determining causes of operating errors and deciding what to do about it. · **Programming** — Writing computer programs for various purposes. Join us to be part of a forward\-thinking organization where your innovations will shape the future of control systems technology! Pay: $43\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 – 80\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) 4% Match * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Lake Orion, MI 48359
